articleTitle: Blockchain Based Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and its Challenges: A Review and Proposed Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the modern era, pharmaceutical supply chains evolving into intricate and automated networks that hold significant potential for several benefits to its stakeholders. However, one of the main challenges lies in maintaining data origin traceability throughout this complex supply chain network. Conventional supply networks typically rely on centralized third-party intermediaries, which can cause transparency, accountability, and auditability issues. To address these challenges, some businesses are leveraging blockchain technology and smart contracts, implementing them on the Ethereum blockchain. While blockchain can provide immutability for data and records within the network, it does not entirely resolve issues related to the credibility of involved entities, the accountability of the trading process, and the complete traceability of items in the supply chain. The healthcare industry often grapples with issues concerning data privacy, transparency, and authenticity of the information. This paper delves into a solution for enhancing the tracking of healthcare products by utilizing the Ethereum blockchain alongside smart contracts and decentralized off-chain storage. The implementation of a smart contract serves to ensure the origin of data, eliminates intermediary parties, and furnishes all involved parties with a dependable and immutable record of every transaction.

articleTitle: Enabling Rapid Data Transfer in Medical IoT Systems with a High-Throughput Present Cipher Hardware Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The proposed method aims to revolutionize data transfer speed and security in medical Internet of Things (IoT) systems by harnessing the high-throughput capabilities of the Present cipher through dedicated hardware. It seamlessly integrates three core algorithms: data packing, Present encryption, and optimized transmission. The steps involved in each algorithm, accompanied by their respective mathematical equations. Data packing efficiently organizes medical data into packets, a vital step for subsequent processing and encryption. The Present encryption algorithm, a cornerstone of our approach, ensures secure data packets prior to transmission. Finally, optimized transmission guarantees efficient and swift data transfer within medical IoT systems. By incorporating these algorithms and equations, our method optimizes data transfer speed, energy efficiency, and data security, utilizing the high-throughput Present cipher hardware framework.

articleTitle: Federated Learning Paradigms in Network Security for Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this work, we present a novel approach for enhancing network security within distributed systems through Federated Learning (FL). The proposed method integrates three fundamental algorithms: Federated Averaging (FedAvg), Secure Aggregation, and Adaptive Learning Rate. FedAvg allows collaborative training of a global model while preserving data privacy on decentralized devices. Secure Aggregation employs cryptographic techniques to maintain confidentiality during model updates' aggregation. Adaptive Learning Rate dynamically adjusts the learning rate, enhancing model optimization efficiency. The proposed work illustrates these algorithms through detailed equations and flowcharts. The proposed approach combines these techniques to achieve secure and collaborative model training across distributed devices, thereby enhancing network security.

articleTitle: Real-Time Network Traffic Classification using Advanced Neural Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: There are constantly new problems to overcome while analyzing network traffic in today's complex network systems, forcing researchers to develop new methodologies. We provide a unique technique for real-time network traffic categorization based on progressively complicated neural embeddings. Using the power of deep learning, this solution solves scalability, flexibility, and user privacy concerns while boosting the efficacy and accuracy of traffic classification. We compare our proposed technique to six current traffic classification strategies to illustrate its superiority. Our suggested method incorporates three key techniques: real-time traffic management, traffic data assessment, and the generation of neural embedding models. The act of arranging incoming network packets into flows and eliminating relevant information from those flows is known as traffic data preprocessing. The recommended methodology's remarkable accuracy of 98.5 percent is significantly more than the ordinary accuracy of 94.2 percent of conventional procedures. Furthermore, it has reduced rates of false positives (1.2% rate) and false negatives (2.3% rate) as compared to the gold standard of earlier approaches, which had rates of 6.8% and 8.9% for these two categories, respectively. Increased processing speed, scalability, adaptability, and privacy protection are just a few of the desirable characteristics exemplified by the proposed approach. Our research contributes considerably to the advancement of algorithms for categorizing network traffic, particularly in terms of real-time analysis. The suggested technique provides network administrators and security professionals with a highly precise and dependable tool for regulating and safeguarding network traffic in dynamic and changing situations.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision Support System for Cardiac Arrhythmia Management using AI and ECG Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Our proposed Intelligent Decision Support System for Cardiac Arrhythmia Management leverages state-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms and electrocardiogram (ECG) data to significantly enhance the accuracy of arrhythmia detection and classification. This method encompasses thorough data preprocessing, feature extraction, model training, and real-time arrhythmia prediction. Raw ECG data undergoes preprocessing to eliminate noise and artifacts using a bandpass filter. Key features, including RR intervals and power spectral density (PSD), are extracted to effectively represent arrhythmia patterns. Three powerful AI algorithms - Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) - are employed for model training. An ensemble model is constructed by combining predictions from these models. This approach offers an efficient and reliable decision support system for clinicians, aiding in optimal cardiac arrhythmia management and improving patient outcomes. Our AI-powered technique has several benefits over more conventional methods. Automatically learning from ECG data, it can identify a wide variety of arrhythmias with a high degree of sensitivity and specificity. Lifesaving actions may be implemented sooner thanks to real-time monitoring and notifications. An additional benefit of this system over more conventional, rule-based approaches is that it is constantly learning and adapting to new arrhythmia patterns. This breakthrough has the potential to revolutionize cardiac arrhythmia management by boosting diagnostic precision, operational efficacy, and individual treatment for patients.

articleTitle: Alertness Anticipation Innovations in Driver Safety Predictions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Drowsy driving is a major contributor to traffic accidents and a major risk to public safety. The development of driver sleepiness detection systems has found success in recent years with the use of machine learning techniques. This work proposes a comprehensive approach to machine learning algorithms—such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest, Decision Tree, and K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN)—for the detection of driver sleepiness. In this paper, investigate how these algorithms perform when trained on a picture dataset. Using a camera mounted in the car, the suggested system first takes live pictures of the driver's face. After that, facial landmarks are taken out of these pictures and used as input data for machine learning models. To identify the patterns linked to drowsiness, each algorithm is trained using a labelled dataset that includes both alert and sleepy facial expressions. Using cross-validation approaches, the performance of each algorithm is assessed in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. By informing sleepy drivers in real time so they can take the appropriate safety measures or take a break, the suggested system has the potential to improve road safety. An important way to assess the suitability of various machine learning algorithms for driver sleepiness detection applications is to compare them. To improve the system's accuracy and resilience in real-world situations, more research can concentrate on incorporating other sensor data, such as eye movement patterns or steering habits.

articleTitle: Ransomware Threat Detection and Mitigation using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The relentless evolution of ransomware threats poses an increasingly severe challenge to cybersecurity. In response to this growing menace, this study presents a comprehensive approach for Ransomware Threat Detection and Mitigation using Machine Learning Models. Leveraging the power of advanced machine learning techniques, the proposed method seeks to revolutionize the landscape of ransomware defense. Our methodology commences with the collection and preprocessing of diverse datasets encompassing system and network activities. Feature engineering techniques extract relevant behavioral attributes. A trio of machine learning algorithms, including Self-Organizing Maps (SOM), Random Forest Classifier, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, is deployed for behavioral analysis. These algorithms excel in identifying intricate patterns and temporal dependencies within the data. Threshold-based classification ensures efficient identification of potential threats. Automated response mechanisms further fortify the system, enabling rapid isolation of affected systems and termination of malicious processes. Performance evaluation reveals the superiority of the proposed method over traditional approaches. High Detection Accuracy (93.0%) and Precision (97.0%) attest to its efficacy in accurate ransomware threat identification while minimizing false alarms. The use of LSTM networks bolsters sequential behavior analysis, a crucial factor in combating evolving ransomware tactics. The Proposed methodology's adaptability shines through its capacity to continuously learn and evolve with new data, thereby staying ahead of emerging threats. The inclusion of automated responses adds a layer of proactive defense, crucial in today's fast-paced threat landscape.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Algorithms to Suggest a Method for Predictive Analysis in Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Data mining is frequently utilised in technology & research, but it is also applied in marketing and finances to address problems in those disciplines. By evaluating the actual world, data mining-based decision support systems improve organisational efficiency. Every business frequently experiences a volatile environment as a result of the strains of competitiveness, cost, taxes, etc., The company is dragged farther into a competitive world by privatisation, globalisation, and liberalisation. Proper marketing tactics must be created and put into action if one is to counterbalance the market and endure to accomplish desired results. Throughout its effective data mining technique, the marketing decision-making system reduces the organisational responsibilities associated with analysis and strategic development. In order to quantify the business models for a company, this study effort offered a data mining-based decision support system employing decision trees and synthetic neural networks as a hybrid technique.

articleTitle: Variac Tapping & Buck-Boost Transformer Design Calculations for Servo Controlled Voltage Stabilizers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Variac (also called as ‘Variable Autotransformer’ as a technical name, and also called ‘Dimmer’ by using for dimming of the lights etc.) and BBT (Buck-Boost Transformer) are the main components in every servo controlled voltage stabilizer (SCVS). Variac's tapping and BBT's sizing calculations are one of the challenging task for designing of servo controlled voltage stabilizers. So, during this paper it is clearly explained with suitable example for 100 kVA (natural air cooled), 3-Phase SCVS.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Detecting Fake Reviews – A Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Fake reviews are very popular today as every internet user is depending on the reviews to draw a conclusion on a particular product or organization or hotels in their respective domains. Fake reviews are the one and only thing that is affecting the present world businesses and all other things. As development of web 2.0 it's seen that customers rely more on product ratings and reviews given by customers for product information. Usually, a more positive review attracts more customers and with intern is responsible for the growth of that product. Nowadays people take advantage of this fact and give false reviews in order to mislead the customers affecting company, market efficiency and merchants. The issue which plays the major role in the field of fake review detection is that the fake review groups are adapting to the present users’ expectations and creating the fake reviews which are not able to be detected by the humans. So, we are trying to solve it using some technologies like machine learning to “Fight the machines with machines” to detect the fake reviews using these technologies. And there are many methods in which these fake reviews can be detects and taken care of using many types of machine learning methods. This article aims to achieve understanding of fake reviews detection in various domains like e-commerce and hotel websites etc. And we also work to identify the relation between the fake review and the reason behind creating them. By performing a systematic literature review we can identify and understand about the main approaches that have been previously studied and made accessible to recognize fake reviews and their applications in different situations. And also, absence of high- quality datasets limit the research of fake reviews. We have also mentioned existing research problems in data acquisition and identifying method design to help in future research on fake review detection.

articleTitle: Design and Implement a Wireless Temperature Monitoring System using Noncontact IR Sensor Based on Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: COVID-19 and its genetic mutations pose a challenge to the world and affect the economic system of countries. Recently, countries were forced to reduce restrictions on airports, universities and schools. The main challenge is how to detect its symptoms without contact to the person who may have infection at local area. This depends on measuring the body temperature which represents the first and the most common symptom that can be identifies the infected people with virus or one of its strains. This paper presents an implementation of smart, and inexpensive human body temperature detector by using portable electric system based on Arduino UNO, and MLX 90614 IR temperature sensor. The measured temperature is sent to the control unit by wireless system through Bluetooth (HM-10 module) for the person walk near the IR sensor, and display it instantaneously on (16x 2) LCD. High temperature detection activates alert buzzer while a notification message sends to overseer within ten-meter distance to give a voice command asking the person to move to the safe area. The results are compared with conventional device and determined the average error between them, where the results proved the effectiveness of the proposed system in detecting the person who have high temperature without contact to that person. Where the system is operated effectively and satisfies the requirements for non-contact due to its high reliability, fast response time, and low consuming energy

articleTitle: Advancing Early Detection of Cervical Cancer Through Multi-Model Intelligent Classifiers and Computational Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: One of the most common illnesses in women and one with a high fatality rate is cervical cancer. Early detection using screening techniques helps to increase the lifespan of women and lower mortality rates. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), cervical cancer is now the fourth most common malignancy to affect women. According to surveys, low- and middle-income nations account for 90% of all cancer-related deaths since there is a dearth of knowledge about the disease and its preventative treatments there. When it comes to preserving the health of women, cervical cancer research is one of the most crucial fields of study. Early detection of cervical cancer is crucial because it can save the lives of many women whose lives are at risk. Foretelling cervical cancer growth prior to administering a screening test is the goal of the proposed study, which makes use of data mining and machine learning algorithms. Feature selection methods were used to isolate the characteristics useful for diagnosing cervical cancer. When applied to the dataset, an enhanced SVM model's accuracy was found to be 94.16 percent. This highlights the model's usefulness in screening for a potentially deadly disease like cervical cancer. This type of prediction algorithm for cervical cancer is gaining popularity as a result of its high accuracy. This ensures the model's high level of predictive performance and hints that it could revolutionise the way the needy are assisted if used in real time.

articleTitle: Ensemble Learning for Multi-Class Classification in Cervical Cancer Risk Factor Analysis: An Empirical Computational Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: One cancer that affects women of all ages frequently and is also particularly fatal is cervical cancer. It is fatal because it cannot be anticipated in the early stages when the patient could be treated properly. When cervical cancer cells begin to migrate to nearby organs including the liver, lymph nodes, and lungs, they block the tube that takes urine from the bladder and cause symptoms. Leg discomfort, exhaustion, weight loss, vaginal bleeding, bone fractures, and pelvic pain are among the symptoms in this latter stage. Human papillomavirus (HPV), smoking, numerous pregnancies, using hormonal contraception, and other risk factors include cervical cancer. Screening is a crucial step in the detection of cervical cancer. This study suggests a technique for categorizing cervical cancer risk variables into four separate classes using a multi-class approach. The ensemble learning approach aims to increase the suggested model's accuracy. This technique aids in enhancing the study of risk factors used to determine the likelihood of developing cervical cancer. A multi-layer feed-forward network is used to examine the suggested Artificial Bee colony (ABC) along with a deep learning method known as the LST Model for various screening methods. The gradient boosting method with Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) is found to produce a higher % for all performance measures using the suggested model.

articleTitle: Understanding of Cellular Network Workload and Prediction Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Management of world class services in smart cities required to deploy dense and efficient communication networks. Therefore, we need to increase the network infrastructure in terms of base stations. But increasing network base stations also increases the power consumption and during ideal conditions may cause the power wastage. In this paper, we have explored the workload data of the cellular base stations and presented their trends. In addition, we include Machine Learning (ML) approaches to predict hourly base station workload. In this context, K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) regressor, Support Vector Regression (SVR) and XGBoost regression have been trained. The experiments with the 4G LTE cellular network traffic have been carried out, which consist of a total of 57 base station's workload for 24 hours. Among these base stations, we selected an individual base station to predict the workload. The proposed investigation will helpful for designing an effective proactive power allocation technique to reduce the power consumption in cellular base stations. On the other hand, when we compared the performance of these three algorithms for prediction accuracy, we found that the KNN regressor provides the best accuracy of 99% for predicting individual base station's hourly workload.

articleTitle: An Advance Implementation of Machine Learning Techniques for the Prediction of Cervical Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cancer has now become a widespread issue, and it might be difficult to diagnose it. The analysis and diagnosis of disease in a patient through a monitoring system has advanced significantly, but there are still some obstacles to overcome. Technology-assisted disease discovery is urgently required since it could enable clinicians to make an accurate diagnosis more quickly. The process makes use of event-driven datasets produced by the Internet of Things (IoT). Rarely are the cloud and IoT used to process the real-time dataset for illness discovery. Cancer detection is a serious difficulty since the data generated by sensors constitutes huge data and cannot be quickly processed without the use of data mining and machine learning. A precise and intelligent method is needed for cancer prognosis because it has been discovered that cancer cannot be accurately predicted from offline datasets. The International Federation of Obstetrics and Gynecology (IFOG) realworld data set has been used to predict cervical cancer using machine learning. Five metrics, including true-positive-rate, false-positiverate, f-measure, MCC, and accuracy, have been used to examine the results of the training of six machine learning models using the latest UCI repository. The outcomes demonstrate that the tree-based decision stump machine learning classifier and the meta-based iterative classifier optimizer achieved the maximum prediction accuracy of 77.97%, which is the greatest among the other ML classifiers. The proposed model demonstrated noteworthy performance in terms of prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Demystification of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Literacy, Algorithmic Thinking, Cognitive Divide, Pedagogical knowledge: A Comprehensive Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study aims to demystify Generative AI literacy and algorithmic thinking while addressing higher education's cognitive divide and pedagogical knowledge. A survey-based approach utilizing Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) was employed. A sample of 340 participants was drawn from various higher education institutions, focusing on university students. The study applies a convenient sampling technique to gather responses. The novelty of this research lies in its comprehensive examination of AI concepts in higher education, targeting students as a pivotal demographic for fostering AI literacy and bridging the cognitive divide. This study yields insights into the effectiveness of pedagogical methods and their impact on AI literacy and algorithmic thinking among university students, ultimately contributing to a more informed and AI-competent future workforce.

articleTitle: Use of IOT in Computer Control Using Hand Gesture Using AT Mega 328 over the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the realm of remote control, my preference is computer manipulation through hand gestures. Recent strides in technology showcase the feasibility of using manual gestures on Arduino platforms, facilitated by cloud computing. A Wi-Fi-based hand gesture computer control system was developed using an ESP-01 Wi-Fi module and an Arduino microcontroller, enabling remote control and monitoring without geographical constraints or time limitations. The ESP8266 Wi-Fi module played a crucial role in establishing wireless communication with an Android application (S Remote) for transmitting commands to regulate domestic appliances. The AT mega 328 AVR series Microcontroller R3, lacking built-in Wi-Fi, required the ESP-01 Wi-Fi module for wireless communication and programming. The Arduino IDE facilitated programming, incorporating ESP-01 and LCD components. Hand gesture-controlled robots and PC/laptop hand gesture control systems, both utilizing Arduino technology, exemplify similar applications. The Human Machine Interface (HMI) concept involves physical components and software enabling communication between users and machines. HMI devices, including LED indicators and touch screens, traditionally use keyboards and mice. This research implemented a hand gesture controller using Arduino technology, specifically for web browser features, video playback, and VLC media player audio adjustments. The ESP-01 Wi-Fi module, configured via AT instructions through a UART serial connection, played a key role in integrating a hand gesture system for effective computer control. Users can perform actions like playing or pausing videos and adjusting audio amplitude within the VLC media player solely through manual gestures.

Author Keywords: This research emphasizes creating a Wi-Fi computer control system incorporating hand gestures

articleTitle: Meet the Rocket Women of Chandrayaan-3: Pioneers in Space Exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This captivating research paper unveils and celebrates the accomplishments of the incredible women who played vital roles in the Chandrayaan-3 rocket mission. It begins by addressing the historical context of women's underrepresentation in space exploration and discusses the progress made towards gender equality within the field. Delving into the distinct roles and contributions made by each woman on the Chandrayaan-3 team, the paper illuminates their varied backgrounds, areas of expertise, and remarkable achievements. Through captivating interviews and personal stories, it unveils the hurdles and triumphs experienced by these trailblazers as they navigated their way to success within a male-dominated realm. Additionally, the paper examines how their monumental impact is inspiring future generations of young girls, underscoring the power of representation and its significant influence on fostering dreams and ambitions. Concluding with a broader view of these trailblazers' contributions to space exploration and their lasting impact on this exciting frontier, the paper emphasizes ongoing opportunities for females in space research now and in the future. By championing these inspiring “Rocket Women,” this riveting research paper seeks to encourage and embolden girls everywhere to explore careers in STEM and become leaders in space exploration, paving the way for greater diversity and inclusion within this fascinating field.

articleTitle: Maximizing Insights from MRI Brain Images Segmentation through HSV Histogram and Gabor Wavelet Transform, and Machine Learning-Assisted Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Medical imaging has better managed disease and reduced patient suffering by detecting brain tumours. Medical professionals employ magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Due to its non-invasiveness and high resolution and contrast, MRI can see tissues. MRI may take several images of the same tissue region with improved contrast. Many photographs provide additional anatomical information about the same tissue. Data from many contrast mechanisms can help researchers understand brain illness. Because tumour tissue varies in location, size, shape, and texture, feature extraction is difficult. MR brain imaging components including white matter, grey matter, and cerebrospinal fluid have complicated structures that make feature extraction difficult. The literature on feature extraction for tumour segmentation does not compare which method is best. Here, we implement two commonly used libraries of established and successful texture feature extraction algorithms. By collecting frequency, localization, and orientation, Gabor wavelet feature extraction delivers multi-resolution surface information in both spatial and frequency domains. These feature extraction algorithms reflect the intensity relationship between image pixels or clusters of pixels. They may also predict image quality using first- and second-order statistics. Our research examines the efficacy and complexity of these two feature extraction algorithms for tumour diagnosis and segmentation. The researchers employed a locust-based genetic algorithm to analyse MR images perimage, reducing the likelihood that the results were just machine-Iearning- based.

articleTitle: Non-Linear Model for Psychiatric Health Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Psychiatric problems, such as depression, have been shown to affect a person's physical wellbeing. These symptoms are typical of a large population. Recently developed Unsupervised Machine technologies, like as non-linear ensemble learning, have demonstrated superiority in a variety of practical domains, from computer vision to healthcare. Non-linear ensemble learning has been proven effective in several contexts. There is some study to examine how DL (Deep Learning) algorithms may be integrated into studies of mental health analysis by reviewing the existing literature on the subject. Here are the four groups into which have placed all the things that seem to fit the bill, according to the various use cases: Genetics, genomes, and clinical data for diagnosis and prognosis Analysis of Data for disease identification. In the research paper, too many machine learning algorithms are used to analysis the psychiatric health analysis. There are some supervised and Unsupervised machine learning algorithms are used for training and testing purposes. Main objective of the research paper is essential for making progress for understanding of mental health issues. In this paper address some of the difficulties that arise when attempting to employ Non- Linear Ensemble algorithms to enhance our knowledge of the factors that contribute to psychiatric disorders, and its offer some suggestions for future research that could lead to advances in the diagnosis and treatment of these ailments. When passed through different algorithms, Non-Linear Regression performed is better then other machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: RGBot: A Machine Learning Enabled Requirements Gathering Technique in Agile-Based Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The creation of mobile app has emerged as an integral aspect of modern organizations in a wide range of fields. A greater percentage of mobile app development (MAD) industries are turning to agile practices to increase app quality and shorten development times. Agile-based MAD relies heavily on efficient requirements gathering from stakeholders, and it has a significant impact on whether or not a mobile app is successful. Conventional methods of gathering requirements are typically labor-intensive and error-prone, prolonging the building process, driving up expenses and may struggle to maintain the track of frequent variations that characterize agile-based MAD. Machine learning (ML) approaches are becoming increasingly prevalent in gathering requirements as a means of automating the monotonous task of requirement engineering. The ability of ML approaches to process massive volumes of data, identify trends, and arrive at precise forecasts has the potential for significant advancement in gathering of requirements. This study intends to offer a methodological proposal for automating requirements gathering through the practice of a ML-based interactive bot, which we have named as requirements gathering bot (RGBot). The RGBot streamlines MAD process by acquiring requirements and optimizing customer experiences to meet stakeholders' expectations.

articleTitle: An Exhaustive Meta-Analysis on Consumer Retention Forecasting Using Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this meta-analysis, we present a robust approach for consumer retention forecasting by integrating advanced machine learning algorithms. The method comprises three core algorithms: Consumer Behaviour Neural Network (CBNN), Retention Decision Trees (RDT), and Long Short-Term Memory for Retention (LSTM-R). The objective is to model intricate relationships within consumer behaviours and accurately predict their retention probabilities. CBNN a key component, adeptly captures intricate patterns within consumer behaviour data. It involves multiple hidden layers with activation functions, enabling accurate prediction of retention probabilities based on input features. The flowchart for CBNN showcases the training process involving forward and backward passes, underlining its deep learning approach. RDT this method utilizes decision tree algorithms to predict consumer retention decisions. By recursively splitting the dataset based on information gain, RDT efficiently models consumer behaviour, as depicted in the flowchart. Information gain is maximized to create a robust predictive model. LSTM-R tailored for temporal data in consumer retention prediction, leverages specialized LSTM architecture. It effectively processes sequential consumer interactions, crucial for accurate prediction of consumer retention probabilities. The proposed method integrates these algorithms, leveraging historical consumer data, and conducts a comprehensive meta-analysis to evaluate their predictive performance.

articleTitle: The Role and Impact of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) in 21st Century Education
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Information and communication technologies are being rapidly integrated in education worldwide. The aim of introducing Information and communication technologies is to increase access, aid instruction, develop 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century skills, and improve education quality. However, uptake faces barriers of costs, teacher training, and unequal access. This study focuses on key technologies - Internet, computers, multimedia, and smartboards- analyzing their potential to enable collaborative, engaging, and personalized learning. It also examines challenges like distraction, costs, and teacher issues. This research paper will examine how the transition from traditional classroom settings to technology-enabled learning environments has impacted teaching methods and the overall learning experience. It will analyze the benefits of Information and communication technologies innovations like smartboards and online learning platforms in modernizing education delivery.

articleTitle: Digital Payment System as a Growth Driver for the Indian Economy an Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Digitalization can be aptly considered as a growth driver of an economy in the modern world. Digitalization has some inherent advantages like speed, freedom from carrying cash around oneself, and transparency in monetary transactions, and serves as a blessing in disguise in many ways. It has also been cited as an important growth driver of an economy. The main digital payment systems include Immediate Payment Service, Real Time Gross Settlement, Electronic Fund Transfer, National Automated Clearing House, Unified Payments Interface, and many more. In the Indian context, digitalization picked up a pace post-demonetization. In fact, the financial stroke of the government to contain black money actually proved a boon for digitalization. The current study is an attempt to empirically gauge the impact of digital payments on the GDP of the Indian economy. Regression analysis has been used to study the same.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Cerium Oxide-Incorporated Lead-Free Perovskite Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Scientists are already designing more efficient and ecologically friendly solar systems as the need for renewable energy sources grows. PSCs, or perovskite solar cells, are a relatively new technology that is showing promise as a competitive replacement for the more established silicon-based cells already utilised in this market. PSCs are quickly gaining popularity in the field of solar energy gathering, owing to their outstanding energy conversion efficiency and cheap production costs. PSCs, on the other hand, may be manufactured using less sophisticated methods, reducing the industry's environmental impact and driving down the cost of silicon cell manufacturing. Silicon cells must be manufactured under very sterile circumstances using expensive and labour-intensive procedures. However, due to the presence of lead in these cells, there are severe worries regarding their stability and safety. Our research shows that photovoltaic solar cells, or PSCs, have a significant amount of untapped potential in the renewable energy market. This is especially true when it comes to addressing the issues with the cost and environmental effects of more traditional PV technologies. They created a variety of distinct shallow donor densities (ND) by altering the amount of oxygen injected. The researchers altered the thickness of the perovskite absorber layer, which modified cell metrics like computational efficiency and current-voltage characteristics, to identify the cell design that generated the greatest power with the least amount of waste. The performance was then improved further by adjusting the ND value of CeOx. The obtained PCE efficiency is 31.8%. articleTitle: Business Performance and Social Media Adoption- An Influence Check by using PLS-SEM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study examines how Indian service-oriented enterprises utilize social media differently and how it impacts their profitability. Quantitative research uses online forms to collect data. It was done this way. Individual-level structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) was used to test the hypothesis on the acquired data. The study suggests that how firms utilize social media applications may affect their performance compared to other ways. The study's findings can help social media-using businesses function more smoothly. Business operations can be improved using this knowledge.

articleTitle: Park-Space: A Parking Space Indicator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Parking Spot Indicator Application is a software program that aims to simplify the process of finding parking spaces in busy lots for drivers. Utilizing sensors installed in each spot, it monitors their occupancy status in real-time and presents this information through an easy-to-use interface. This application offers drivers, lot operators, and the environment several benefits. Drivers can save time and reduce stress by avoiding the hassle of searching for a spot, thanks to the real-time updates provided by the application. Operators can optimize resources, reduce congestion, and increase revenue by effectively managing their lots. Additionally, this application helps minimize traffic congestion and emissions by reducing circling time spent looking for parking spots. It is designed to be scalable and adaptable to various types of lots, including outdoor areas, multi-level structures, and underground facilities. The user-friendly interface provides a simple experience with a real-time map displaying available spots highlighted.

articleTitle: Intrusion Response Automation Through Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The proposed method focuses on automating intrusion response using machine learning algorithms to enhance cybersecurity. It encompasses three vital algorithms: Anomaly Detection using Deep Autoencoders, Intrusion Classification using Random Forest, and Adaptive Response using Reinforcement Learning. The Anomaly Detection step employs deep autoencoders, an artificial neural network, to identify deviations from normal patterns in data, crucial for detecting anomalies. The Intrusion Classification step uses Random Forest to efficiently classify these anomalies into specific intrusion types, aiding in targeted responses. The final step, Adaptive Response, employs reinforcement learning to dynamically adapt response actions based on identified intrusion types, maximizing the system's defense strategies.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning Innovations in Network Security and Threat Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In Transfer Learning Innovations in Network Security and Threat Intelligence,” we introduce a holistic approach that harnesses transfer learning to fortify network security and elevate threat intelligence. This methodology revolves around three core algorithms, each addressing a specific facet of cybersecurity enhancement. Initially, a deep neural network undergoes pre-training on a diverse source domain dataset rich in cybersecurity information. This process aims to capture generalized features and knowledge pertaining to a broad spectrum of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. The outline these techniques, such as Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) and adversarial training, both conceptually and mathematically. These three algorithms amalgamate to create a robust transfer learning framework, purpose-built for network security and threat intelligence. This comprehensive approach empowers security practitioners to dynamically adapt and reinforce their defense mechanisms.

articleTitle: Role of Big Data and Machine Learning on Marketing and Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The article discusses the impact of big data and machine learning (ML) on the information technology of the marketing industry as well as the challenges it faces with regard to management of information and data. The analysis found aspects of the sector's digital transformation that have not already been completely covered by consensus academic studies in order to achieve this. Papers spanning five databases have been obtained. Website of Science, Scopus, Research-gate, Emerald, and ProQuest are some examples of collections. 69 papers were chosen for this reviewed literature after 214 articles were screened. Five topics that are highly applicable to the technological age in marketing were highlighted as study gaps in the current literature. Five other prospective areas of further studies in the use of big data and ML-driven solutions in the marketing sector were also suggested. By highlighting areas that require actual investigations, systematisation, follow-up research, affirmation, or the collection of experimental observations, an exploration of the potentials of digitization in branding could be helpful to university scholars as well as practitioner's alike working in the fields of information technologies (IT), information systems (IS), business, & advertising.

articleTitle: DL Based Speech to Text Converter for Audio Visual Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the digital era, Speech recognition and Text conversion has become a prominent research field with numerous applications. The accurate recognition of speech and quick conversion possess number of challenges like accent, mixed words, variation in pronunciation etc. The proposed system leverages the power of machine learning algorithms to accurately recognize speech and convert it into text in real time. The system is trained using the ML modules like speech recognition, moviepy etc. Overall, our work demonstrates the potential of machine learning-based approaches for speech recognition and text conversion and highlights the need for further research in this area to address the challenges and limitations of existing systems.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Deep Learning Ecosystem for Real-Time Cognitive Data Processing on Industrial Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The capacity to manage cognitive data in real time is crucial in the rapidly increasing field of industrial edge computing. This criterion must be fully completed to proceed. Our research resulted in the creation of a new platform dubbed the Dynamic Deep Learning Ecosystem, or DDLE, which strives to achieve these goals. The Deep Learning Edge (DDLE) is a strong architecture that ensures deep learning models run as well as possible on edge devices. The dynamic data-driven learning environment (DDLE) includes approaches such as dynamic model scaling (DMS), edge-based pruning (EBP), and real-time adaptive inference (RAI). The entire goal of the operation is dependent on these algorithms accomplishing all this work. Deep learning models may face dynamic changes in complexity and size if DMS is used. The way these changes are implemented is determined in part by the type of data and the amount of processing capacity presently available. The proposed DDLE has been thoroughly tested, and the results demonstrate that it beats more standard approaches in certain crucial measures, such as accuracy and latency. The findings of this study highlight the necessity of deep learning at the edge as well as the potential benefits of DDLE. Furthermore, it demonstrates that DDLE can be a viable option for businesses looking for a real-time cognitive data processing solution.

articleTitle: GenAI in the Cyber Kill Chain: A Comprehensive Review of Risks, Threat Operative Strategies and Adaptive Defense Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) has become an effective instrument capable of creating realistic content on its own in a variety of fields. GAI's growing adoption raises concerns about potential misuse for cyber threats, such as creating, convincing, phishing emails, producing deep fake videos and distributing false information through posts that appear to be genuine on social media. This is accurate even though its potential uses in data synthesis, virtual assistants, content development and the creative arts are exciting. These difficulties appeal for a careful analysis of GAI's place in cybersecurity (CS). This paper offers a comprehensive analysis of the possible threats connected to the offensive GAI technique used in the Cyber Kill Chain (CKC) framework. In addition, our proposal includes defense tactics that leverage GAI capabilities. These strategies include the areas of detection, deception and adversarial training, with the aim of reducing the potential risks associated with cyber threats induced by GAI. Threat actors employ the use of GAI to augment Evasion, obfuscation and deception techniques, hence increasing the effectiveness and difficulty of detecting their attacks. This study highlights the importance of using proactive defense measures. The dual capability of GAI for legal and illegal usage highlights the need to comprehend and mitigate its influence inside the CKC framework. To combat the evolving gamut of GAI-induced cyber threats, organizations should employ attack-aware and adaptable GAI-enabled defense strategies.

articleTitle: An Approach to Path Conjunction in Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks Founded on Transmission Range Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Due to the constrained communication radius, nodes in an ad hoc network can act as both hosts and routers, and each node asks its neighbour node for assistance in forwarding messages. Finding a precise optimal routing solution is difficult because wireless mobile nodes behave dynamically without infrastructure. Second, load balancing and energy efficiency are issues with the Mobile Ad-Hoc Network (MANET) routing systems now in use. A solution to the issue of maximizing the amount of energy used during transmission is provided using the Transmission Range based Optimal Path (TROP) routing approach. To reduce energy usage while in transmission mode, the TROP routing approach builds the best backbone path based on several criteria. The multi-Criterion technique is built around the periodic estimation of criteria, which takes into account the load distribution during transmission as well as the transmission range and residual energy of an ideal node. In a setting with high mobility, the TROP routing approach applies a scheduling scheme for energy consumption optimization.

articleTitle: Smart Decision Support Framework for Precise Diagnosis of Chronic Odontogenic Rhinosinusitis using U-Net Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The proposed methodology aims to revolutionize the diagnosis of Chronic Odontogenic Rhinosinusitis (CORS) by leveraging advanced artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, with a focus on U-Net segmentation. CORS, characterized by persistent inflammation originating from dental infections affecting paranasal sinuses, presents a complex diagnostic challenge due to its intricate etiology and symptom overlap with conventional rhinosinusitis. This study introduces a Smart Decision Support Framework employing U-Net segmentation, enabling precise and efficient diagnosis. The framework integrates crucial algorithms, Data Preprocessing, U-Net Segmentation Training, and Post-processing forming the backbone of this innovative approach. These algorithms collectively facilitate precise segmentation and diagnosis of Chronic Odontogenic Rhinosinusitis using U-Net segmentation, empowering clinicians to make well-informed diagnostic and treatment decisions.

articleTitle: A Robust Deep Learning Solution for Accurate Sleep Stage Classification Using Continuous Photoplethysmography Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In recent years, there has been a lot of interest in categorizing sleep stages using continuous photoplethysmography, or PPG data. This study presents a powerful deep learning strategy for classifying various sleep stages. The algorithm was trained using PPG data. The proposed solution outperforms current approaches for detecting sleep phases because it employs a three-stage approach that incorporates data preprocessing, feature extraction, and the development of a deep learning model. The model's accuracy and reliability were further evaluated by using expertly annotated sleep phases throughout the validation procedure. The model is successful, according to the study's findings, and has the potential to totally revolutionize the way software for sleep monitoring and analysis is built.

articleTitle: Video Surveillance System with Unattended Objects Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In today's congested public venues like railway stations, airports, and retail centers, security is a major concern. One of the suspicious object detection system's most important jobs is abandoned item detection. Automatically detecting suspicious items and enhancing public security and protection are the algorithm's main goals. We provide a technique for finding abandoned items in safe materials. The need for CCTV research in computer vision science has increased recently. There are several research studies on video surveillance in the literature. The primary aim of this approach is to develop a real-time security model that can recognize suspicious activity. Future incarnations of the device might be used to monitor unusual behavior in public areas instead of the current monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Retail Transformation Through Big Data in Inventory Control and Consumer Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The retail industry is undergoing a significant transformation driven by the utilization of big data. This transformative power enables retailers to gain profound insights into consumer behavior, enhance inventory management practices, and deliver personalized shopping experiences by harnessing and analyzing vast datasets. This research paper emphasizes explicitly the application of big data in two pivotal areas within the retail sector: inventory control and consumer analytics. In consumer analytics, big data empowers retailers to meticulously track consumer preferences, identify patterns, and tailor marketing strategies for more effective customer engagement. Moreover, in inventory management, big data facilitates the precise estimation of demand, optimization of inventory levels, and reduction of stockouts. The paper comprehensively explores the benefits of integrating big data into retail operations while addressing the inherent challenges retailers face during implementation.

articleTitle: Cyber attack Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cyber security professionals look more closely at risk assessment and provide strategies to lower it. The field of cyber defense was created with the intention of creating effective methods. Machine learning has proven efficient in cyber protection, but it has also raised serious privacy concerns. Unprecedented advancements in computing, storage, and computational technologies have led to the fast growth of cloud computing, networking, and evolutionary computation. There is a growing need for comprehensive and sophisticated information security and privacy problems as the globe progressively digitizes. Furthermore, security threat defense strategies are becoming more advanced. The growth in international cyber terrorism is the result of several computer flaws. Global computer security issues including virus detection, ransom ware recognition, fraud detection, and spoofing identification were addressed using machine learning techniques. The analysis of the study examines the use of cyber training for both offensive and defensive objectives, providing details on cyber risks based on machine learning techniques and Machine learning methods that describe how machine learning is used for computer defense, such as the discovery and avoidance of attacks, vulnerability scanning and recognition, and public internet risk assessment, are used to analyze the far more prevalent types of cyber security issues.

articleTitle: An Efficient Design and Implementation of Cervical Cancer Prediction Model using RFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Given its negative effects on women's lives, cervical cancer is one of the most hazardous diseases that affect women. Despite being widespread throughout the world, cervical cancer is easily curable if found in its early stages. Numerous research initiatives have been launched recently to find early-stage cervical cancer and treat it. All those initiatives, however, are quite complex and are not feasible for rural and middle-class women worldwide. Therefore, it is stated that an automated decision support system would be created for the social good and benefit of these rural women by simply verifying their biological data, which is readily accessible in all health and biological centres. This work makes efficient and effective use of the MATLAB2013 tool to implement Data Mining Techniques, particularly for the prediction of Cervical Cancer, which is fully customized and configured in straightforward step-by-step wizards, with all the required and optional parameters. This study elucidates the Random Forest tree (RFT) algorithm and related methods, including data refining techniques such as bagging and boosting, to produce reliable results. After a quick discussion of how the RFT algorithm improves prediction accuracy, each stage is shown via screenshots and explained in detail. Accuracy was calculated by comparing the anticipated values to the actual ones. The output of these created models is then validated using the validation and performance operators. A prediction accuracy of 83.92% has been achieved using the Classification And Regression Tree (CART) algorithm for cervical cancer. For this dataset, our next proposed approach achieves an accuracy of about 93.72% using RFT.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Analysis for Captchas Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Several websites improve their security and avoid dangerous Internet attacks by implementing CAPTCHAs (Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart), a type of verification to identify whether the end-user is human or a robot. The most prevalent type of CAPTCHA is text-based, designed to be easily recognized by humans while being unsolvable towards machines or robots. However, as deep learning technology progresses, development of convolutional neural network (CNN) models that predict text based CAPTCHAs becomes easier. The purpose of this research is to investigate the flaws and vulnerabilities in the CAPTCHA generating systems in order to design more resilient CAPTCHAs. To achieve this, we created CapNet, a Convolutional Neural Network. The proposed platform can evaluate both numerical and alphanumerical CAPTCHAs.

articleTitle: Enhanced Social Media Profile Authenticity Detection Using Machine Learning Models and Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Fake engagement is one of the main issues with online networks or ONSs, which are used to artificially boost an account's popularity, this study examines the effectiveness of seven sophisticated Machine Learning Algorithms, Random Forest Classifier, Decision Tree Classifier, XGBoost, LightGBM, Extra Trees Classifier, and SVM, and got 93% accuracy in Decision Tree Classifier. In order to solve overfitting issues and improve model resilience, the paper proposes Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and uses K-Fold Cross-Validation. Furthermore, design a Gan-ANN model that combines Batch Normalization and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) with GAN-generated synthetic data is investigated. The enhanced dataset seeks to strengthen model performance and generalization when combined with cutting-edge modeling methods. This study aims to improve model scalability, predictive accuracy, and dependability across different machine learning paradigms.

articleTitle: An Operative Investigation of ML Methods for Image Retrieval with MPKDC-Based Brain Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Processing images is crucial in making judgements based on a wide range of criteria. Image processing techniques include enhancing, restoring, and compressing photos all help save space in the long run. Segmentation is a crucial stage that plays a significant role in every aspect of the image processing workflow. When assessing medical images, image segmentation-based improvement techniques are frequently used. This work proposes a unique MPKDC method for determining which hypoechoic areas in a brain imaging are most likely to contain a tumor. The proposed algorithm can help the radiologist determine what areas need to be scanned using MRI for diagnostic purposes. Multimodal Brain Tumor Image Segmentation datasets were used to evaluate the proposed method. This dataset includes 220 high-quality brain tumor images and 54 low-quality tumor images. Promising efficiency of the suggested segmentation methodology was demonstrated via cross-validation of the succeeding methods.

articleTitle: An Effective Statistics Investigation for the Structured Healthcare using Reasonable Ensemble Machine Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Due to its rapid expansion, healthcare data has gained widespread attention in today's data-driven society. There are both structured and unstructured representations. In order to provide patients with individualised care, the healthcare industry now needs to analyse both structured and unstructured data. This study explains the basics of ensemble learning for categorization projects. Disease classification through organised healthcare analysis is the main topic here. Two stages are proposed in this section: The proposed competitive feature selection model was introduced in phase one. It takes datasets and determines which features are most useful. In the second stage, an aggressive ensemble classification model was proposed. It is made up of a number of distinct classifiers that compete with one another to determine which is best for each individual data set. These two steps enhance the categorization efficiency of structured healthcare data. The planned work was essential in pinpointing the best qualities to prioritise. The proposed competitive ensemble classification model outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches, as demonstrated by extensive experimental findings on a variety of datasets.

articleTitle: Automated Eco-Friendly Sanitary Napkin Incinerator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: An eco-friendly mechanism for disposing of sanitary waste is proposed by the current invention. Sensors, a microcontroller, and an incinerator make up the system. When operated by the microcontroller, the incinerator is set to accept an input signal from an IR Sensor installed inside a dispensing inlet. while it is being controlled by a microcontroller, which is where sanitary waste is distributed. Following that, an input line transports this sanitary waste to a burning chamber. To burn sanitary waste and produce gases and ash, which are then expelled through chimneys and collected in ashtrays, respectively, the waste is placed in a burning chamber. The use of UV light, charcoal, and cotton in chimneys helps to cut down on the discharge of odor-causing gases as well as carbon dioxide.

Author Keywords: sanitary waste are some related terms

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Dynamic Analysis Tools and Honeypots for Inspecting Android Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Android applications are software components that are used to perform tasks such as messaging, calling, social networking, banking, trading, capturing photos and videos, etc on Android devices. Android users use a variety of such applications on their mobile devices as per the requirement. Android developers and security researchers can use certain tools to understand and analyse the dynamic behaviour of Android applications without installing them on real Android devices. This paper focuses on the detailed study of dynamic analysis tools and honeypots for inspecting the behaviour of Android applications either on a simulation environment or a real Android device. This paper will help Android developers and security researchers to select the appropriate tools based on the necessity of inspection.

articleTitle: Penetration of InsurTech Replacing Traditional Insurance Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rise of Insurtech, a blend of insurance and technology, has triggered a digital revolution in the insurance sector. The new product development, underwriting, delivery, and administration of insurance products will be transformed by this progress, which uses cutting-edge technologies like blockchain, the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence, and data analytics. In the era of smartphones and on-demand services, insurtech businesses are addressing the desire for straightforward, digital insurance solutions and enhancing consumer experiences. Big data and machine learning are used by insurtech to improve security and fraud detection in an increasingly digital environment while also enabling more accurate risk assessment, fair rates, and better overall risk management.

articleTitle: A Critical Study of ICT Oriented Innovations based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) Applications towards BFSI Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Financial Service and Insurers (BFSI) sector refers to firms who provide a wide variety of accounting products and assistance across the world. This work adds to the technical innovation of services in processing administration, a topic that has yet to be settled in the available research. AI is an interdisciplinary field of study that has distinguished itself for the technical dynamism it brings to an organization products and processes. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the developing technologies driving the continued expansion of ICT-enabled applications. This study investigates the application of the use of AI and machine learning (ML), respectively, in the field of banking, as well as the policy ramifications. It grants a nontechnical foundation to understand the growth and possibilities of AI/ML systems. Artificial intelligence, or the emulation of human brain in machines, is gaining popularity and will play an important role in the new financial century. The current study aims to examine consumers' perspectives on the widespread implementation of intelligent systems with artificial intelligence in Asian countries. The banking industry also prioritizes novel AI technology to boost customer service and overall growth by making greater revenue.

articleTitle: New Decision-Making Process Based on Set Theory: Towards Application of Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Generating consistent and appropriate choices is essential for any decision-making process that deals with ambiguity or uncertainty. Throughout history, various mathematicians have devised distinct methodologies for resolving decision-making problems. This study presents a novel approach, referred to as the Decision-Making Process Algorithm (DMPA), that is grounded in the principles of set theory. The objective of this technique is to enhance the process of resolving decision-making problems. To illustrate the mathematical process, we will address two problems. The first concern is about the availability of different brands of a specific product, each having equally important distinct features. The second issue pertains to medical diagnosis and the handling of uncertainty. The Decision-Making Process Algorithm (DMPA) is based on the principle of a co-evolutionary algorithm that is specifically designed to handle non-linear constraints. In the field of co-optimization, it is necessary to tackle challenges that are not commonly encountered in traditional optimization methods. The paper presents the findings of the Decision-Making Process Algorithm (DMPA), which suggests that the algorithm is highly effective in tackling real-world problems. This is supported by the successful implementation of the algorithm in two separate case studies. The first case study involved the selection of a specific product variety or brand, while the second case study focused on the management of uncertainty in medical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Railway Track Crack Detection Using IoT Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Railway transportation is one of the most used means of transportation in India and many other countries, as large number of people use rail for transportation everyday, safety of the passengers is one of the important goals to be met. The railway department is still in its growing phase so; there are few issues to be focused on. Some of them are, is to reduce the number of accidents that occur due to derail and crack in the track. In this paper, we are building a IoT based model to detect crack using Arduino and IR sensor, once the crack is found, the location of the crack will be fetched with the help of GPS using GSM module, a message will be sent to the railway authorities’ registered mobile number about the crack being found, along with the location of the crack in the form of a Google maps link. This model will be fixed on to railway track maintenance vehicle which run independent of train. This model is built to be simple as it operates outdoors.

articleTitle: EEG Signals Acquisition and Processing of Mental Tasks for Controlling Smart Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: With the help of this biosignal, we can create various kinds of interfaces. These interfaces were especially used for paralyzed individuals who have problems in the normal bio-sensor channels. Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals play a vital role in semi-paralyzed and fully paralyzed individuals to make communication with their caretakers. EEG signals are used not only for paralyzed individuals, nowadays most of home appliances are designed due to their reliability and accuracy. EEG based Smart devices are very easy to operate because signals are generated by the human brain automatically whenever the task is performed by humans. Through this research, we discussed the basic methodology needed for interfacing the EEG signals with smart devices. From this paper, most of the researchers will be going to know how to connect the EEG signals with the smart systems to control the external devices and induce the researchers to apply the EEG signals in real time.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Proposition Abstraction from Domain Text for Conceptual Plan Mining Using Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Summarization is a perfect example of one of the numerous text mining jobs that may be improved with concept maps. A broad idea map illuminates the connections between the numerous thoughts being mapped. This article describes an evaluation technique designed with tokenization, proposition extraction, and refining in mind. The Deep Tokenizer approach, which is based on deep learning principles, has a processing time of 5 milliseconds and a tokenization accuracy of 98%. The extraction accuracy with the given proposition extractor approach was 95%, and the processing time was 10 milliseconds. The program was modified specifically to extract propositions from tokenized text. The suggested proposition refiner technique was proven to have a refining accuracy of 94% and a processing time of 8 milliseconds. The goal of this strategy was to back up and enhance the ideas derived from the data. Bar charts were used to graphically show the performance statistics of the various algorithms. These findings indicate the techniques' usefulness and reliability in dealing with large text datasets, shedding light on possible applications in natural language processing.

articleTitle: Air Mobility Network Resilience: An Innovative Microchained Fabric Solution with Focus on Assurance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Urban Air Mobility (UAM) represents a revolutionary shift in contemporary transportation, offering a promising solution to the ever-growing urban congestion. However, the integration of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) into urban environments introduces unique challenges, especially concerning data security and anomaly detection. This paper introduces two groundbreaking algorithms designed to address these challenges. Through a comprehensive analysis, we demonstrate the efficacy of these algorithms in ensuring robust data security and efficient anomaly detection within the UAM network. The proposed methods, backed by mathematical representations and real-world testing, outperform traditional methods, paving the way for a safer and more efficient UAM ecosystem.

articleTitle: The Role of Hyperparameter Tuning and Feature Engineering in Enhancing Machine Learning Models for Crop Disease Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Crop diseases, according to this abstract, represent a severe danger to both food availability and worldwide agricultural practices. To address the critical need for more effective methods of agricultural disease analysis, this study employs cutting-edge machine learning tools such as feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning. The need for these methods has increased in recent years. The recommended method, which employs Random Forest, XGBoost, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), can be utilized to improve disease detection in agricultural contexts. This study found that the novel technique surpasses standard ones in terms of processing efficiency, area under the curve (AUC), recall, accuracy, and precision. Furthermore, in terms of precision and accuracy, the novel method exceeds the previous methods. These results will have a significant impact on precision farming and environmentally conscious agriculture. This study compared several performance metrics, including accuracy, precision, recalls, F1-scores, AUCs, and computation efficiency. All these factors were considered. The results demonstrate beyond a shadow of a doubt that the technique we advocate is the best in terms of the metrics considered. Our methods outperform the industry standard in terms of accuracy and precision (95% and 92%, respectively).

articleTitle: The Transformative Influence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on Financial Organizations Worldwide
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Artificial intelligence and the banking industry complement one other well. Working in an industry where practically every participant adheres to a logic that tries to maximize profits, it is challenging to resist the norm of using speedy calculations, extensive data processing, and precise estimates. Due to the strict mathematical limits placed on making financial assessments, the question of why financial markets still require human interaction arises frequently and the answer to it is for making financial decisions, which are governed by these mathematical limits and to overcome it the use of artificial intelligence (AI) has been necessary and also acts as remedy in both computational and other types of errors in finance sector. Thus from that time AI is used in financial industries. The introduction of digital technology has its own pros and cons. Financial organizations, such as insurers, are either investing billions of dollars to buy data from other industries or developing their own AI capabilities to support the growth of their businesses. Business models based on AI have recently grown, and this trend is expected to continue. In some financial industries, artificial intelligence is unavoidable. It is global in scope.

articleTitle: A Review of Adversarial Machine Learning for Cyber security in Intelligent Systems using Image Classification & Signal Classification Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Machine learning models with adversarial examples must be trained to differentiate between genuine and invading data. Cyber computing technology and tools face huge intrusion attacks and malicious programs. Tampered QR code for online payments, malicious face and biometric detection, incorrect facial recognition, object and sign detection are the adversarial examples in real-life scenarios. Convolutional neural networks often fail to image classification tasks due to high vulnerability. The Intelligent systems comprising computer vision, self-driving cars, radio signals, IoT Devices, industrial production and automation are prone to cyber attack with adversarial data in machine learning models. The goal of this paper is to summarize the various Convolutional Neural Network models and Recurrent Neural Network approaches used in machine learning for malicious image classification. The analysis aims to identify the area of attacks using adversarial machine learning in cyber physical systems and intrusion detection systems.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Hindi Fake News Detection Model Using Machine Learning
