publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The current society we live in is marked by fast change, which brings with it a variety of obstacles that, when taken together; make it difficult for people to live their lives. The discussion that we are having right now focuses on the single most essential problem, which is fake news. The term “fake news” refers to a kind of propaganda or a problem that may include incorrect information and is often distributed through the media. The word itself comes from the English phrase “fake news.” This encompasses not just the internet but also more conventional kinds of media, such as television, newspapers, and even smart phones, to name a few examples. In the society we live in today, where there is an abundance of social media networks, a large number of people are seeking to develop and share information, yet the vast majority of it is pointless and has little bearing on real-world issues. This misleading news is the major driving force behind the dissemination of various different political and commercial purposes. Those aims include: It is now becoming more difficult to differentiate between genuine news and actual news as a direct result of the proliferation of the internet world. In an effort to find a solution to the problem of fake news, we have been putting a lot of effort into developing the idea of a “False news detecting system.” This system integrates a large number of news articles written in Hindi that have been obtained from a wide range of sources.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Obstacle Avoiding Robot with Ultrasonic Sensors and Motor Functions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A simple robotics project simulated in Tinkercad based on Arduino Uno. It uses ultrasonic sensors for obstacle detection and can do basic movements using DC motors. The primary objective of this project is to develop an autonomous robot capable of navigating an environment while detecting and avoiding obstacles in its path. The robot utilizes ultrasonic sensors to measure distances and determine the presence of obstacles, employing an Arduino microcontroller to process sensor data and make real-time decisions. Motor functions are coordinated through the Arduino to enable dynamic movement and obstacle avoidance strategies. This project serves as a foundational framework for developing intelligent, obstacle-avoiding robotic systems using readily available components and open-source platforms like Arduino. By Using Tinkercad, it offers a virtual workspace where you can design circuits using Arduino boards, ultrasonic sensors, motor drivers, and other electronic components. You can drag and drop components onto a virtual breadboard, connect them using wires, and simulate the connections and interactions between the components.

articleTitle: An Advancement in a Prediction Model for Cervical Cancer Using the Cart Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Everyone, but especially women, should get regular health checks if they want to live long and happy lives. Even today, despite the fact that women have access to a lot of medical care and enjoy a high level of social standing, many of them still pass away for a variety of factors that neither they nor their loved ones are aware of. This demonstrates how little women are aware of their health's potential and regular examinations. Women are more susceptible to some of the deadliest diseases simply because they are more thoughtless and ignorant. One such terrible illness is cancer and cervix cancer. This study focuses on the data mining techniques used with biological data to accurately forecast the development of cancer cells known as malignant tumors in women's cervical tissues. Accurate results for cervical cancer are investigated using several data mining algorithms, including CART, SVM, and C4.5. The primary goal is to enhance the effectiveness of cancer cell prediction and raise the precision of the results. The obtained prediction performances are on par with those of current methods. Experiment results show that CART is the most effective algorithm for predicting the presence of Cervical Cancer cells, a novel area of research. To help researchers choose the most effective algorithm, we give predictions of the accuracy levels of a number of different algorithms based on their sensitivity, specificity, and F-Score.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease MRI Image Segmentation Based on the Enhanced U-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The most widespread form of dementia for which there is still no cure is Alzheimer's disease (AD). Choosing the best treatment options for AD can be aided by an accurate classification of the disease. Several studies from the past ten years have demonstrated the value of deep learning algorithms for diagnosing AD. In this study, we suggest a U-net style model for the diagnosis of AD utilising 3D T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). In this study, the Alzheimer is segmented from 2D brain scans using a U-Net Convolutional Network-based method. The first U-Net design executes a series of convolutional operations with a filter size of 3*3. In this paper we have used techiques of hybrid pooling. So instead of using max pooling we have used mixing of minimum pooling and average pooling. The updated architecture, which outperforms the original U-Net model clearly, was seen to obtain an admirable performance rate of 91.23%.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis of Application of Artificial Intelligence in Heart Disease: 2013 to 2023
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The use of cutting-edge technologies in healthcare evolves continuously. Artificial intelligence offers a wide range of applications in the diagnosis, detection, or early prediction of many diseases. This research work was conducted to outline the current research directions in the area of artificial intelligence applications for cardiac disease. The various bibliometric analysis approaches are used between 2013 and 2023 to evaluate the potential for research in the field of applications of artificial intelligence in heart disease. Initially, search strategy 1 was used to retrieve 1128845 papers, while search strategy 2 was used to retrieve 581739 papers. Finally, the AND operator was used to combine search strategies 1 and 2 to include 50196 publications that perfectly matched our objectives. This research work found that: (1) The number of publications in the field of application of Artificial Intelligence in Heart Disease increased exponentially; (2) there is 33440 groups or organisation involved out of it 242 has at least 5 research publications; (3) There is 16187 keywords available with this research topic.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Recurrent Neural Network with Biomimic Components
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In order to improve the energy efficiency and computational capacity of our data processing systems, bioinspired, or neuromorphic, computing draws inspiration from how the brain computes. Emulation of natural systems, patterns, and components is known as biomimetics or biomimicry, and it is done to address challenging challenges in society. The term “spintronics” refers to the application of a fundamental property of particles (the spin of an electron) known as the spin to information processing. Hopfield was the first to establish a direct connection between physical models and neural networks. To learn any of these models, the neural network must be able to adjust the coupling between each pair of spins. To implement multi-layer perceptron (neural network) structures, current technologies, however, have necessitated the extensive usage of complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) devices, which raises the perceptron's complexity of manufacture, space need, and power consumption. In this paper, it is suggested that the first trainable CMOS-free recurrent neural network with biomimetic components can be built using biomimetic neurons made of domain wall-magnetic tunnel junctions. This analysis shows how well this system performs computationally on benchmark tasks and how much more efficiently it performs computationally than alternative recurrent neural network systems.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurship and Innovation in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: A Blockchain Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The continuous development of entrepreneurship and the most recent Artificial Intelligence (AI) enable many new business practices to be strengthened by the potential to generate novel forms of partnership. Such evolving innovation aids in the delivery of branded assistance as well as certain novel business communications with clients and employees. AI digitalization has highlighted the importance of companies focusing on current tactics while also exploring novel market potential on a frequent and timely basis. While virtual innovation study in the context of corporate innovation is acquiring traction, Blockchain can ensure confidentiality of information. As a result, in this study, Entrepreneurship and Innovation depending on AI and Blockchain Approach (EI-AIBA) is offered to improve company practices and preserve safe interactions among different customers. The qualitative scientific information was gathered from a small number of primary participants from 2 diverse business areas. EI-AIBA has been examined by investigating the differences and parallels in the influence of technological advancement on value growth, suggestion, and business acquisition. Blockchain approach may assist with business capacity and employee skill communication concerns. The outcomes of the trial indicate that digitization is widely accepted as necessary and helps entrepreneurship and innovation initiatives. The suggested EI-AIBA computational findings increase the demand prediction proportion (97.1%), goods quality proportion (98.3%), business growth proportion (98.9%), customer conduct assessment proportion (96.3%), and customer contentment proportion (97.2%).

articleTitle: Neural Network Solutions for Advanced Persistent Threat Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the last few years, persistent and deceitful attacks have emerged. These attacks, often known as advanced persistent threats, or APTs, pose a severe challenge to the present security architecture. The term APTs was coined to offer a more accurate explanation of the many sorts of attacks. The word “assaults” can also be interpreted to signify APT in its closest sense. Using neural network architecture, we provide a unique technique for identifying and analyzing APTs. This technique may be beneficial in identifying and evaluating APTs. The authors of the study provided a substantial quantity of evidence to support the validity of the procedures they detailed. To discover and comprehend data anomalies, a multi-level architecture based on recurrent neural networks (RNNs), convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and attention processes may be employed. This makes the system more resistant to such assaults. An attention mechanism was introduced to the model's third layer to improve the system's sensitivity to irregularities. By focusing on certain parts of the input data, this method assists the network in identifying suspicious patterns and behaviors that may be related to an advanced persistent threat.

articleTitle: Evaluative Analysis of Secure approaches in Simulated Real-World Contexts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel methodological approach to evaluating security measures within simulated real-world contexts. By leveraging three distinct algorithms Vulnerability Scoring Algorithm (VSA), the Attack Simulation Algorithm (ASA), and the Impact Assessment Algorithm (IAA) this provides an exhaustive analysis of potential vulnerabilities, simulate cyberattacks based on these vulnerabilities, and gauge the consequences of successful breaches. The Proposed method's foundational algorithm, VSA, quantifies vulnerabilities' severity, whereas ASA simulates realistic attacks and calculates the likelihood of their success. Lastly, the IAA assesses the potential impact of successful attacks. Collectively, these algorithms offer a rigorous and holistic evaluation of security measures. The findings visualized and underscored the superior performance of our proposed method compared to traditional approaches. This research contributes a valuable tool set for organizations seeking to fortify their security posture in an ever-evolving threat landscape.

articleTitle: A Framework to Predict the Value of Cryptocurrencies Using the Decision Tree and Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Investors are increasingly interested in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin. In this paper, we investigate how to make accurate Bitcoin price predictions by analysing a number of factors that affect that price. As a first order of business, our research tracks and identifies an ongoing price trend in Bitcoin's day-to-day fluctuations. Data is taken up to the present day, including the opening, closing, and all points in between prices for Bitcoin. We offer a machine learning module that uses the dataset to make price predictions. The purpose of this research is to compare the predictive abilities of several machine learning algorithms for predicting Bitcoin values. Both the decision tree and the regression model are compared to experimental results.

articleTitle: An effective Convex-Hull Founded Borderline Recognition in Unattended Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: An Unattended Wireless Sensor Network (UWSN) is made up of battery-operated sensor nodes that function under difficult conditions with little assistance from humans. Unattended WSNs are employed in a variety of applications, including monitoring volcanoes, military surveillance, and extreme environmental monitoring. Because event-based UWSN apps generate dynamic traffic, the network becomes congested, uses a lot of energy, and has malicious nodes present, which makes it perform poorly. Therefore, it is crucial to conduct research into developing an energy-efficient and dependable self-management framework that adapts dynamically to changes in network conditions. To assess the network's level of coverage, the borderline information is helpful. In the static sink scenario, the borderline nodes (or convex nodes) are employed as a backup path when there is a high load. The energy-aware convex hull method is used to identify the borderline nodes. Convex-hull procedures that are presented in three different forms: centralized method, distributed approach, and mobile sink approach. The application situation and deployment environment for the sensor network affect the algorithm's applicability. Borderline nodes have a variety of uses. The borderline nodes determine the coverage region of a network. The borderline nodes in a network with a static sink scenario are used to forward data when there is a high volume of traffic.

articleTitle: Using Artificial Intelligence to Track and Predict Student Performance in Degree Programmes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Predicting learners' prospective performance depending on their current educational data is critical for implementing appropriate educational measures for guaranteeing learners' timely and acceptable graduation. Though there is a large body of research on predicting students’ performance when resolving issues or preparing for classes employing statistical methods, predicting students’ performance when finishing degrees is a new area of research. Techniques enable machines to arrive at judgements for humans in artificial intelligence (AI). This technology improves the consumer encounter in a variety of manners. Numerous research in the realm of education were undertaken to address the issue of learner focus and performance employing different Machine Learning (ML) methods. We demonstrate that the suggested technique outperforms standard methods in extended simulations on an undergraduate learner database gathered over a 3-year period at UCLA.

articleTitle: Better Utilization of NDFA Over DFA with the Existing Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Non-deterministic Finite-Automata (NDFA) and Deterministic-Finite-Automata (DFA) are fundamental computational models with different characteristics. This paper is inclined towards assessing and presenting gripping evidences for the utilization of NDFA over DFA in various domains. We analyzed studies and practical cases where NDFA outperforms DFA, radiating light on the practical advantages of NDFA in terms of computational efficiency. This aims to provide an extensive review of the benefits of NDFA in comparison to DFA, facilitating important decisions when selecting the appropriate automaton for specific computing tasks.

articleTitle: Smart Ticketing and Overcrowding Control System for Public Transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Conventional ticketing procedures limit the potential revolutionary effects of public transport. In order to overcome these restrictions, the Smart Ticketing and Overcrowding Control System for Public Transportation presented in this study ingeniously combines RFID and GSM technology. Despite their ease, the current ticketing systems struggle with high costs, interoperability problems, and privacy difficulties. In addition to negatively affecting passenger satisfaction and transportation efficiency, overcrowding. The suggested solution makes use of smart cards with RFID tags to enable quick, con-tactless ticket confirmation. Integration with GSM technology enables real-time communication for tariff calculation and fast ticket confirmation. RFID readers, GSM modems, Arduino micro-controllers, LCD displays, and a crowded control system are all included in the architecture. Through testing, the equipment exhibits notable results. Without paper tickets or manual checks, passengers get seamless ticket validation, which improves convenience. Reduced ticket fraud and improved revenue collection are advantageous to the transportation authority. The technology offers transportation authorities useful data insights for streamlining schedules, fares, and routes. Real-time monitoring provided by the technology enables early overcrowding identification and prevention, protecting the security and comfort of passengers.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Role of ICT in Digitalization of Banking Financial Services & Insurance Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The biggest issue that the banking and banking sector is currently facing is the modernization of banks. In this technological shift process, banks run into with ground-breaking disruptive technologies that need the adaptation of practically all collaboration tactics. In the financial industry, the rise of technology is associated with roadblocks that appear to obstruct the seamless use of digital solutions. In the future, these new financial technologies will certainly bring fresh ideas to the financial sectors and a dramatic shift in the way conventional finance is conducted. The issues they cause ought to be addressed as well. The technology network would bring both the city and rural worlds together under the banner of ecologically sound development, ensuring all social aspects informed. Nations that implement an in-depth plan will be fortunate to give their population with equal growth as well as an efficient, environmentally conscious, and digital living. Digital transformation has transformed several industries, particularly the banking business, by improving efficacy, customer experience, and use. This paper examines previous research and examines the influence of digital evolution on bank performance, with an emphasis on growth acceleration. To help the banking industry make the most of digital developments for the future, we have compiled some suggestions. The banking industry's use of IT is the focus of the uncovered study. The study accounts for by providing information on the advantages and disadvantages of implementing technology advances in interaction and knowledge sharing in the present setting of India's banking business.

articleTitle: Automated Malware Classification Using Deep Learning Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Automated classification may significantly reduce the time it takes to discover and remove malware. This paper suggests a detailed method for automating the classification of malware using deep learning neural networks. The three main techniques at the core of the approach are: data preprocessing and feature extraction; neural network model development; training and assessment. Data preprocessing includes cleaning and organizing the raw malware dataset as well as feature extraction using n-grams, opcode sequences, API call sequences, and byte-level n-grams. The collected features are then used to construct a deep learning neural network model including convolutional, recurrent, and fully connected layers. Once the model has been trained on a labeled dataset, performance measures like accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, false positive rate, and false negative rate are used to evaluate the model's effectiveness. The new method, called “DeepMal,” performs remarkably well when measured against traditional methods for finding malware.

articleTitle: Analyzing Customer Sentiments in Genshin Impact: A Business Intelligence Perspective on Player Perception
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Customer perception plays a pivotal role in determining the success of a game in the competitive market landscape. It encompasses how players perceive various aspects of the game, including its mechanics, visuals, story, character design, and overall experiential quality. In data analysis, sentiment analysis has emerged as a powerful tool for gaining valuable insights into customer perception. This research aims to employ sophisticated sentiment analysis techniques to understand customer perception in the context of Genshin Impact comprehensively. Through sentiment analysis, this study explores the intricate relationship between customer perception and player sentiments expressed concerning Genshin Impact. An analysis of categorized tweets reveals significant sentiment patterns associated with using specific words. Negative sentiment is observed in tweets containing words such as “lazy,” “retired,” “uninstalled,” and “sad,” indicating the presence of unfavorable content. Conversely, positive sentiment is associated with words like “play,” which holds the highest frequency in positive keywords. Genshin Impact players use this term to express their enjoyment and satisfaction from engaging with the game. Additional positive keywords include “interesting,” “funny,” “gacha” (a term related to acquiring characters in the game), “lore,” and “characters.” By leveraging sentiment analysis techniques, this research contributes to a comprehensive understanding of customer perception in Genshin Impact. The findings shed light on the prevailing sentiments of players and provide insights into the factors contributing to positive and negative perceptions of the game.

articleTitle: Ensuring Web Application Quality: The Role of Software Testing as a Form of Quality Assurance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Software quality is a precise characteristic that identifies the characteristics that every software should have. Quality is the primary determinant of the success or failure of a software project and a software-related company. Software quality has been the subject of several studies. To produce high-quality software, organizations involved in the software industry adhere to requirements set out by Capability Maturity Model Integration. Software Quality Assurance, Software Quality Plans, and Software Quality Control are the three key levels that make up quality. Therefore, in this research, we'll talk about the concepts and quality standards that are applied to software projects in the Bangalore software industry, as well as how these standards are monitored and maintained. We will examine how many software companies use the CMMI guidelines while producing software in this research. How many companies evaluate the quality of their initiatives, and how many are meeting international standards. The discoveries exhibit that specific organizations in Bangalore are utilizing software quality assurance strategies.

articleTitle: Toxicity Tweet Detection and Classification Using NLP Driven Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The use of social media is increasing regularly. Unethical things like defamation, spreading hatred, pornography, etc are becoming easier for some irresponsible users because of the easy accessing and due to similarity of social media. In this view, this study has been carried out to use machine learning techniques to classify comments into their hazardous categories. In order to categorize a comment based on its toxicity, this research compares classic machine learning methods with deep learning methods including Logistic Regression, SVM, RNN, and LSTM. To compare the performance of the models, four distinct models are developed, put into use, and trained on a common dataset. These models were developed and evaluated using sizable amounts of secondary qualitative data that included several comments that were either labeled as harmful or not. Results showed that employing LSTM, a satisfactory accuracy of 90.7% and an F1- score of 0.94 were obtained.

articleTitle: Investigating the Temporal and Spatial Dynamics in Graph Data for Enhancing Accuracy in Traffic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: For In this study, we present a comprehensive methodology for traffic prediction that seamlessly integrates linear time series analysis, deep learning techniques, and attention mechanisms. This multifaceted approach is elucidated through three meticulously designed flowcharts, each elucidating a distinct facet of the prediction process. Commencing with the collection of traffic data, it proceeds through a cascade of methods including autoregressive modeling and variational autoregressive techniques. The journey culminates with the application of Support Vector Regression (SVR) and k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithms. Utilization of deep learning methodologies for traffic prediction. This segment emphasizes the importance of acquiring both spatial and temporal traffic data to encapsulate intricate spatiotemporal patterns. Preprocessing procedures are introduced to make the data amenable to deep learning, encompassing normalization, handling missing values, and data transformation. The application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is central to this approach, facilitating the capture of spatial patterns, such as traffic congestion. Furthermore, the integration of ST-ResNet with residual convolution units and the employment of 3D-CNNs for time-space correlations enhance the model's capabilities. The attention process commences by defining queries, keys, and values, followed by the adaptive weighting mechanism. Subsequently, self-attention is integrated, and the Transformer model, renowned for sequence modeling, is harnessed. The comprehensive methodology we present here stands as a robust and adaptable framework for traffic prediction. Its versatility is exemplified through rigorous experimentation, where it consistently outperforms six traditional methods. These empirical results demonstrate the superior predictive capacity of our ‘Deep Learning Model,’ reinforcing its viability for real-world traffic prediction tasks.

articleTitle: Optimizing Drug Dosage and Medication Management for Geriatric Patients with Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this paper, we utilize ANNs to investigate how medicine dosing and management might be improved for the elderly population. The suggested strategy calls for the use of patient-specific data as inputs for the ANNs, such as age, renal and hepatic function, body mass index, and preexisting prescription profiles. The neural network model dynamically changes drug doses using the combination of the Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) algorithm, Backpropagation, and the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) algorithm to maximize therapeutic benefits and reduce the likelihood of adverse drug events. The research highlights the improved accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, and F1 score of the suggested technique compared to numerous conventional methods. As a result, the suggested system has great potential to revolutionize medication management for the elderly population since it is more personalized, flexible, patient-safe, effective, and efficient in its use of resources.

articleTitle: Sensor-Based Networks and the Internet of an Everything Solutions and Difficulties
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Using Cisco Packet Tracer as a modelling tool, this research study investigates the manner in which sensor-based networks and the Internet of Everything (IoE) might function together. It describes a thorough technique for creating network topologies, setting up devices, establishing connectivity, monitoring data, putting security measures in place, diagnosing issues, as well as assessing outcomes. When assessing the behavior and difficulties of sensor-based networks and IoE, a controlled realistic environment is intended. This study bridges the theoretical and practical implementation gaps by employing Packet Tracer, providing insightful information about the actual uses of these game-changing technologies. Future scopes will include upcoming technologies like 6G and edge computing as well as broaden simulations to accommodate more complicated situations.

articleTitle: An Improved Design of 6G Microstrip Patch Antenna with a High Reflection Coefficient and Working Frequency of 5.8 GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The 6th Generation (6G) network, which is the following generation of wireless communication technology after the 5G network, will be coming soon to India. As 6G is still in research stage and development stage the exact details are not yet confirmed. Yet, it is anticipated that the 6G antennas will be able to support significantly higher frequency bands than the 5G antennas, with frequencies up to 1 THz or more, based on the present understanding of 6G technology. New antenna technologies must be created in order to operate at these high frequencies and support high-speed data transfer rates. This paper proposes an improved design of a 6G microstrip patch antenna using Microsoft CST Studio Suite<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>with a high reflection coefficient and a working frequency of 5.8 GHz. It is a miniature antenna with whole component dimensions as small as 2.5cm x 2.5cm x 2cm. This antenna can be used for various 6G applications as it gives us good radiation values, a very high reflection coefficient <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> value as well as a good far-field <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> result. The antenna is implemented using various layers such as the patch, inset, feedline, lossy substrate and a ground plane.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Oncology: A Critical Review of Artificial Intelligence and Stem Cells in Cancer Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cancer continues to be a leading cause of death globally, accounting for approximately 10 million fatalities in 2020 alone. Amid this public health crisis, innovations in oncology have heralded unprecedented advancements in patient care and therapeutic efficacy. Two such groundbreaking innovations are Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Stem Cell Research. This review critically examines the integration of AI technologies and stem cell therapies in revolutionizing the field of oncology. While AI algorithms have demonstrated the capability to improve early cancer detection rates by 20–30%, stem cell treatments show promise in elevating remission rates and potentially curing certain types of cancer. Despite these advantages, ethical considerations and data reliability pose challenges to widespread adoption. This paper synthesizes data from over 30 peer-reviewed articles, clinical studies, and medical reports to provide a comprehensive analysis of current practices, limitations, and future directions in the convergence of AI and stem cell technologies for cancer treatment.

articleTitle: An Analytical Study of Global Wild Fires
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Wild fires are highly destructive to life and property even in the most advanced nations in the world. This paper analyzes the characteristic features of wild fires across the globe with some important parameters and looks at some intelligent, software assisted methodologies for prevention and mitigation.

articleTitle: Utilization of Emerging IoT Based Alert System for Accident Prevention and Rash Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The issue of rash driving has persisted over the past ten years, endangering the safety of both passengers and the general public. A separate study from Times of India claims that approximately 90% of all fatal road accidents are caused by rash driving. According to the Gulf News article, there have been nearly 2.15 lakh documented incidences of rash driving and road rage in India in 2021 alone. Therefore, it becomes very essential to keep an eye on and manage instances of reckless driving in order to avoid any casualties. The research work “Accident Prevention and Rash Driving Alert System” addresses the first aspect of the issue by identifying and notifying incidents of rash driving and informing the appropriate parties

articleTitle: IOT - Based Smart Environmental Monitoring for Oyster Mushroom (Pleurotus ostreatus) Production
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The smart environmental monitoring system for oyster mushroom production presented in this paper uses an Arduino microcontroller and the Internet of Things (IoT). These Internet of Things (IoT) sensors track changes in temperature and humidity and transmit the information to the Arduino microcontroller, which configures the control algorithm. The simplest mushrooms to grow are oyster mushrooms (Pleurotus ostreatus), which can be produced from a variety of agricultural waste materials. The system was developed using the Iterative and Incremental model. The process primarily encompasses seven key stages: (1) planning, (2) requirements gathering, (3) analysis and design, (4) coding, (5) implementation, (6) testing, and (7) deployment. Based on the moisture content of the soil media learned from the moisture content sensor, the misting system can automatically control the water pumping system on the site. Misting is the most effective and popular method for achieving good propagation; a balance between transpiration and humidity is required to allow water and nutrient uptake without excessive dehydration, especially in the case of mushroom culture. Bacteria may develop if the growing medium is also completely saturated with water. The findings indicated that the temperature within the cultivation facility was consistently kept within the optimal range of 20 �C�30 �C. Given the inverse relationship between humidity and temperature, it was inferred that the ideal humidity levels were likewise upheld. The misting system was primarily implemented to regulate the temperature within the grow room. Its purpose was to cool the environment by automatically activating when the temperature exceeded 30 �C. Once the temperature and humidity sensors detect a reading of 30 �C, the misting system is triggered to activate. This is achieved by automatically opening the solenoid valves that are connected to the water source. The RTC module functions as a timekeeping device for recording temperature logs straight onto the SD card.

articleTitle: An Assessment of Healthcare Administration to Senior Citizens in Catanduanes Using Text Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: As the population of senior citizens expands, challenges on how healthcare is delivered are becoming extremely important, this study aims to evaluate how the government provides healthcare services to senior citizens in Virac, Catanduanes using text analysis to enhance the programs in place that can help them manage the healthcare services provided. The research made use of the mixed-methods approach, which included qualitative and quantitative research methods to assess the healthcare administration of government to senior citizens. The machine learning text analysis was also used in this study to assess if the respondents' opinions on the services provided are positive, neutral, or negative. Based on the responses, the assessment of the healthcare administration for senior citizens is ineffective, according to the study's findings. The feelings and opinions expressed by senior citizens are based on their experiences with the services provided to them. This research suggests that the government should improve its services for senior citizens' healthcare administration, especially in the province to better meet their needs and satisfaction. This may be evident in their feedback on what services they want to receive and how they want them to be improved.

articleTitle: Systematic Review on Business Model of Cultural -Based Product Business
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In an increasingly globalized market, the business model of companies that have culture-based products is a unique and under-researched field. This systematic review aims to explore, synthesize and evaluate existing literature regarding business models applied in the realm of culture-based product businesses. This study followed the PRISMA protocol for conducting and reporting a systematic review. A total of 15 peer-reviewed articles were included from a search of the Scopus database. Using the qualitative analysis, the result of this research serve the pattern of research in the term of business model in cultural based product. This study give the important insight for the future research to contribute novelty research in this areas.

articleTitle: Multi-Hop Teleportation Protocols for Quantum Networks Privacy in Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study examines the development of wireless quantum communication network and advance quantum com- munication. In this paper we present the idea of system scheme to transfer quantum states in the wireless quantum communication network and advance. Quantum communication is a rapidly evolving field that will significantly impact the twenty-first century. Wireless quantum communication networks transport quantum states using a multi-hop teleportation quantum routing approach. This technique does not require compatibility with classical paths, as quantum states are transported directly along the designated path. The chance of successfully transferring a quantum state is determined using statistics. Researchers analyze statistics to optimize network performance and develop strategies for quantum state transfer success. Advancements in error correction techniques enhance the reliability of quantum communication networks. A quantum state is moved from the source to the destination using direct multi-hop teleportation on the chosen path. Statistics are used to determine the likelihood of successfully transmitting the quantum state.

articleTitle: ReconMaster: A CLI Based Web Reconnaissance Tool
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: ReconMaster is a website reconnaissance toolkit, which is primarily based on Bash and GO languages. One of the key features of ReconMaster is its seamless integration with multiple reconnaissance tools, allowing users to gather a wide array of valuable information about the target website. From identifying vulnerable endpoints to analyzing parameters, this toolkit organizes and presents the obtained results in a comprehensive and easily understandable format. Upon providing a domain name or a list of domains, ReconMaster initiates a series of scans and spidering activities. It diligently explores the target domain, leaving no stone unturned in its pursuit of uncovering potential vulnerabilities. Each discovered endpoint is then subjected to a series of tests, utilizing a streamlined one-liner command to assess its susceptibility to various vulnerabilities. To ensure efficiency and ease of analysis, ReconMaster sorts the positive responses obtained from the vulnerability tests and neatly stores them in text files within the appropriate folders. This systematic approach allows penetration testers to conduct further analysis on the identified vulnerabilities and devise appropriate strategies for addressing them

articleTitle: SSFID: A Survey and Analysis of Security Framework for IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The explosion of Internet of Things devices has brought about numerous security concerns due to their interconnected nature and the sensitive data they handle. This paper reviews secure IoT frameworks that address data confidentiality, integrity, and authentication vulnerabilities. The analysis begins with a look at IoT security issues and threats. In resource- constrained IoT devices, existing security measures are insufficient, emphasizing the need for lightweight cryptographic techniques. Data confidentiality, integrity, and authentication are reviewed. Various frameworks use lightweight symmetric encryption methods with small key sizes to protect data. Some frameworks use lightweight hash functions to guarantee data integrity with minimal computational complexity. This protects vital data in transit. Lightweight authentication protocols secure IoT devices and users. Strong cryptographic methods like elliptic curve cryptography offer secure authentication without requiring excessive computation and transmission. Existing methods and protocols are reviewed. Performance and security trade-offs of the existing framework are compared to solutions. This review analyses IoT secure frameworks' merits and limitations. This review uses lightweight cryptographic approaches and protocols to identify vulnerabilities and ensure secrecy, integrity, and authentication in a resource-efficient manner.

articleTitle: Privacy Optimization in Sensors Based Networks With Industrial Processes Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) also known as IoT has the potential that is required to revolutionize industries, this has been discussed in this research article. Advancements in technology have made devices affordable, efficient and reliable. Different sectors have already started to incorporate these devices into their operations to boost productivity, to minimize failure and downtime. They also use it to optimize resource utilization which is also an important factor. However, the use of these devices also has some security challenges which need to be handled. This research paper proposes a security model specifically designed for process management in the industries. The goal of this model is to find the vulnerabilities, to minimize the risks and threats. Also ensuring integrity, confidentiality and availability of processes is a part of the goal. This paper gives evidence from its implementation and trial apart from its explanation. During the implementation phase, the sensitive data achieved a 100% encryption rate, for protection. Also, integrity checks were conducted on 99.8% of data to guarantee data integrity.

articleTitle: Enhancing Epilepsy Diagnosis through EEG-Based Machine Learning: A Comparative Analysis of Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Epilepsy is a non-contagious condition of the brain which affects individualsof all age groups, with approximately 60% of people worldwide suffering from it. The unpredictable nature of epileptic seizures necessitates accurate diagnosis for timely intervention. Electroencephalography (EEG) is a pivotal tool in epilepsy diagnosis, as it captures transient changes in brain electrical activity. This paper presents a comparative analysis of various machine learning algorithms applied to EEG data for classifying different seizure types. Our approach focuses on improving performance through data augmentation and preprocessing techniques. We explore the efficacy of algorithms such as Decision Trees, Gaussian Naive Bayes, Multi-Layer Perceptrons. K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, and Support Vector Classifier. The results highlight the superior performance of Multi-Layer Perceptron, achieving an accuracy of 96%, surpassing other algorithms. This research underscores the possibility of machine learning in enhancing epilepsy diagnosis and seizure prediction, contributing to improved patient care.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Framework for Safeguarding and Surveillance of Women in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In Each nation across the globe has established a mechanism for reporting instances of violence perpetrated against women. The statistical data pertaining to law enforcement agencies in Asian nations indicates a notable incidence of criminal offences perpetrated against the female gender. During the late 1990s, the National Crime Records Bureau released a report which forecasted that the escalation in the incidence of crimes perpetrated against women could potentially surpass the growth rate by the year 2020. Historically, a significant number of offences perpetrated against women were not brought to the attention of law enforcement officials owing to the negative connotations attached to such actions. Based on the data gathered by the government, there has been a significant increase in the incidence of various forms of criminal activities perpetrated against women. The principal objective of this study is to address the deficiencies in the current security surveillance systems with the aim of enhancing the safety of female constituents within the community. The extant surveillance technology currently available in the market is deemed insufficient to address the contemporary apprehensions regarding the safety of women. Consider the scenario wherein a male individual gains unauthorized access to a women's hostel facility. In the case of a nocturnal emergency resulting from a fire outbreak, during which the occupants of the hostel are in a state of slumber, the developed system will effectively identify the fire and promptly alert the designated fire department personnel through a pre-programmed message. The proposed system is expected to incorporate supplementary features, including realtime video streaming, email and text message notifications, SMS alerts for unauthorized access, and the capacity to transmit videos of anomalous movements detected within the monitored region.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Information Recommendation System Utilizing Deep Learning Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The dynamic information recommendation system, rooted in deep learning strategies, offers a revolutionary approach to personalized content recommendations. This paper introduces a method that seamlessly adapts to ever-changing user preferences and the dynamic nature of information. The system is structured into three pivotal phases: Data Collection and Preprocessing, Deep Learning Model Training, and Recommendation Generation with a Feedback Loop. Through meticulous data preprocessing, advanced neural network training, and continuous feedback integration, the system ensures that users are presented with the most relevant and personalized content. Experimental results, as depicted in various figures, underscore the superior performance of the proposed system, consistently outshining other recommendation methods. The histogram analysis further accentuates the system's robustness, with performance scores predominantly centered around 95%.

articleTitle: Samarjini - Revolutionizing Household Cleaning with an Affordable IoT-Based Automatic Mopper
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The title “Samarjini” draws its inspiration from the Sanskrit word for a cleaning tool, and this research paper introduces the development of an automatic mopper machine designed to streamline household cleaning tasks while maintaining affordability. In a market filled with high-cost alternatives, this IoT-based device stands out by offering autonomous navigation, obstacle detection and avoidance, and effective floor cleaning at a lower price. The paper explores the machine's design, hardware and software components, evaluates its performance in various scenarios, and underscores its relevance in today's fast-paced lifestyles. Extensive experimentation was conducted to assess the machine's performance in diverse environments and scenarios. The outcomes affirm that “Samarjini” excels in floor cleaning, adeptly avoiding obstacles and autonomously navigating through spaces.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Insights into Student Success
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The global youth cohort represents a beacon of hope for the future of the world's population. The implementation of diverse solutions tailored to the unique needs of students poses a significant challenge for Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) situated in underdeveloped countries. The significance of academic achievement in educational institutions is held in high regard by educators, as it serves as a metric to gauge the effectiveness of a particular school. The timely detection of educators who are at risk and the subsequent implementation of proactive measures have been shown to have a substantial impact on their likelihood of achieving success. The educational trajectory of an individual is influenced by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the environment in which they grow up, their family history, and their social and personal responsibilities. These factors collectively contribute to the shaping of an individual's educational journey. The present study employs the Random Forest, Naive Bayes, and K* methodologies to assess the academic performance of students across various dimensions. The experimental research demonstrates that the random forest method exhibits superior performance when compared to both the K* and Naive Bayes approaches.

articleTitle: An Effective Prediction of Cervical Cancer with Hybridization of K-Means with RFT Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The cervical cancer is the second-deadliest illness for women worldwide. Cervical cancer is hidden in women until it is advanced and incurable, thus numerous trials and research projects have been conducted to find it early. Due to the lack of appropriate datasets, accurate cervical cancer prediction has proven to be the most difficult and complex task in medical data mining. Numerous studies have been conducted to provide various methods that can fix issues and increase the accuracy of cervical cancer prognosis through photographs. As a result, researchers face a difficult and time-consuming procedure that necessitates a highly effective and complex algorithm that draws from a wide range of knowledge, experience, and methodologies. At first, the Cervical Cancer dataset is completely loaded, including its primary properties and the origin of the data. After a new method termed “whitening” is applied as pre-processing to the data set, the data mining algorithm RFT is used to clean up the data. After explaining why a combination of machine learning and data mining is necessary, the paper presents the proposed technique. The problem is solved, and the algorithm is defended as the most effective one for predicting cases of cervical cancer. The most effective prediction method is a hybrid of RFT and K-Means. To aid the researcher in drawing conclusions about the optimal algorithm to utilise for reliable prediction, several algorithms are constructed and their accuracy levels are projected using sensitivity, specificity, and F-Score as prediction factors.

articleTitle: Improving Internet of Things Application Efficiency via Synergistic Integration of LoRaWAN MAC Protocols for Enhanced Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Internet of Things' (IoT) tremendous expansion, there are now more linked devices than at any other time in history. Because of their huge coverage area and low power consumption, low-power wide-area networks, or LoRaWAns, have swiftly taken over as the norm for Internet of Things installations. The present LoRaWAn Mac (Medium Access Control) protocols struggle to accommodate many devices while maintaining optimal performance. This is true even though these strategies have a number of advantages. This paper proposes a unique method for improving the performance of LoRaWAn-based Internet of Things applications by merging three difficult MAC protocols in a synergistic manner. The adaptive data rate (ADR) algorithm is used to make real-time data rate adjustments; the dynamic channel allocation (DCA) algorithm is used to effectively allocate channels; and the priority-based channel access (PCA) algorithm is used to prioritize critical data transmissions. All three of these algorithms are referred to as “algorithms.” All these algorithms are combined into a tiny package known as priority-based channel access (PCA). The integrated solution outperforms more standard MAC protocols in terms of efficacy, scalability, and dependability. The purpose of this essay is to offer a comprehensive response to the challenges associated with adopting LoRaWAn for general use in IoT.

articleTitle: Implementation of Internet of Things (IoT) framework for Governing Modern Cyber Attacks in Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is the most reliable structure for improve the effectiveness and convenience of human existence on the planet. The Internet of Things has made important contributions to a wide range of application fields. With the rapid proliferation of smart gadgets, as well as their reliance on wireless technologies for information transmission, they have become more vulnerable to hackers. As a result of the increasing danger of cyber attacks, cyber security has emerged as among the most essential aspects of the Internet of Things, ranking second only to data privacy (IoT). The goal of IoT cyber security is to decrease cyber security risk for companies & consumers by ensuring the security of IoT resources and the safeguarding of personal information. Various methodologies and frameworks for assessing cyber security risks have been developed and are now being used in various governmental & commercial enterprises.

articleTitle: Impact of Indian Railway Service on Satisfaction of Passengers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The service industry is acting like a big player in the economy. For any service industry to achieve a competitive advantage and create the difference only quality service is the key. The Transportation sector is the renowned service sector for economic development. In the present situation good transportation forms good logistics services. Transportation constantly has a great impact on the development of economy, as the economy is ceaselessly getting reliant on the expanding capacity and the discernment of transport. With the facility and round the clock operation of big size wagons, larger train loads and closed-circuit rakes help all through day and night with a major focus on customer satisfaction. Railways have been most convenient to transport goods or cargos. Indian Railways is the backbone of the country for its unremarkable performance from the previous 151 years. IR having 114,520 kms of overall track with a route of 66,000 kms, and 7,600 various stations. IR helps the passengers in a best way, and hence there is a requirement to incorporate concern of passengers within the planning, processes and other operations which influence the services for passengers and the quality in a greatest manner. The study on the service quality address worries of passenger more viably, and comparable time. It additionally as well as productively observes the development and support of a decent service quality.

articleTitle: Why Electric Vehicles Are the Future of Transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are quickly establishing themselves as a practical and sustainable transportation option in the face of climate change and the need to cut greenhouse gas emissions. The situation of EVs now and their potential for the future are thoroughly reviewed in this overview. It places a strong emphasis on important factors including improvements in battery technology, benevolent governmental policies, lower manufacturing costs, and the potential integration of renewable energy sources. The automotive sector might be revolutionized by electric cars, which could also improve air quality and lessen dependency on fossil fuels. As EVs' range, charging capacity, and infrastructure advance, they become increasingly useful and attractive to a wider spectrum of consumers. Beyond personal transportation, electric buses, Lorries, and delivery vehicles are becoming more and more common.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Rainfall Prediction on Indian Agriculture Land
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Indian agriculture sector boasts the second-largest agricultural land area globally, serving as a crucial source of employment for nearly half of the Indian population and playing a significant role in driving the country's economy. The Indian agriculture sector has undergone significant growth and expansion in recent decades. The weather and the surrounding environment significantly influence agricultural productivity, both in terms of quality and quantity. Errorless weather forecasting has the potential to impact the scheduling of planting and harvesting activities, as well as influence spending on essential agricultural inputs, such as irrigation, insecticides, fertilizers, and herbicides. The productivity of agriculture is significantly influenced by rainfall, making it one of the primary factors to consider. Disaster rains or no rains can create situations like floods or droughts that will lead to disaster reduction in crop productivity. Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms have emerged as highly effective tools for making predictions in various fields in recent years. The main objective of this paper is to conduct a comparison-based analysis of ML and DL methods for predicting rainfall with the help of the meteorological dataset gathered for the agricultural land of Surguja, located in the Chhattisgarh, region of India.

articleTitle: A Critical Investigation in Analysing the Design and Implementation of Internet of Things and Blockchain Systems for Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is gaining importance in the recent digital environment as it enables in enhancing the productivity and output of the organisation. Business enterprises are focusing to achieve competitive advantage by using the digital tools to their advantage. The IoT enables in applying different sensors which support the users in collecting the information, analyse the pattern and forecast for achieving sustainable growth and development. It has been regarded that there is a growing demand for energy consumption in the world and is expected to grow by more than 38% in the next two decades and hence companies, individuals and government are looking to implement novel methods like blockchain, edge computing and other tools in order to measure the current and future requirements, enhance interaction between energy providers and consumers so as to satisfy the needs. The usage of blockchain and edge computing foster the necessary data analysis, prepare dashboard reports and support in quick decision making. In the present conditions, it has been stated that IoT can support in the overall connectivity with the smart grid connectivity, overall automation of various functions which can support in reducing the energy bills. This study is focused in using descriptive research for analysing the key determinants of IoT and Blockchain in the organisation, the analysis states that IoT and blockchain technology supports in enhancing scalability and efficiency, achieve overall effectiveness of information flows and support the traceability and interoperability for better decision making.

articleTitle: Development of Machine Learning Model for Detection and Diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease. A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: New techniques of detection and diagnosis are needed for Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a major concern for society's health. Machine learning (ML) has been identified as a viable approach in this context due to its capacity to allow the development of predictive models that can help in the identification of AD across its various phases. This paper provides an overview of current developments in developing ML models for application in Alzheimer's disease screening and detection. The paper opens with a discussion of the importance of early identification and recognition of Alzheimer's disease by detailing the disease's pathophysiology and describing its clinical signs. Data from neuroimaging (e.g., MRI, PET scans), clinical data (e.g., cognitive evaluations, genetic information), and new biomarkers (e.g., markers in cerebrospinal fluid) are all discussed next. The report then delves into the development of ML methods in AD studies, showing the shift from classical statistical approaches to cutting-edge algorithms like deep learning and ensemble approaches. This article delves into the significance of feature selection and extraction in improving model performance and readability. Moreover, the paper discusses difficulties connected to the accessibility of data, the presence of bias, and the requirement of standardized datasets and evaluation criteria. The review's meat and potatoes are an in-depth look at the latest research and top-tier ML models for AD diagnosis and detection. There is a large variety of techniques that may be used to these models, including as Transfer learning from different domains, semi-supervised learning, supervised learning, and unsupervised learning. The article also discusses how multimodal data fusion techniques could help improve diagnostic precision. The evaluation places equal emphasis on the interpretability and therapeutic usefulness of models as they do on their development. The article talks about how to incorporate model predictions into clinical decision support systems by visualizing and explaining them. Also discussed are the legal and moral complications of implementing ML-based AD diagnostic systems.

articleTitle: Predictive Machine Learning Models for DDoS Attack Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research provides a comprehensive method for enhanced Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) detection and mitigation by utilizing ensemble learning, namely the Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and AdaBoost algorithms. This may be done by combining these three strategies of learning. These algorithms were chosen for their demonstrated capacity to analyze high-dimensional data, understand complex connections, and adapt to new forms of attack. The dataset is then divided into training, validation, and testing sets to assess the model's resilience. Predictions obtained because of independent training of each basic technique on the training dataset were labeled RFi(X), GBi(X), and ABi(X), respectively. The weights for this approach are determined by a procedure known as cross-validation. The ensemble forecast is used to establish a threshold, and when a DDoS attack reaches that level, mitigation is activated. One method for dealing with the problem is traffic rerouting. Other methods include rate limiting, temporary IP address bans, and the adoption of new machine learning models for more in-depth research. The ensemble learning model's efficiency is reviewed on a regular basis, and changes are made as needed to account for developing trends in DDoS assaults. The suggested technique has several advantages and benefits over more standard DDoS protection systems. These enhancements include higher rates of true positives, lower rates of false alarms, and increased accuracy and precision. This illustrates its agility in both responding to and defending against a wide range of DDoS attack routes.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Edge Computing for IoT Advancements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rise of cloud computing and distributed ledger technology has enabled the IT sector to implement cutting-edge safeguards for sensitive customer data. This article examines how cloud computing and distributed ledger technologies (DLTs) may be safer due to their applications, advantages, and fundamental principles. It is critical to have a comprehensive awareness of this paradigm's core contributions, driving reasons, research difficulties, and prospective remedies. An approach based on eight mathematical equations and three sophisticated algorithms is also described. The researchers that carried out the previously stated experiment devised this strategy. The first technique, named the “Secure Data Transmission Algorithm,” involves securely transmitting data from the cloud to DLT. The “Consensus Protocol Enhancement Algorithm” (CPEA) is a method for accelerating consensus-building in DLT networks. These speeds up the process of improving the security of DLT networks. The “Privacy-Preserving Smart Contracts Algorithm” is a novel algorithm that has been designed to enable smart contracts while protecting the privacy of its users. The study's findings shed light on the potential benefits of this consolidation and provide a strong foundation for the future development of further preventive measures. The proposed solution, which is supported by complicated mathematical formulations and algorithms, efficiently answers the contemporary information technology era's strong requirement for greater security. This is because the approach relies on sophisticated mathematical formulas as its foundation.

articleTitle: A Review on Social Media and Deep Neural Networks for Sentiment Analysis in Emergency Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Disaster management is essential to ensuring public safety and reducing the impact of disasters. In recent years, disaster response and recovery have benefited from the use of social media and deep neural network technologies. Examples of sentiment analysis include tweets and deep neural networks. Information about disasters can be found on Twitter in real time. Information, media, and ideas are shared through these channels. Monitoring and evaluating Twitter messages can help emergency management professionals assess the situation, identify affected places, and establish the requirements of the people. Text sentiment analysis is useful in emergency management. Deep neural networks, a type of machine learning, can analyse and categorise people's feelings on social media. By being trained on massive volumes of historical data, deep neural networks can classify tweets as positive, negative, or neutral and produce a sentiment score. Monitoring social media and evaluating sentiment is only one of the many ways in which deep neural networks aid disaster management authorities. The precision of sentiment analysis can also be impacted by sarcasm, ambiguity, and subtleties in language use. In conclusion, disaster management can benefit from the use of Twitter and deep neural networks for sentiment analysis. By monitoring and assessing social media content, authorities can improve situational awareness, make educated judgements, and safeguard affected communities during disasters.

articleTitle: Analysis of Approaches for Identifying Threats in the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) and Exploration of Research Frontiers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The contemporary healthcare landscape has witnessed a rapid integration of the Internet of Things (IoT), particularly within the realm of medical devices, forming the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT). While IoMT offers transformative benefits, it also introduces significant security challenges. This study presents an innovative and holistic approach to comprehensively analyze and identify threats in the IoMT environment. The proposed method involves a wellstructured process encompassing data collection, preprocessing, feature extraction, and threat identification through advanced machine learning algorithms. Raw data, often noisy and redundant, is initially collected from various IoMT devices, which primarily consist of crucial medical data such as vital signs and diagnostic information. Preprocessing is then applied to clean, normalize, and transform this raw data into a suitable format for subsequent analysis. Feature extraction is pivotal to capture meaningful information, essential for effective threat identification, and involves the identification of pertinent features related to patient health, device behavior, and system interactions. Utilizing machine learning algorithms, specifically Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), the proposed method showcases superior performance in comparison to traditional methods. Additionally, the proposed method exhibits significantly lower execution times, highlighting its efficiency and suitability for real-time threat detection, a crucial requirement in the dynamic IoMT landscape. This research stands as a significant contribution to bolstering the security and reliability of IoMT systems, ensuring a safer healthcare environment for patients and practitioners.

articleTitle: Non-Overlapping Block Processing of Cancer Genes Data for Earlier Prediction of Breast Cancer Diseases using Regression Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Earlier prediction of breast cancer through genes is a challenging task. Existing methods use gene expression in large datasets for the classification and identification of breast cancer based on genes. In this paper, the Bag of Words (BoW) method is applied to a large data set based on block processing to predict cancer at an earlier stage with non-overlapping based block processing of gene data. Based on blocks of gene data, a gene's frequency count is calculated. For frequency calculation, BoW techniques with different gene data lengths are used. The frequency value calculated from the bag-of-words provides the input for machine learning based prediction. Regression techniques such as Multiple Linear Regression (MLR), Simple Linear Regression(SLR) and Logistic Regression (LR) are used for the prediction of breast cancer using non-overlapping based block processing of large data. The LR technique's prediction accuracy is about 93.5 % which is very high compared to other methods. High accuracy in the prediction of cancer genes at an early stage is achieved.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Attack Tree: Assessing Cyberattack Risk Using Attack Tree and Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Organisations and users have been experiencing significant rises in cyberattacks and their severity, which means that they require a greater awareness and understanding of the anatomy of cyberattacks, to prevent and mitigate their effects. In analysing cyberattacks, there are a number of different approaches that may be used to assess their potential risks and effects. However, these are utilised in specific types of cyberattacks and their analysis, which means they cannot be applied in every situation or cyberattack. Moreover, several other factors may influence the decision to use these approaches, such as cost, complexity, skills and adaptability. As a result, continuous research to design and enhance these approaches is undertaken to produce a generic, cost-effective, easy and adaptable approach. This paper presents one such approach to assess the risk of cyberattacks utilising an attack tree and fuzzy logic. An attack tree is a systematic and illustrative method for describing an attack on a system and analysing its taxonomy and other aspects. Subsequently, the probability and risk of each leaf node in the attack tree are calculated using the proposed formulas. Finally, fuzzy logic enables decision making based on imprecise data and heuristics to obtain the overall risk of attack. This proposed approach comprises systematic steps to accomplish an assessment of any cyberattack and its associated risks in an uncomplicated and effective manner, enabling its prevention and mitigation to be determined. The paper illustrates an application of the proposed approach to assess the risk of an information theft attack on an organisation, which can then be utilised to assess the risk of other cyberattacks.

articleTitle: Enhancing Remote Oversight of Plants with a Compact IIoT System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: It is impossible to overestimate the importance of remotely monitoring industrial facilities in the context of the Industrial Internet of Things. The goal of this line of research is to improve remote monitoring by using real-time data analytics, predictive maintenance, and energy optimization with a tiny Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) system. The three most important algorithms are an energy optimization method using a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller, a predictive maintenance strategy based on machine learning models, and a real-time data streaming and analysis tool. The proposed method is said to be able to use these algorithms in real time, which enables it to schedule preventive maintenance, identify anomalies, and use energy effectively. Effective, sustainable, and data-driven plant management support should be expected to result in minimal downtime, lower operating costs, and ecologically conscious operations.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Efficiency of Computational Genetic Epidemiology using HPC-Driven AI Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Genetic epidemiology significantly enhances our understanding of complex illnesses; it investigates the interaction between genetic variables and environmental factors in determining the prevalence of diseases in communities with the merging of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and High-Performance Computing (HPC) models, the industry has seen a transformational change in recent years. This work presents a new method called “High-Performance AI-GenEpi,” which is intended to improve the effectiveness of computational genetic epidemiology. Genomic Data Preprocessing (GDP), Deep Learning for Genetic Risk Prediction (DL-GRP), and Parallelized Genome-Wide Association Analysis (P-GWAA) are the three main techniques that are combined in the suggested approach. P-GWAA uses HPC to speed up genome-wide association research, DL-GRP uses deep learning to accurately predict disease risk, and GDP maximizes data quality and compatibility. It performs very well computationally, providing faster processing times for risk assessment, association analysis, and data preparation.
