In addition, the approach takes use of HPC's parallel processing power and produces very accurate genetic risk predictions, which makes it perfect for evaluating large genomic datasets. The efficacy of the technology is shown across a wide range of applications, such as medication repurposing, biomarker discovery, and illness risk prediction. High-Performance AI-GenEpi is leading the way in the ongoing evolution of genetic epidemiology, providing a fresh approach to effective and perceptive research in this vital area.

articleTitle: Cotton Crop Disease Detection Using DL Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In recent years, the importance of agriculture in India has grown significantly given the speed population growth and rising food demand. With approximately 70% of the population depending on agriculture, the need to increase crop yield has become crucial. One of the major challenges faced by farmers is the detection and prevention of plant diseases, as they can have a detrimental impact on crop productivity. To address this issue, a method for detecting plant diseases using deep learning and image processing is being developed. Low agricultural yields are a result of bacterial, viral, and fungal plant diseases. To stop the spread of illnesses and reduce production losses, early detection and prompt response are crucial. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and models like VGG16, in particular, have showed considerable potential for image classification problems. These methods can be used to precisely diagnose and categories plant diseases by utilizing deep learning. This paper focuses on the use of deep learning approaches, specifically CNNs and VGG16, for plant disease identification. The study delves into the details of these two deep learning techniques and their application in disease identification and classification. By analyzing and processing plant images, these methods can effectively differentiate between healthy plants and those affected by diseases. The proposed technique holds immense potential in revolutionizing plant disease detection in India. By providing farmers with a reliable and efficient tool for disease identification, preventive measures can be implemented promptly, leading to increased crop yields. Moreover, deep learning methods prioritize the outcomes of specific tasks, making them well-suited depending on the data itself, for the diagnosis of plant diseases.

Author Keywords: Plant diseases caused by bacteria and Viruses

articleTitle: Understanding the Underlying Mechanics of Binary Brainwaves and Bayesian Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Understanding the basic mechanics behind binary brainwaves and Bayesian frameworks is crucial for decoding the intricate inner workings of human cognition. In this research, we provide a game-changing method that integrates Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs), Hidden Markov Models (HMMs), and Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs) to provide a holistic understanding of such intricate systems. The acronym for this strategy is “BNNiPGM,” which stands for Bayesian Neural Networks Integrated Probabilistic Graphical Model. We compared the proposed method to six alternatives and report our results using many types of visual displays. The findings show that the proposed approach excels over existing methods in a number of respects, including temporal and spatial resolution, prediction accuracy, computational complexity, model interpretability, and generalization capability. Scatter plots, pie charts, histograms, and box plots are only some of the graphical representations used in the study, each of which presents the performance comparison in its own unique manner. Based on the scatter plots' findings, it's clear that the proposed technique outperforms the two more common methods. Pie charts may be used to visually display the majority of the total points for the proposed approach. Histograms show that the performance of the proposed technique has a larger than normal distribution of high scores and a smaller than normal distribution of low scores. The box plots further demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method. By laying the groundwork for further research into the probabilistic features of binary brainwaves and Bayesian frameworks, this study contributes to the disciplines of artificial intelligence and neuroscience. We can learn more about the cognitive mechanisms at work in the human brain by combining biological neural networks, hidden Markov models, and probabilistic graphical models (PGMs) to create more accurate models of intricate neurological processes and cognitive functions.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Performance Assessment of Machine Learning Models for Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The incorporation of machine learning into disaster management is a game-changing development since it improves our preparedness for, reaction to, and recovery from a wide variety of catastrophic occurrences. Machine learning models have showcased their effectiveness across key areas, including early warning systems, damage assessment, resource allocation, and overarching decision support mechanisms, leading to substantial enhancements in the efficiency and efficacy of disaster management endeavors. By harnessing the potent capabilities of data analytics, predictive modeling, and real-time decision-making, machine learning empowers authorities and response teams with the capability to make judicious decisions, ultimately holding the potential to save lives and ameliorate the repercussions of disasters. However, for the successful integration of machine learning in the realm of disaster management, sustained collaboration among governmental bodies, organizations, and technology experts is imperative. Furthermore, unwavering commitment to data quality, model precision, and ethical considerations is paramount. Adaptive and robust disaster management systems are on the horizon, thanks in large part to the rapid development of machine learning, which bodes well for the future of catastrophe prevention and response. Moving on to the performance evaluation of different machine learning models, this research sheds light on the accuracy levels reached by these models and the specific strengths and weaknesses of each. Notably, Logistic Regression (LR) and Support Vector Classifier (SVC) demonstrate commendable accuracy, attaining an impressive 88%. The Decision Tree Classifier, although slightly lower at 84% accuracy, still exhibits a robust predictive capacity. In contrast, Ensemble methods yield an accuracy of 86%, signifying their effectiveness in capturing intricate data relationships. Meanwhile, the k-Nearest Neighbor (k-NN) classifier registers an accuracy of 84%. This comprehensive performance assessment, meticulously outlined in the study, furnishes an indispensable reference for the judicious selection of the most suitable machine learning model tailored to specific task requirements, thereby advancing the field's data-driven decision-making capabilities.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Machine Learning Based Ensemble Model for Prediction of Possible Diseases and Recommending Medicines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Many instances remain untreated globally due to the lack and unavailability of medical services. In this regard, efficient monitoring and analysis of medical records will be helpful in timely identification and prediction of diseases. To enable a quicker and more precise diagnosis, a platform that keeps track of a patient's medical history and makes illness predictions based on the patient's present symptoms is needed. Early disease prediction allows users to determine the severity of a condition and take appropriate action timely. Thus, anticipation of illness in its early stage becomes essential but it's difficult for doctors to anticipate outcomes precisely and accurately based only on symptoms. Availability of medical data and its analysis with the help of machine learning techniques can help the healthcare system for appropriate predictions and recommendations of diseases. In this paper, based on the patient's symptoms and medical records, a general illness prediction system is proposed. Using the input image for disease prediction, we applied an ensemble model exploiting the KNN, SVM, Naïve bayes and deep learning techniques to accurately predict diseases. The proposed model superseded the existing techniques with 98% accuracy on experimental study performed using benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: Identification of Post Covid Symptoms in Long Haulers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Covid 19 is a disastrous infection that the whole world tackled for 2 years from 2020-to 2021. As this virus was new and doctors had no idea about it, they treated patients to save lives with all their possible experiences. This virus was contagious, and lockdown took place, people faced financial problems due to loss of jobs or businesses getting shut down for months, many people could not get admitted to hospitals and lost their life due to lack of facilities. While the whole world was dealing with these numerous issues, there was one kind of group of people who successfully recovered from Covid19 but, they faced some changes in their health like some inability they didn't have before infecting of Covid19 or worsened health issues that were mild in them pre Covid19 infection. These are called post Covid19 symptoms which are seen in post Covid19 patients, and such patients are termed as “Long Haulers”. Long Covid19 symptoms are different in different people, some face mild symptoms like headache, fatigue to severe symptoms where we see an effect on vital organs. In some cases, the effect on the vital organ is irreversible. The conception behind this study is to rack up the data of post Covid19 patients and perform analysis on such data and upskill a ML model, this trained model then project what disease the post Covid19 patient is prone to by taking all his/her details. This idea will help users to get an idea beforehand and take prophylactic measures by conferring with a respective specialist.

articleTitle: The Healthcare Internet of Things as a Paradigm Shift in Hospital Management, Patient Care, and Medical Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: When it comes to hospital administration, patient care, and medical data analysis, the Healthcare Internet of Things (HIoT) is nothing short of a paradigm revolution. We dive into this new paradigm to examine its far-reaching effects and revolutionary possibilities in the healthcare system. The context is established by introducing HIoT as a game-changing development in healthcare. Using the IoT to network several devices, this model paves the way for real-time patient monitoring, to provide a precise depiction of the healthcare system, dataset environments use well maintained medical data sources. The performance and efficacy of HIoT technologies may be evaluated using measurable criteria such as sensitivity (0.94), specificity (0.89), F1-Score (0.91), ROC-AUC (0.95), and cost savings (∃150,000). To determine the relative importance of each part of the HIoT ecosystem, researchers undertake “ablation studies”. Our findings provide a clear picture of the disruptive potential of HIoT. Better patient outcomes may be ensured via early interventions thanks to the improved accuracy (0.92), efficiency (9.2), and satisfaction (9.2) provided by the suggested HIoT technique for patient monitoring. to its persistent outperformance of conventional methods. With cutting-edge technologies and a hopeful future for both patients and healthcare professionals, HIoT is in the front of healthcare's ongoing revolution.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Face Recognized Attendance Management System using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In today's digital age, manual attendance tracking is plagued by inefficiency and the potential for inaccuracies, often leading to proxy attendance. The main aim of this research work is to manage and monitor the student's attendance by using face recognition technology. This proposed model is mainly categorized four major modules. First module is database creation. Second module is face detection. Then third module is face recognition and final module is automatic attendance updating process. Student images are compiled to create a comprehensive database, ensuring inclusivity across the class roster. The system utilizes the face recognition library, which relies on deep learning based algorithms for face detection and recognition during testing. This face recognition part Convolutional Neural Network algorithm is used. The system matches detected faces with the known database and marks attendance, ensuring a streamlined and accurate attendance tracking process. This innovative approach has the potential to revolutionize attendance management in educational settings, offering a contactless and efficient solution while mitigating proxy attendance concerns. The proposed model is to compare the accuracy level of face recognition.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Security in IoT Networks through Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research introduces an advanced methodology for enhancing edge computing security in IoT networks by employing machine learning techniques. The approach begins with a meticulous data preprocessing and feature engineering phase, preparing raw IoT data for further analysis. Subsequently, the Isolation Forest algorithm is applied for anomaly detection, effectively isolating anomalies by leveraging random feature selection and isolation trees. To enhance intrusion detection, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), known for its proficiency in pattern recognition, is utilized. The CNN model learns intricate patterns from preprocessed IoT data and distinguishes normal behavior from potential intrusions. Furthermore, an ensemble fusion technique is proposed, combining the strengths of Isolation Forest and CNN-based intrusion detection to achieve a more accurate and reliable intrusion detection system. Performance evaluation demonstrates that the proposed method consistently outperforms traditional approaches, showcasing superior detection accuracy, lower false positive rates, enhanced privacy preservation, reduced latency, improved scalability, and increased energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Wood Finishes: Innovative Marketing Strategies in Architecture and Interior Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Rising global population and income levels necessitate ever more affordable and quality housing facilities. A significant portion of the population is also moving to new places as the service sector develops, fueling the expansion of hostels, co-living spaces, guest houses, and government buildings. This trend translates into higher demand for suitable furniture options and wider range of furniture products. The objective of this paper is to firstly explore artificial intelligence (AI) for identifying innovative marketing strategies in the premium wood finish industry. Secondly, this paper presents a brief literature review on classifying influencers in marketing of excellent wood finishes. The paper follows a case study based approach to explore how an organization identifies, analyzes, and utilizes its capabilities to attract influencers and, ultimately, the end consumers. To support this research, interviews were taken with 54 architects, interior designers, contractors and color experts based in Mumbai, Pune, Delhi and Canada. Finally, this study proposes a five-step approach that any organization can follow to adopt design-first approach in the wood finish industry.

articleTitle: Acquiring Diverse Knowledge for Predictive Academic Excellence in the Field of Transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Research is being conducted to examine whether gathering information may help students achieve extraordinary academic outcomes in the transportation business. Three major components of a comprehensive solution will be presented through a revolutionary technique that integrates previously different approaches: knowledge graph construction (KGC), knowledge embedding (KE), and predictive modeling (PM). During the KGC stage, data is gathered from many sources and arranged into a knowledge graph. However, when the KE stage is reached, this data is stored in vector spaces. These embeddings are used in transportation research for PM tasks that need prediction. The suggested technique is superior at capturing the intricate links seen in transportation data as well as providing a more comprehensive predictive modeling tool. Traditional approaches, while perhaps easier to use, are not as capable of dealing with complicated patterns and a diverse set of data sources. This work proposes a unique research approach based on knowledge representation and embedding, which greatly contributes to the advancement of progressive scholarship in the field of transportation studies. This illustrates the need for the sector to adopt creative tactics to meet everchanging difficulties.

articleTitle: Advancements in Control Systems: Sliding Motion Control, Integrating PID Control, and Machine Learning for Precision and Robustness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: To improve the precision and robustness of control systems, this paper investigates the integration of three different control methodologies: Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) control, sliding motion control, and machine learning. The introduction starts by outlining the historical progression of control systems and highlighting their growing significance in contemporary technology. These integrated control strategies are at the centre of the research. The effectiveness of PID control as a solid foundation is first demonstrated through real-world applications and success stories, which provide insights into its principles, advantages, and disadvantages. The next step is to introduce sliding motion control to improve the adaptability of control systems, particularly in handling complex dynamics and uncertainties. It is presented as an addition to PID control, and real-world examples show how adaptable and responsive it is. The importance of machine learning's ability to learn from data and adapt to changing environments is emphasised as the role of machine learning in control systems is thoroughly examined. It is viewed as a tool for performance improvement and optimisation, supported by real-world examples that show the sophistication of control systems. The integration of these three methodologies, emphasising the theoretical underpinnings and methodologies of this approach, forms the core of the research. Through case studies spanning numerous industries, such as industrial automation, robotics, aerospace, and autonomous vehicles, it elaborates on the advantages of such integration, particularly in terms of achieving precision and robustness.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Multifaceted Interactions of Modern Digital Dreamscapes and Deep Data Insights
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Through a methodologically exhaustive approach, this study investigates the complex relationships between contemporary digital dreamscapes and deep data insights. Natural Language Processing (NLP), Social Network Analysis (SNA), Machine Learning Algorithms (MLA), Data Mining (DM), Topic Modeling (TM), and Sentiment Analysis (SA) are among the six original methods compared to the proposed method, which combines ethnographic research with cutting-edge data analysis techniques. To emphasize the relative performance and ethical implications of the methodologies, four different visualizations are offered, including a bar chart, scatter plot, pie chart, and box plot. According to the results, the suggested technique is superior to the conventional ones in many respects, including accuracy, precision, recall, F1-Score, processing time, privacy, data security, ethics, cultural sensitivity, scalability, and adaptability. Considering these findings, an interdisciplinary approach is necessary for evaluating digital dreamscapes, one that takes into consideration cultural, ethical, and data-driven factors.

articleTitle: Biometric Network Security Enhancements through Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In Biometrics is a relatively new authentication mechanism that has garnered some acceptance in the rapidly evolving field of network security. People are increasingly interested in biometric-based security solutions since traditional systems, which usually rely on tokens or passwords, are insecure. Although biometrics have a lot of potential, several issues must be addressed before they can be used successfully, such as the data's inherent unpredictability and the technology's vulnerability to hostile attacks. With our proposed technique, we intend to overcome these issues and improve biometric network security. Our methodology is built on the use of deep learning techniques, notably for feature extraction. Deep Feature Extraction (DFE) is a technique developed by our group that employs a convolutional neural network (CNN). Unlike in the past, when human feature engineering was required, CNNs are now capable of automatically and adaptively learning the spatial hierarchies of features in biometric data. Important characteristics needed for effective identification or verification are deleted. One of the key disadvantages of deep learning models is their vulnerability to adversarial assaults, which is especially problematic for applications that manage sensitive data. It ensures enhanced accuracy for the system through the right integration of information from several sources, resulting in fewer false positives and false negatives. The proposed technique provides a comprehensive answer to the problems that biometric authentication systems face. By combining numerous algorithm combinations and cutting-edge deep learning methodologies, we want to set a new standard for biometric network security.

articleTitle: Advanced Distributed Ledger Technologies for Predictive Network Security Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Because of the combination of cloud computing and distributed ledger technologies (DLTs) the information technology sector can now implement cutting-edge safety standards. This article examines the application cases, benefits, and underlying mechanisms that improve security when distributed ledger technologies (DLTs) are integrated with cloud computing. These aspects, when combined, contribute to the greater security of the cloud. The “Privacy-Preserving Smart Contracts Algorithm” offers a revolutionary method for deploying smart contracts while protecting user privacy. This data includes health records and financial information. Line plots, scatter plots, and box plots are examples of modern visualization techniques used in the presentation of the findings. These graphs demonstrate the advantages of the proposed technique over the more common options presented. The proposed method's memory, accuracy, and precision have all been shown to improve, proving its efficacy in achieving the goal of boosting security. Furthermore, it has a very fast runtime and a high F1-Score, suggesting the product's usefulness and usability. To summarize, the integration of cloud computing and DLTs constitutes a significant achievement in the field of data security. The findings of this study shed light on the potential benefits of this type of integration and laid a solid foundation for establishing additional safety safeguards. The technique presented here is a practical solution to the challenge of strengthening digital security, and it is supported by complex algorithms and mathematical calculations.

articleTitle: Adversarial Machine Learning Challenges in Modern Network Security Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving landscape of network security, the threat of adversarial attacks on machine learning models has emerged as a critical concern. In response, we propose the Adversarial Robust Network Security Framework (ARNetSec), a comprehensive defense strategy integrating three pivotal algorithms—Adversarial Training (AT), Randomized Smoothing (RS), and Defensive Distillation (DD). AT involves training the model on a mixture of clean data and adversarial examples, generated through the Fast Gradient Sign Method (FGSM). RS adds random noise to input data during inference, creating uncertainty that hampers adversarial attempts. DD employs temperature scaling in the softmax function, smoothing the probability distribution and enhancing robustness. This framework collectively fortifies machine learning models, bolstering their resistance against adversarial attacks, and substantially improving their generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Security and Data Sensitivity: Leveraging the Synergy of Blockchain Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Data security and sensitivity have become significant challenges for organizations worldwide in the digital transformation era. Protecting sensitive user data from cyber-attacks, breaches, and information exposure is of utmost concern. This research paper explores the potential of integrating blockchain, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) technologies to enhance data protection and ensure confidentiality. The introduction provides an overview of data sensitivity and the growing importance of data security in the digital age. It delves into blockchain technology, emphasizing its decentralized, immutable ledger for secure authentication, access control, and tamper-proof data storage. The paper presents various use scenarios, illustrating how blockchain safeguards sensitive user data, including medical records, financial information, and personal identifiers. It further examines AI's role in data security, showcasing its capability to detect threats, analyze anomalies, and authenticate users, thereby blocking unauthorized access to confidential information. Additionally, the study explores machine learning for data sensitivity management, highlighting its prowess in formulating access control policies and data categorization. The research underscores how blockchain, AI, and machine learning synergize to create a comprehensive data security architecture, enabling businesses to leverage the immutability of blockchain and the intelligent data protection of AI/ML. Real-world examples demonstrate the effectiveness of this synergy in enhancing data security and safeguarding against modern threats.

articleTitle: System Malware Detection on Android Application File Packages Using Heuristic Optimizer through Hybrid Approach EDT-ABO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the age of ubiquitous sensors and intellectual devices, various techniques have been employed to discover diverse categories of malware variants. But, particular areas of malware detection remain unexplored appropriate to the emergence of new malware variations. Many malware detection programs rely on signatures, such as utilizing a hash function to generate a hash value for an executable file containing malware. However, traditional malware detection methods often fall short in detecting the majority of new iterations of existing malware. This research introduces an innovative approach rooted to improve the usability of an existing framework. Because the modern meta-heuristic algorithm optimal selection is built on African Buffalo Optimization Algorithm, we must obtain a novel model i.e., Enhanced Decision Tree Algorithm Using African Buffalo Optimization (EDTABO) to increase the overall optimization. This is accomplished by applying the EDTABO optimisation strategy, which is known as EDTABO to increase its accuracy. This approach is capable of overcoming the complexity provided in engineering issues. The system is initially trained using datasets from malware software and android applications, and the datasets are then pre-processed by removing training errors. The built ABDT model then executes the detection process to foretell malware activity. Also, techniques both static and dynamic are used to detect malware activity. Using such proposed model presented model successfully predicts whether the provided application is malicious or benign and was created for malware detection and protection.

articleTitle: Encrypted Traffic Analysis for Malware Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In an era where cyber threats continually evolve, the detection of malware within encrypted network traffic remains a formidable challenge. This study presents a pioneering approach that harnesses the power of deep learning to address this challenge effectively. The proposed methodology for “Encrypted Traffic Analysis for Malware Detection using Deep Learning” leverages Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and hybrid models to extract meaningful features from encrypted data. Proposed research not only significantly enhances malware detection accuracy but also contributes to robustness against adversarial attacks. Additionally, this work emphasizes the importance of real-time analysis, scalability, and privacy preservation in the proposed approach. Cross-dataset evaluation further demonstrates the generalizability of our models, and continuous monitoring ensures adaptability to evolving malware threats. With these contributions, our methodology marks a significant advancement in the realm of network security, safeguarding systems against hidden malware threats lurking within encrypted traffic.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Study on E-Banking as ICT Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Bibliometric analysis is a quantitative method for analyzing and tracking the current state of research in a specific field of academic interest. Numerous studies have been conducted on e-banking over the last three decades. The main aim of this study is to investigate the existing literature available on e-banking through bibliometric analysis. This research has utilized bibliometric analysis to evaluate research papers in the field of e-banking. Articles published up to 19th September 2022 were considered for bibliometric analysis and were retrieved from the Scopus database. 226 articles related to e-banking were analyzed using biblioshiny and VOSviewer techniques. The study identifies the most productive countries and authors that are deeply engaged in the research area of e-banking. Further, the study's findings displayed the most repeated keywords, top-cited articles, top-productive journals and chronological publications of articles. The study's findings are based on secondary data, and no primary data were collected for the research. The research limits document retrieval to a single database (Scopus) and extraction of the documents was based on specific keywords from the Business Management and Accounting disciplines. As a result, the outcomes could not be generalized. Academicians interested in exploring the topic of e-banking can benefit from this bibliometric research. It provides information on this field's prominent journals, authors, and nations.

articleTitle: Indian Comics Industry in the Blockchain Realm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Blockchain technologies promise efficient transactions, more trade account-ability, and increased/direct payment for the creative industry may revolutionize value exchange and IP management Patrickson, B. (2021). The Indian comics Industry lacks a technology solution to help small publishers and independent writers. Traditional comics cannot help small publishers and creators succeed. Online comic book stores are comparable. Online comic shops provide creators and publishers with more accessible point-of-sale systems. Despite their many benefits, small/new publishers or individual authors struggle with business models or tools. Inaction threatens the worldwide comic book market. Direct licensing and artistic work administration require unique software to expand global talent pools, increase customer access and brand recognition, and worldwide comics and goods distribution. Give small/new businesses industry data. Set high criteria for collaboration, production, and revenue. Until then, marketing software must consider the 4Ps: Product - User-friendly. Affordable Price, Place - Wide availability. Promotion - It is Eco friendly and safe. The main point seems terrible. Large comic publishers or corporate links may dominate the solutions above, but they must remain open and uninfluenced. A dominant party could withhold resources from other market participants, preventing them from abandoning traditional production and distribution methods. This study examined the potential negative economic change in the comic book industry production, distribution, and licensing resources that do not coordinate. Small publishers, artists, and comic book customers suffer from the economy Blockchain's potential requires a global paradigm shift and organized software tools.

articleTitle: Harnessing the Potential of Ethereum Blockchain Framework to Enhance Patient Record Management in Healthcare Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In today's digital age, the healthcare sector is experiencing a significant transformation due to the pervasive influence of Information Technology (IT). There is an abundance of sources for generating and accessing patients' health data, and safeguarding the management of this data has become of utmost importance. Blockchain technology, at the forefront of technological innovation, offers a promising solution for secure data storage within the healthcare domain. In the context of current research the authors, have developed a sophisticated smart contract designed specifically for the storage and management of patients' medical records. This smart contract incorporates a range of functionalities, including the creation of new records, authorization for newly generated records, and the ability to retrieve stored records. Uploading the test reports on IPFS server has been deferred for consideration in future scope. The smart contract is meticulously designed and rigorously tested on the Ethereum Blockchain framework. The research objective is to elucidate the pivotal role that blockchain technology plays in ensuring the security and integrity of healthcare recordkeeping, utilizing the robust Ethereum framework as authors’ platform of choice. The research aims to shed light on the transformative potential of blockchain in enhancing the trustworthiness and privacy of patient data within the healthcare sector.

articleTitle: Recognising Human Actions Using Long-Term Recurrent Convolutional Network (LRCN)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The study of human activity recognition has gained popularity. It is employed to make sense of the actions taken by the people in the films. The CNN and LSTM models, which were trained independently, can be used to do this. Using a pre-trained model, we can use this CNN model to extract spatial characteristics from the frames that were taken from the movies. The action depicted in the videos can then be predicted using an LSTM model by using the features that CNN extracted. Alternatively, combining convolutional and LSTM layers into a single model using the Long Recurrent Convolutional Network is a more effective way to implement it. We discovered that using a single model was more accurate than using each model separately.

articleTitle: The Deciding Divide: A Comparative Study on Exploring the Parallels and Contrasts in Decision-Making between Humans and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this study we delve into a analysis of decision making processes, between humans and artificial intelligence (AI) systems. Our main objective is to explore and understand the similarities and differences in how humans and AI approach decision making. Through our research we shed light on the abilities possessed by humans, such as reasoning, emotional intelligence and adaptability as well as the reliance of AI systems, on programmed algorithms and data analysis techniques. We thoroughly investigate factors that influence decision making, such as information processing and reasoning methods employed by both humans and AI. To evaluate decision making patterns and reasoning capabilities we conduct experiments involving user responses alongside an AI chatbots performance. Our findings strongly emphasize that while AI systems excel in data processing abilities and making decisions they still lag behind humans in terms of skills, emotional intelligence and adaptability. By comprehending the strengths and limitations of each approach our study underscores the significance of harnessing the combined potential of both expertise and AI systems to enhance decision making across domains.

articleTitle: Generic and Domain Centred Summarization of Documents with Heightened Thought Plan by using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In recent years, the massive growth of digital content has created a pressing need for effective summarization tools that can deliver concise, coherent, and informative representations of lengthy texts. This study offers a comprehensive model that uses deep learning to discern and emphasize the underlying thought patterns within documents, ensuring that the generated summaries not only capture key factual details but also the nuanced domain-centric insights. Document summarization stands at the intersection of information retrieval and natural language processing. The Heightened Thought Plan Summarizer (HTPS) introduces a cutting-edge approach, adept at generic and domain-centric summarization. By converting sentences into embeddings and calculating domain relevance scores, HTPS crafts summaries that are both broad and nuanced. Our evaluations, spanning performance, efficiency, and domain relevance, pitch HTPS against ten traditional methods. The results affirm HTPS's superiority in producing human-like, domain-relevant, and coherent summaries. While there's potential for refining its efficiency and coverage, HTPS represents a promising stride in advanced document summarization.

articleTitle: Personalized Treatment Recommendations for Mental Health Disorders Using AI and Big Healthcare Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The advancement of AI and the availability of massive healthcare datasets have led to significant advancements in the field of mental healthcare. Multiple types of learning are incorporated into the suggested tactic. These include deep learning, collaborative filtering, and reinforcement learning. The goal of Deep Learning for Diagnosis, or DL-D for short, is to improve the precision with which mental health issues are identified by analyzing data from several sources. Examples of such data sources are fmri scans and genetic profiles. Patients' medical records might be combined using the innovative CF-TR algorithm to provide customized therapy recommendations. To improve the effectiveness of pharmaceutical regimens, RL-MRO (Reinforcement Learning for Pharmaceutical Regimen Optimization) was developed by researchers in the area. This innovation automatically modifies dosing plans in response to patient feedback and probable adverse events. To gauge the strategy's efficacy, we compared it to six other options, each of which was predicated on a different group of metrics. The results show that the proposed method outperforms the standard method in terms of accuracy, precision, and memory. How well this technology can individualize treatment programs and simplify dosage schedules for individuals will determine the health outcomes that may be expected. The suggested method of providing mental health care is thorough and customized to meet the unique needs of each patient. This assists persons with mental health concerns in the long run as well as increasing the success of treatment.

articleTitle: Cloud-Powered Interactive Music Pedagogy A Paradigm Shift in Music Education for the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The integration of cloud computing and interactive music instructional modes has revolutionized the educational landscape, particularly in music education. This paper delves into the innovative cloud-based platform designed for music learning, emphasizing its unique features and benefits. The platform's architecture, as depicted in the provided flowcharts, showcases the systematic and iterative learning processes, from music selection to feedback provision. Additionally, the collaborative learning process, facilitated by the platform, promotes peer interaction and mentorship. The paper also introduces a novel cloud computing model, highlighting the hierarchical interaction between users and cloud infrastructure. The transformative potential of cloud computing in modernizing classrooms is evident, with the cloud offering advanced resources and facilitating collaborative creation of scholarly material. The paper concludes by discussing the efficacy of the platform in enhancing music education outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Resilience of Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems against External Threats
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: There has never been a more pressing need for novel and sturdy methods of bolstering system resilience than in today's period, which is characterized by the prevalence of industrial cyber-physical systems (ICPS) and the unrelenting expansion of external threats. This research presents the “Integrated Resilience Framework (IRF),” a novel approach to strengthening ICPS's defenses against external attacks. The IRF is an all-encompassing and flexible framework that integrates several techniques, such as those for cybersecurity frameworks, machine learning and predictive analytics, and resilient hardware and redundancy. The results of our trials show that the IRF is much superior to conventional techniques for making ICPS more resilient. In addition to ensuring adherence to cybersecurity best practices, the integrated strategy uses machine learning and predictive analytics to identify and react to attacks in real time. In addition, the system's redundancy and fault-tolerant components provide continuous service with minimal interruptions. To sum up, the IRF is a game-changer for the study of ICPS resilience. It's a comprehensive, futuristic, and powerful answer that can outlast more conventional approaches. Businesses may better protect themselves against both new and old dangers by adopting the IRF, making the industrial sector as a whole safer and more secure.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Approach to Improving Neonatal Care through Artificial Intelligence and Clinical Data Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This approach makes use of cutting-edge machine learning techniques to improve early diagnosis, better treatment protocols, and supply neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) with continuous monitoring capabilities. The following are the essential parts that make up this whole. Collecting the Data and Performing Preprocessing: We collect clinical data from a wide variety of sources, some of which include electronic health records (EHRs), medical sensors, laboratory findings, and imaging tests. The data are preprocessed to get rid of any outliers, fill in any gaps in the data, and make sure the data are consistent. First, we use an algorithm called Random Forest (RF) for early diagnosis. This allows us to determine the chance of newborn problems, such as sepsis or respiratory distress syndrome, occurring. The results of the separate decision trees are combined in RF before any predictions are made, which guarantees a reliable and accurate early diagnosis. Real-time monitoring of newborn vital signs and clinical data is also a component of our system. Anomaly detection algorithms are used in this process to discover deviations from the normal range of values. This individualized approach to newborn care ensures that appropriate therapies are performed at the appropriate times, which leads to improved patient outcomes. To ensure that a human-centered approach is maintained in the field of healthcare, the technique incorporates many ethical precautions, such as protections for patients' privacy and openness.

articleTitle: The Connection Among Informatics and Audit Standards is Mediated by Organizational Culture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study examines the complex relationship between informatics, organizational culture, and audit standards in the context of business and finance in an era characterized by technological innovation as well as constantly changing regulatory requirements. The paper examines the substantial influence of informatics on contemporary audit practices using rigorous data analysis employing SPSS and examines the mediating function of organizational culture in this dynamic environment. Descriptive statistics provide a preliminary understanding of data patterns by highlighting primary tendencies and variabilities within significant variables. Additional regression including mediation analyses reveals important linkages and the underlying mechanisms at work, illuminating the informatics field's transformational potential. The conclusions highlight just how important it is to match organizational culture with technical improvements and provide a road map for guaranteeing the efficiency of audit operations. This research makes important contributions that open the door for further research in this constantly changing field, where technology is continuing to influence audit standards.

articleTitle: A Novel Phishing Website Detection Model Based on KMeansSMOTERENN and Stacking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Real-word datasets of anomaly detection often have neither symmetric nor normal but rather skewed and imbalanced class distribution, with the Majority class examples overwhelming the Minority class (es) examples [20]. However, the traditional classification algorithms consider datasets to have equal representation of each class and, therefore, equal misclassification costs [1-2], [4]. [20-22]. Both of these assumptions fall flat with class imbalanced [1-2], [4], [20-22]. Researchers have proposed several techniques to handle the class imbalance at the Data and Algorithm levels [1-2], [4], [20-22]. We propose a novel Phishing Website Detection Model based on ‘KMeansSMOTERENN’ hybrid sampling and Stacking, which is a fusion of three techniques, namely, (i) ‘KMeansSMOTERENN’ for Dataset balancing, (ii) Cost-sensitive Classification for Algorithm-balancing, and (iii) Hybrid Classification using Stacked Generalization. At Level 0 of our Hybrid Classification Model based on Stacking, we have employed Cost-Sensitive Decision Tree (DT), Cost-Sensitive Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Gaussian Naïve Bayes (GNB). At Level 1 of our Hybrid Classification Model based on Stacking, we have employed a Cost-Sensitive Logistic Regression (LR) Classifier. Through our extensive experiments with 10-fold Stratified Cross Validation X 10 runs, we have found that our novel proposed ‘KMeansSMOTERENN-STK’ Stacking model with Mean(AUROC) as 99.81 % and Mean(Accuracy) as 98.96% outperformed the ‘Original-STK’ Stacking model based on Original(Imbalanced) dataset with Mean(AUROC) as 99.24 % and Mean(Accuracy) as 96.57% We also understand that our novel proposed Phishing Website Stacking model based on KMeansSMOTERENN Hybrid Sampling and Cost-Sensitive Classification has not been proposed so far.

articleTitle: Implementation of Social Media Fake Profile Identification Using A Novel Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Online Social Networks OSNs have become more popular among individuals in today's society for usage in their regular social activities. Because of this, a significant amount of information on the users' social lives, personal lives, and professional lives is being saved on these OSNs. The growth of bogus profiles is one of the problems associated with utilizing these sites, despite the fact that they have improved the quality of people's social lives. Other problems are also associated with their use. The user data that is made accessible on OSNs is drawing the attention of academics and social analyzers, but it is also attracting the attention of hackers. These cybercriminals take advantage of the openness and vulnerability of an OSN by creating phoney identities, then use those profiles to engage in illegal, deceptive, and destructive behavior. Some examples of this behavior include identity theft, defamation, trolling, bullying, and spamming. In this research Paper, we will examine a variety of methods, both supervised and unsupervised, for determining if an Instagram profile is authentic or false. After putting a number of readily accessible Machine Learning Models through their paces, we have developed a Hybrid Model, which can be found in the file Maulik Shah Fake Profile Identifier.ipynb. This dataset has room for improvement in terms of quantity and quality metrics; however, this paper also demonstrate how accurate it can become to identify fake profile.

articleTitle: Advanced AI Approaches for Detailed Examination of Individuals Prone to Nightly Respiratory Challenges Using Medical Records
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has opened new avenues for the detailed examination of individuals prone to nightly respiratory challenges using medical records. This study presents an advanced AI approach that integrates predictive modeling, natural language processing (NLP), continuous monitoring with wearable devices, data integration, risk scoring, and anomaly detection within a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS). The proposed method offers a holistic and patient-centric solution for early detection and personalized care. In this study, we evaluated the performance of the proposed method against six original traditional methods. Performance metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, AUC-ROC, sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and heatmaps of multiple metrics, were used for the comparison. The results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method over traditional approaches. The proposed method consistently outperforms traditional methods across all performance metrics, exhibiting higher accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and AUC-ROC. The sensitivity and specificity of the proposed method exceed those of traditional methods. Additionally, the heatmap of multiple metrics reveals the comprehensive and robust nature of the proposed approach, emphasizing its ability to provide a nuanced examination of individuals prone to nightly respiratory challenges. In conclusion, this advanced AI approach, integrated within a CDSS, is poised to revolutionize the management of individuals at risk of nocturnal respiratory challenges. It enables early detection, personalized interventions, and enhanced patient outcomes. The proposed method addresses the limitations of traditional approaches by leveraging the power of AI-driven technologies, offering more accurate, efficient, and patient-focused healthcare solutions. This study contributes to the growing body of research that harnesses AI's potential to transform healthcare and underscores the importance of data-driven, individualized patient care.

articleTitle: Analysing Network Traffic and Implementing Diverse Technologies to Examine Different Components of the Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper comprehensively explores network traffic analysis using various technologies, focusing on dynamic analysis for malware study with Sandnet as an analysis environment. It investigates DNS and HTTP usage by malware, considers ethics and risk mitigation, and delves into machine learning-based IoT device identification. The study introduces a multi-stage meta classifier methodology to enhance IoT device classification, discusses network traffic predictability, and highlights intrusion detection using packet sniffers for security. By addressing these topics, the paper significantly contributes to network traffic analysis understanding, its application, and implications for network security and control.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network-Driven Healthcare Resource Management for Improved Outcomes in Infectious Disease Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The efficient administration of healthcare resources is crucial for successful infectious disease control. The merging of technology and medicine has opened the path for revolutionary changes in today's healthcare system. Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) are one of them that has the potential to radically alter the way healthcare is administered. Using ANNs, this paper presents a novel method dubbed “Dynamic Patient Risk Stratification (DyPRoN).” DyPRoN performs real-time risk assessments of individual patients, allowing for flexible distribution of medical resources. Adaptability to the dynamic nature of infectious illnesses is hindered by the prevalence of static models in conventional approaches. However, DyPRoN uses ANNs to do continuous analysis of patient data, allowing for risk classification in real time. This adaptive method improves healthcare resource management, which in turn helps with infectious disease control.

articleTitle: Interfacing a Flying Robot with OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research work is carried out to satisfy the requirements of developing industries. As per our today's requirements, safety plays a vital role in all industries. Also, a cost-effective system is required to maintain safety around our workplaces. By considering all the factors in mind, a flying robot system is made to instruct the employees to safeguard themselves by identifying near misses in the industries. The main aim of the work is to design a flying robot system with a camera to identify persons without safety equipment. So, every half an hour the images will be automatically captured by the surveillance drone and sent to the ground station which is operated by the OpenCV library for tracking objects like monitoring the crowd, detecting fire, and near misses to safeguard the employees from accidents. Here, a functional prototype is developed to achieve the goals and implement it in industrial applications.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Staying one step ahead of developing threats to national security requires rapid innovation in predictive analytic approaches. This is because it is projected that the complexity of cyberthreats will continue to rise in the coming years. This paper provides a unique technique for zero-day vulnerability prediction analysis using deep neural networks (DNN). This approach was developed thanks to the characteristics of DNN. The use of historical data on anticipated weak points is at the core of our method, which was developed with the goal of providing a proactive reaction to the issues presented by elusive threats. This strategy's major purpose was to provide a proactive reaction. The recommended technique provides an all-encompassing approach and is made up of three reliable components. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs)are used for feature extraction, LSTM networks for temporal analysis, and Random Forests, or RFs, for group learning. This method, which draws on a wide variety of academic fields, provides for a complete and trustworthy prognostic analysis. These parameters include, in addition to accuracy and precision, false positive rate (FPR), mean time to detection (MTTD), area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), recall, and F1 score.

articleTitle: Investigating How Employees’ Cybersecurity Behaviour is Affected by Their Knowledge of Cybersecurity Policy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Society currently faces more security threats in the cyberspace which is most harmful due to the cyberattacks development responsible for the complexity and volumes growth of mobile applications as well as Internet technologies. By conceptually defined as the domains for employee's cyber security behaviour as well as the development and the testing of operational measures, this study has advanced cyber security behaviour and research for awareness and investigation are added to the body of published literature on cybersecurity. Based on survey data from 579 corporate managers and professionals, the investigation for the impact of cyber security policy and awareness. The presented hypotheses are tested using ANOVA techniques and structural equation modeling. The findings indicate that employees familiar with the information and security terms and conditions of the company can have the ability to handle the jobs related to cyber security than the employees who do not have enough knowledge. Additionally, the study shows that an organizational environment as favourable for investigating that employee for the impact of cyber security policy that has positive impact on the cyber security behaviour.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing ECG Signals with Enhanced Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The tremendous advances in computing technology are directly responsible for the substantial developments that are presently taking place in the medical sector. A new age of health data analytics and predictive modeling has begun with this change, allowing medical personnel to better utilize data to improve patient outcomes, treat diseases more preventatively, and spend resources more effectively. This article investigates the role of computers in redefining healthcare analytics and the implications for the healthcare system. The advent of contemporary computers has ushered in a new era in healthcare data analytics, one in which huge amounts of data can be reviewed quickly without losing accuracy. In the healthcare business, machine learning approaches such as Random Forest, Elastic Net Regression, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Networks have become key tools for predictive modeling. These algorithms, in conjunction with the integration of several healthcare data sources, have given medical practitioners and researchers the ability to make thorough and evidence-based judgments. Contributions can take numerous forms, but some examples include the creation of novel methodologies and improvements to forecast reliability. In terms of accuracy, precision, and recall, the developed Integrative Health Data Analytics Framework beats more traditional methodologies, as proven in the preceding section.

articleTitle: The Convergence of Computational and CellularTherapies in Cancer Treatment: An AcademicReview
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the complex realm of cancer therapeutics, the past decade has witnessed two distinct but potentially complementary evolutions: the rise of cellular therapies like CAR-T, which achieved an overall response rate of up to 90% in certain hematologic malignancies, and the advancement of computational methods such as machine learning, which has shown a diagnostic accuracy of over 90% in various studies for different cancer types. This academic review seeks to explore the nascent but rapidly emerging intersection of these two fields. Utilizing machine learning algorithms, computational models have the potential to refine patient selection criteria for cellular therapies, enhancing their efficacy and safety. Conversely, the mechanistic insights gained from cellular therapies can be integrated into machine learning algorithms, enhancing their predictive accuracy. The review also touches upon the ethical and regulatory landscapes, which have become increasingly complex with advancements such as CRISPR gene-editing technologies. As the convergence of computational and cellular therapies gains momentum, its potential for transforming cancer treatment is enormous, promising more precise and personalized therapeutic strategies in the fight against this devastating disease.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Algorithms for Deep Learning in Secure Network Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rapid advancements in deep learning and network security have necessitated the development of efficient algorithms to optimize model performance. In this research, we introduce a holistic approach to enhance deep learning models using evolutionary algorithms, specifically tailored for secure network environments. Central to our methodology are three innovative algorithms: Genetic Hyperparameter Optimization (GHPO), Coevolutionary Neural Architecture Search (CoNAS), and Transfer Learning with Genetic Adaptation (TLGA). The GHPO algorithm employs genetic algorithms to optimize hyperparameters, ensuring model robustness. CoNAS, on the other hand, dynamically evolves neural network architectures alongside adversarial strategies, ensuring models remain resilient against emerging threats. Lastly, TLGA leverages transfer learning in conjunction with genetic algorithms to fine-tune pre-trained models for specific security tasks. Each algorithm is grounded in rigorous mathematical foundations, and our results indicate their efficacy in optimizing model performance across various metrics, including Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 Score, and AUC-ROC. This research provides a comprehensive toolkit for researchers and practitioners, emphasizing the potential of evolutionary algorithms in optimizing deep learning models for network security.

articleTitle: Internet of things: present state of the art, applications, protocols and enabling technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has transformed into a dynamic paradigm that connects a wide range of systems and devices in many fields. The current status of IoT is thoroughly examined in this research study, including its applications, communication protocols, supporting technologies, including prospects for the future. Researchers methodically examine how the Internet of Things (IoT) has an influence on many businesses, and social issues, including daily life using Jupyter Notebook for data analysis. In the Jupyter Notebook environment, the study highlights the value of structured data pretreatment, exploratory data analysis, and statistical inference, including visual depiction of findings. The future of IoT research is in the integration of developing technologies, better interoperability, and increased security methods.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Maize Leaf Disease Detection using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Worldwide, maize is a significant cereal crop for crop productivity, identifying diseases in the plant's leaves is essential to raise a good crop. Deep learning methods that have been used in recent years to precisely identify and categorize these serious diseases, offering a non-destructive and effective way to find maize leaf ailments. In order to detect maize leaf disease, this paper suggests using three well-liked deep learning models: VGG16, Inception V3, and EfficientNet. The models were trained and assessed using a datasets of 4000 images of three distinct maize leaf diseases and a healthy class. All three models had high accuracy rates, according to the results, though EfficientNet outperformed the other two models. The suggested method can detect and track diseases in maize crops with high accuracy and can be applied practically. It can accurately classify various diseases. The study also demonstrates that deep learning models can offer a trustworthy and effective solution for detecting crop diseases, which can aid in lowering crop losses, raising crop yields, and enhancing food security.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics and AI for Personalized Treatment Plans in Genetic Heart Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Hereditary cardiac conditions, which are the focus of this abstract, pose a serious problem for medical science. The article “Predictive Analytics and AI for Personalized Treatment Plans in Genetic Heart Diseases” explores novel techniques that utilize the potential of predictive analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to revolutionize the diagnostic and therapeutic landscape of cardiac illnesses. In this paper, we discuss how predictive analytics and AI may be used to design individualized therapies for hereditary heart problems. We take a look at the influence that genetic variants have on illness manifestation and how typical one-size-fits-all treatments fall short. Data-driven insights, risk classification, and prognostic powers are just a few of the ways in which predictive analytics is ready to transform the industry. Together with artificial intelligence (AI), which can mimic human intellect, they hold the possibility of customizing treatment strategies with unparalleled accuracy. In this article, we'll go over the value of genetic profiling and how it's being used in conjunction with machine learning algorithms to forecast things like illness susceptibility and response to therapy. The moral and legal implications of using AI in medicine are also discussed. The confidence and privacy of our patients are protected by our emphasis on ethical procedures and data protection. Predictive analytics and artificial intelligence have already started to improve the treatment of hereditary heart disorders, as evidenced by case studies and success stories. The applications are as varied as the genetic differences themselves, ranging from early illness prediction to individualized pharmaceutical regimes and surgical procedures. Predictive analytics and artificial intelligence are merging to change how we think about inherited heart problems. Readers will walk away from this piece with a solid grasp of how predictive analytics and AI might influence the future of individualized treatment strategies for those with hereditary heart disorders. All people who are afflicted with these diseases have reason to hope that this path will lead to healthier hearts, happier lives, and a better future.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Blockchained Federated Learning System and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Machine learning is an effective way to process the enormous amount of data produced in today's real life. Machine learning will, however, be hampered by privacy and scalability concerns. Federated learning (FL) can avoid privacy infringement by distributing training assignments to numerous clients and so splitting apart the central server from the local devices. However, Federated Learning continues to have issues with malicious data and single points of failure. Blockchain technology's emergence offers a trustworthy and effective method for FL deployment. In this paper, a thorough survey of blockchained FL (BCFL) system is performed. First, we examine the issues of federated learning. Then, we illustrate the problems addressed by blockchain specifically for FL and explained Blockchain-based federated learning architecture. At the end, we discussed the challenges and future research directions related with the Blockchain Federated system.

articleTitle: Software Defect Prediction for Reliability Analysis Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Ensuring software dependability is of utmost importance in today's technology-driven world, given the increasing significance of software and the potential consequences of defects, such as financial losses and security breaches. The substantial contribution of the software industry to the global economy further emphasizes the need for reliable software. While various methodologies and techniques have been introduced to enhance software reliability, challenges persist, including accurate failure parameter estimation, statistical significance determination, and dealing with imbalanced data. This paper explores machine learning algorithms and defect prediction approaches to address these challenges. The research aims to improve the accuracy of software reliability predictions by utilizing advanced techniques and methodologies. The results demonstrate a substantial improvement in accuracy, with an average of 99.36% across all software systems. The proposed technique showcases its capability to make highly accurate predictions for diverse software projects, offering valuable insights to software development teams and stakeholders. Identifying potential issues and improving software quality become more achievable with the help of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Machine-Learning-Related Methods in Cancer Patients Behavioural Investigation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Computational science and omics have been combined to open new application areas for the creation of healthcare systems that are more effective. In the current period, this integration has been extremely successful across several healthcare industries, such as cancer. In this paper, a technique for leveraging machine learning and natural language processing to examine the unstructured writings gathered from patient testimonials and personal accounts. The suggested methodology seeks to discover the actions, feelings, negative impacts, choices, and characteristics of cancer patients. The preliminary stage of our work entails text cleaning after web text extraction, where some characters and symbols are eliminated, and the texts are then tagged using Language Toolkit. Natural language processing and machine learning have been used to analyse unstructured texts from patient reviews and stories in order to undertake behaviour analysis based on the experiences of cancer patients who have posted their stories on social media. The suggested methodology locates the hidden characteristics of the cancer patients in the text, including their behaviour, feelings, side effects, choices, and demographics. Seven machine learning techniques (MLT) have been tested to see how well they perform in terms of Precision, Recall, F-measure, and Area under the operating Characteristics.

articleTitle: Real-Time Phishing Attack Detection through Advanced Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The proposed method, “EnsemblePhish,” revolutionizes real-time phishing attack detection through a comprehensive multi-step approach. It involves data collection, preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, ensemble techniques, and real-time detection. The process begins with collecting and preprocessing a labeled dataset (D) containing phishing and non-phishing instances. Feature engineering (F) extracts crucial characteristics through URL analysis, content analysis, and behavior analysis. Three distinct machine learning algorithms—Random Forest, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and a Deep Neural Network (DNN)—are chosen for training based on the extracted features. These models are combined through an ensemble method to enhance performance. Real-time detection involves continuous monitoring of network traffic, extracting real-time features, and employing the ensemble model for swift phishing prediction. The decision made leads to appropriate alerts, fortifying cybersecurity.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition Using Convolutional Neural Network

abstract: Folks who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech impairments rely heavily on sign language as a means of communication. Using sign language without an interpreter may be difficult for the majority of individuals. The goal of emotion identification systems in sign language is to identify and interpret the wide range of human emotions conveyed by body parts such as the head, arms, hands, and fingers. abstract: Data storage in the hippocampus depends critically on the dentate gyrus's effective design division. articleTitle: Investigating the Synergies between Decentralized Protocols and Edge Intelligence for a Resilient Web3.0 Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper presents the results of an in-depth investigation of how edge intelligence and decentralized protocols might work together to create a robust Web3.0 system. An exhaustive literature study is conducted, covering topics such as decentralized protocols, edge computing, and their significance to Web3.0, to provide a solid groundwork for this inquiry. This first stage of the investigation involves a comprehensive review of previous research, methods, and best practices in the field, with the goal of identifying areas where the envisioned synergy may fill a need. Empirical data culled from preexisting Web3.0 infrastructure, real-world use cases, and simulated data are all considered throughout the data collection process. Expert interviews and surveys are also used to collect qualitative information, with the goal of eliciting relevant feedback from specialists in the area. The research approach itself includes the design and execution of a series of experiments and simulations. These exploratory projects are meant to analyze how Web3.0 apps may best make use of decentralized protocols and edge intelligence. These factors comprise measurements relating to latency, throughput, data availability, scalability, and security/privacy. At the end of the study, a comparison is made between the suggested integrated solution and the status quo of centralized systems and other popular approaches to Web3.0 infrastructure. This in-depth research illuminates the benefits and drawbacks of the integration process.

articleTitle: Analyzing User Behavior in Social Media through Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Social media platforms have transformed into vast reservoirs of intricate data, accumulating unprecedented volumes of user interactions and behaviors. Advanced big data analytics techniques have enabled a deeper understanding of this data treasure trove, shedding light on the intricate landscape of social media user conduct. This comprehensive guide provides insights into the realm of big data analytics for examining user behavior on diverse social media platforms. In our digital age, users generate staggering data sharing thoughts, opinions, preferences, and emotions online, spanning text-based posts, comments, multimedia content, and network interactions. The report delves into the analytical techniques driving this field, including natural language processing, sentiment analysis, machine learning, and network analysis. It scrutinizes significant research findings from these methods, such as identifying influencer networks, sentiment trends, and predictors of user engagement. However, the field confronts challenges, emphasizing the necessity of ethical data usage and user privacy protection. It also acknowledges complexities linked to real-time data streams, unstructured content, and nuanced interpretation to mitigate errors and biases. The report explores future directions, like countering misinformation, predicting social trends, and delivering highly personalized user experiences. This overview is a valuable resource for researchers, businesses, and policymakers, providing insights into big data analytics for understanding user behavior on social media.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics and Machine Learning for Personalized Diabetes Management in Real-Time
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
