abstract: GlucoNet Pro is an innovative technology that employs predictive analytics and machine learning to provide real-time glucose level forecasts and individualized recommendations as an alternative therapy for diabetes. Patients' glucose levels, insulin dosages, food consumed, calories burned, and other unique data are continuously monitored and compiled using this method. Before a unified dataset can be created from the collected information, it must be cleansed, standardized, and aggregated. In addition to the time of day and the day of the week, we also collect information on the individual's daily routine, such as how often they exercise and when they eat. In addition to calculating the insulin sensitivity index (ISI) using glucose and insulin data, GlucoNet Pro also gives carbohydrate ratios that may be used in mealtime insulin calculations. It utilizes many machine learning methods, such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), XGBoost, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), to forecast glucose levels in real time and provide individualized recommendations. Since RNNs excel at processing sequential data, they are ideally suited for spotting the temporal correlations that occur in blood glucose patterns. Long short-term memory (LSTM) models are necessary to capture long-term relationships in glucose patterns, notwithstanding XGBoost's superiority at finding fine-grained correlations between variables. GlucoNet Pro makes use of an ensemble prediction that combines all three models to take use of their combined strengths. These estimates may then be used to tailor the system's recommendations to each particular patient, such as adjusting insulin dosing, offering dietary recommendations, or suggesting physical activity. Mean Absolute Error, Root Mean Squared Error, and F1 Score are all examples of performance assessment metrics that can be used to assess the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Methods of continuous learning are created to accommodate patients' shifting behavior as a result of different treatments and environmental modifications. Data anonymization and secure data transfer procedures have been established to protect sensitive patient information. Data privacy, security, and ethics are all issues that must be taken very seriously. Overall, GlucoNet Pro is a major step forward in the delivery of customized diabetes treatmentIt beats traditional approaches in a variety of ways, including accuracy, mistake rates, and patient satisfaction. It has the potential to enhance both the treatment of diabetes and the quality of life for individuals who suffer from it, thanks to its efficacy and flexibility, which make it a potentially helpful tool for both people with diabetes and their healthcare professionals.

articleTitle: Data Mining and AI for Early Diagnosis and Treatment Optimization in Autoimmune Encephalitis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: To guarantee high-quality and trustworthy data, we first highlight the need of preprocessing. The dataset is prepared for analysis by using standard methods such as data cleansing, normalization, and feature engineering. The technique relies heavily on the feature selection process, which picks out the most informative aspects of a large collection of clinical, imaging, and laboratory data. ReliefF (Relief Feature Selection), Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE), and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) are three of the most popular feature selection techniques utilized here. These techniques make it easier to find unique characteristics in data, which in turn makes machine learning models more effective. A logistic regression model is used to predict the likelihood of autoimmune encephalitis based on certain characteristics to make an early diagnosis. In addition, linear programming is used to incorporate treatment optimization as an optimization issue. This guarantees that the suggested strategy maximizes therapy effectiveness within the bounds of possible side effects, available resources, and individual patient preferences. By adhering to a code of ethics, we preserve patient privacy and meet all applicable regulations. The suggested technique provides a holistic answer for autoimmune encephalitis evaluation and management. It greatly enhances diagnostic precision, therapeutic efficacy, and computational efficiency by merging data mining, AI, and mathematical modeling. These developments, together with our dedication to ethical compliance, make our method a very attractive and effective option for the diagnosis and individualized treatment of autoimmune encephalitis.

articleTitle: Digitalization of Farming Knowledge Using Artificial Intelligence and Vedic Scripture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research paper investigates the digitalization of farming knowledge that refers to the process of using digital technologies and tools to improve farming practices, increase agricultural productivity, and enhance farmers' access to information and resources. This can include the use of smartphones, computers, the internet, and other digital devices to collect and analyze data, manage resources, and communicate with other farmers and experts. Digitalization of farming knowledge is becoming increasingly important as the world's population grows and the demand for food increases. With the help of digital technologies, farmers can optimize their operations, reduce costs, and increase yields. For example, farmers can use data analytics to monitor weather patterns, predict crop yields, and identify the best times to plant and harvest their crops. They can also use precision agriculture tools such as GPS and drones to manage their fields more efficiently and accurately. Eventually, the paper highlights the significance of grasping AI-driven vedic scripture approaches to back and progress digitalization of farming knowledge objectives whereas relieving cybersecurity risks.

articleTitle: Brain Image Segmentation via GLCM Features and CNN Classification for Improved Image Retrieval Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Improvement methods based on picture segmentation are commonly employed in medical image analysis. Pixels are commonly put together in groupings of varied sizes to generate an image. The available pixel intensities in an image allow for the separation of distinct image regions. Edge-based and boundary-based segmentation methods are the two primary classifications of this type of analysis. The boundary-based segmentation technique is the more widespread of the two. The image of the tumor needs to be segmented into numerous fragments, each of which can then be analyzed separately. It can annotate data and locate locations of interest in medical image processing. The issues with the existing paper are addressed in the suggested study. Feature extraction using GLCM has been used for classification of tumor images. Analysis of data in segments is routine. The CNN classifier's segments are labelled by an analytical procedure. The proposed method boosts information quality and reduces error-prone training in MRI brain tumor pictures by increasing the learning coefficient of the back propagation layer in the neural network. As a result, the current CNN Shallow Net architecture achieves a higher classification rate of 99.61% thanks to its increased specificity (98.56%) and sensitivity (98.12%). The deep web achieves a segmentation accuracy of 99.58 percent, with an additional diagnostic accuracy of 98.5 percent in identifying cancerous spots.

articleTitle: A Review of Smart Traffic Operation System for Traffic Control Using Internet of effects & Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This review encapsulates the transformative potential of integrating the Internet of Things (IoT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) in devising a Smart Traffic Operation System for urban traffic control. The contemporary urban landscape, marked by burgeoning vehicular populations and increasing instances of congestion, necessitates a paradigm shift in traffic management. Traditional systems, often static and reactive, are rendered inadequate to address the dynamism and unpredictability of modern traffic patterns. Enter the synergistic blend of IoT and RL. Through the pervasive data collection capabilities of IoT devices, the system gains real-time insights into traffic conditions, while RL facilitates adaptive and proactive decision-making. This fusion not only promises enhanced efficiency and safety but also offers environmental dividends by reducing vehicular emissions through minimized congestion. However, the successful implementation of this system hinges on addressing challenges related to data security, storage, and privacy concerns. This study comprehensively examines the intricacies of the integration under consideration, thoroughly analyzing its benefits, possible drawbacks, and the future trajectory for the management of urban traffic.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on the Integration and Impact of Bits and Bytes in the Digital Era
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Technology, data analysis, efficiency in using resources, and practical applications are just a few of the many areas that have benefited greatly from the digital era's merging of Bits and Bytes. In this in-depth research, we present a new approach to evaluating the results of this combination by using Agent-Based Modeling (ABM), Machine Learning (ML), and Network Analysis. Novel approaches are used to compare six performance assessment metrics, including ABM, ML, and others. The suggested approach shines in terms of novelty in technology, analysis of data, efficiency in the use of resources, precision, adaptability, and practicality. While ML makes use of data-driven insights, Network Analysis reveals complicated network architecture, while ABM provides a fine-grained simulation of individual agent interactions. Cost-benefit analysis demonstrates financial feasibility, while simulation and modeling improve forecasting accuracy. In contrast, time-tested techniques like ABM and ML have been shown to be mostly ineffective, particularly in terms of efficiency and practicality. Although these techniques do provide useful information, the suggested method demonstrates the superiority of integrated approaches. The findings demonstrate the importance of the comprehensive method for comprehending the far-reaching effects of Bits and Bytes amalgamation in all its forms. This research deepens our understanding of the dynamic relationship between digital data and material objects in the modern digital age. It emphasizes the significance of the suggested strategy for conducting thorough evaluations and making well-informed decisions across a wide range of fields.

articleTitle: Neural Architectures for Secure Data Transmission in Next-Gen Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: As data transmission speeds and degrees of complexity are projected to reach previously unfathomable levels soon, it is now more necessary than ever to ensure data security while it is being transported across Next-Generation Networks (NGNs). This article provides an in-depth examination of the topic “Neural Architectures for Secure Data Transmission in Next-Generation Networks.” Our research investigates the convergence of cutting-edge neural network models with the sensitive subject of network security to meet the unexpected problems provided by NGNs. The initial stages in this research are to identify and characterize the particular security concerns that NGNs confront. These problems include, for example, fast data transfer, device networking, and the proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices. The proposed strategy uses the capabilities of neural architectures to improve the overall security of NGNs. This is a description of our methodology, which is divided into three sections. This algorithm class uses autoencoders to identify even little changes in network data that may signal the presence of abnormalities. As society becomes more digitally linked, the safe transmission of such data through NGNs is steadily transforming from a technological challenge to a societal imperative. This is since NGNs are being used in an increasing variety of applications. Throughout this entire effort, neural architectures are supplied as critical enabling components for the main purpose.

articleTitle: BVKCS - A Blockchain Based e-Voting System with Key Covering Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Safety and confidentiality concerns have been constantly paramount when considering the extensive acceptance of e-voting systems. Given the significant cost-effective and political inferences of election results globally, addressing the issues of anonymity, concealment, verifiability, and legitimacy in e-voting systems is of utmost importance. Blockchain technology emerges as a promising solution to address these issues and enhance the safety, clearness, immutability, and reliability of the voting process. This paper presents the development of a Blockchain-based e-Voting System with Key Covering Scheme (BVKCS), leveraging public key cryptography and key covering method to tackle the inherent issues in e-voting schemes. BVKCS significantly improves the protection of the e-voting mechanism while upholding the reliability and legitimacy of the voting background. The results demonstrate that BVKCS outperforms current voting methods on the basis of security and performance elements (throughput and latency).

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing to Improve Optimal Customized Treatment in Clinical Decision Support Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Through computational methods and natural language processing, sentiment analysis recognizes and classifies the sentiments conveyed by personal statements. The current effort aims to apply entity semantic analysis to construct a test case for a healthcare system for individualized medication. To assess if a patient's response to a cure, service, therapy, etc., is positive, negative, or neutral pharmaceutical data analysis is used. After a more thorough investigation of the patient surveys and an excellent diagnostic decision system, the gathered orientations were compared. To classify the pharmaceutical data analysis and contrast, sentiment polarity methods based on machine learning are also applied. Support vector machines (SVM), random forest classification, linear SVC, and multinomial NB are the most used analytic Sklearn techniques. It has been discovered that the SVM method achieves better accuracy than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Spam E-Mail Detection Using Logistic Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rise of spam mail, or junk mail, has emerged as a significant nuisance in the modern digital landscape. This surge not only inundates user's email inboxes but also exposes them to security threats, including malicious content and phishing attempts. To tackle this escalating problem, the proposed machine learning-based strategy that employs Logistic Regression for accurate spam mail prediction. This research is creating an effective and precise spam classification model that effectively discerns between legitimate and spam emails. To achieve this, we harness a meticulously labeled dataset of emails, each classified as either spam or non-spam. This model is to apply preprocessing techniques to extract pertinent features from the email content, encompassing word frequencies, email header data, and other pertinent textual attributes. The choice of Logistic Regression as the foundational classification algorithm is rooted in its simplicity, ease of interpretation, and appropriateness for binary classification tasks. To process train the model using the annotated dataset, refining its hyper parameters to optimize its performance. By incorporating feature engineering and dimensionality reduction methodologies, bolster the model's capacity to generalize effectively to unseen data. Our evaluation methodology encompasses rigorous experiments and comprehensive performance contrasts with other well-regarded machine learning algorithms tailored for spam classification. The assessment criteria encompass accuracy, precision, recall, and the F1 score, offering a holistic appraisal of the model's efficacy. Furthermore, we scrutinize the model's resilience against diverse forms of spam emails, in addition to its capacity to generalize to new data instances. This model is to findings conclusively demonstrated that our Logistic Regression-driven spam mail prediction model achieves a competitive performance standing when juxtaposed with cutting-edge methodologies. The model adeptly identifies and sieves out spam emails, thereby cultivating a more trustworthy and secure email environment for users. The interpretability of the model lends valuable insights into the pivotal features contributing to spam detection, thereby aiding in the identification of emerging spam patterns.

articleTitle: Cryptographic Key Management Using Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The study's findings present a completely novel method for cryptographic key management that makes use of neural network techniques. Unlike more classic strategies such as the Caesar Cipher and the Vigenère Cipher, our suggested method emphasizes the usage of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for greater key generation. This method is also unusual in that it employs convolutional neural networks. Therefore, both productivity and safety improve. In terms of scalability and flexibility, recurrent neural networks (RNNs) beat one-time pads and enigma machines for key distribution. Security and efficiency are raised to a greater extent when generative adversarial networks (GANs), a more advanced kind of rotation scheduling than static rotation techniques, are used. These extensive tests indicate that our suggested technique for creating, distributing, and rotating cryptographic keys reaches outstanding performance levels. These levels were determined by measuring the system's capacity to generate, distribute, and rotate keys. This suggests that the technology has the potential to greatly improve data security in online environments. This research provides a novel and practical approach to cryptographic key management, with significant implications for strengthening cybersecurity and protecting private data.

articleTitle: Robust Anomaly Detection in Network Traffic using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The exact detection of anomalies in computer network traffic is crucial to network protection. This study presents a novel approach to achieving the stated goal: the use of deep learning models. To correctly capture the temporal, geographic, and probabilistic aspects of network data, the recently developed approach integrates deep autoencoders (DAE), variable autoencoders (VAE), and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks. The proposed strategy surpassed six industry-standard solutions in terms of accuracy, recall, F1-score, AUC-ROC, false positive rate (FPR), and false negative rate (FNR). This was demonstrated via performance reviews. Furthermore, the proposed technique makes optimum use of currently available resources. This study improves network security by employing more robust anomaly detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Smart Environment and Plant Disease Monitoring with Analysis System in Agricultural Field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Agriculture is deemed to be the most significant segment in India. The main objective of this research work is to monitor plant diseases and analyze the system using a smartphone. The remote monitoring framework, including temperature, stickiness and soil humidity sensors, a microcontroller, an ultrasonic sensor, a camera, and a GSM module is validated for effective environment observation. The technology could offer a fresh method for farming to obtain information related to agriculture. In this monitoring system of agricultural diseases, the main aim is to achieve disease monitoring information and collections of the results are detected by Android application through GSM. ARM processor is used for analog to digital converter (ADC) and sends the gathered information to portable through GSM. An IP web camera is occasionally empowered to catch the plant leaf picture for disease checking and an ultrasonic sensor is utilized with the end goal of plant development checking. It uses a soil battery to drive the temperature sensor to foster plant development checking framework and plant infection observation, likewise adaptive android application to screen such circumstances by utilizing this innovation to accomplish a green hardware framework.

articleTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Humanoid Future of Robotics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Humanoid robots are now developing as a viable area of study and development in the field of robotics, which has seen major improvements in recent years. Robots that resemble and mimic humans are called humanoids, and they may work alongside people in a variety of contexts. With a focus on their possible uses, technical difficulties, and societal effects, this research study intends to investigate and assess the future possibilities of humanoid robotics. This research intends to offer insightful perspectives into the future of this quickly developing technology by assessing the state of humanoid robots today and analyzing trends and advances in the industry.

articleTitle: Optimalization of Tiktok Platform for Green Business Digital Marketing Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research based on business’ need to improve performance and the existence of opportunities on Tiktok platform for marketing. The purpose of the research is to find out the application of digital marketing to sales strategies and to measure the performance of eco-friendly business Earthy Worthy. This research method uses a qualitative approach by doing documentation and triangulation techniques for business performance. The study shows the use of Tiktok as a digital marketing medium has an impact on increasing sales and business performance. The conclusion is the use of Tiktok as digital marketing medium has an impact to better business performance. Utulization of Tiktok can be done through creating creative content, live shopping, and using the features called Tiktok Shop Digital Marketing, Business Performance, Social Media Commerce

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Examination of Satellite Stereo Triplet Image Matching for Digital Elevation Model (DEM) Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Satellite-derived Digital Elevation Models (DEMs) are of utmost significance in a wide range of applications, such as analysing terrain, urban planning, navigation and transportation, managing disasters, hydrological modelling, and monitoring natural resources. These applications collectively contribute to enhancing our comprehension, management, and planning of Earth's surface and its valuable resources. This research paper delves into exploring diverse methods and satellites employed for automatically generating DEMs from satellite stereo triplet images. The study primarily emphasises the importance of comprehending satellite image geometry, integrating suitable matching techniques, and developing open-source workflows to enhance the precision of automatically generated DEMs. Moreover, it aims to furnish valuable insights for future studies in this domain.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Framework for Data-Driven Management of Chronic Pain with Machine Learning and Advanced Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Chronic pain management presents a complex challenge in healthcare, demanding innovative approaches for effective intervention. This research introduces a comprehensive framework leveraging machine learning and advanced analytics to address this challenge. In addition, the platform employs cutting-edge analytics to sift through the ocean of healthcare data in search of knowledge applicable to real-world scenarios. By identifying trends in patients' responses to therapies and disclosing associations between various aspects of lifestyle and pain levels, analytics are crucial for determining the most effective method for treating chronic pain. The proposed methodology integrates predictive modeling, forecasting, and treatment optimization algorithms to personalize chronic pain management strategies. By harnessing patient-specific data, including historical pain records, genetic factors, and lifestyle information, the framework aims to enhance accuracy in predicting pain severity, forecasting future pain episodes, and optimizing treatment plans.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Resources and Hospital Capacity Planning for Critical Diseases using AI and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Critical illness management relies heavily on the strategic allocation of resources and the well-planned construction of hospital infrastructure. In this study, we propose to adopt the “AI-OptiHealth” technique, which employs artificial intelligence (AI) and data mining technologies to revolutionize resource allocation and capacity planning during severe disease epidemics. We evaluate the results of this approach in depth and compare them to those of more traditional methods. Our proposed AI-OptiHealth system combines the Patient Risk Prediction (PRP) algorithm with the Resource Demand Forecasting (RDF) algorithm and the Resource Allocation Optimization (RAO) algorithm. Three distinct modules, the Resource Demand Forecaster (RDF), the Resource Allocation Optimizer (RAO), and the Patient Risk Profiler (PRP), work together to improve resource allocation in response to dynamic situations. The results show that the AI-OptiHealth system outperforms the status quo in a number of key areas. Better patient outcomes can be achieved by accurate risk assessment and strategic use of resources. In addition to being very flexible, the method also takes ethical considerations into account when allocating resources. The AI-OptiHealth method represents a major advancement in recent years for allocating healthcare resources and planning capacity for critical diseases. Its use of AI and data mining yields resource allocation techniques that are highly efficient, malleable, and ethical, eventually leading to better patient care during pandemics. This research emphasizes the need for novel approaches to healthcare management in order to address the enduring challenges of the sector.

articleTitle: Prediction of Delays in Invoice Payments Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Accounts Receivable (AR), is the most valuable asset of an organization. If it is not managed effectively, it can cause the firm serious financial hardships. Identifying data patterns is essential to understanding AR in order to forecast whether it is guaranteed that an invoice can be paid in a timely manner or else it'll be delayed. It is extremely important for large organizations that deal with thousands of vendors to fulfill their service level agreements with them to avoid penalties. The data is collected from a multinational organization consisting of the past two year's transactions. The research has been conducted by reviewing numerous papers related to invoice processing and different methodologies used to estimate consumer payment in AR. This paper is intended to showcase a supervised modeling solution. Predicting the payment outcomes of newly created invoices is essential for facilitating collection actions tailored to each invoice or customer. Since this is a classification problem, an ensemble method of Random Forest and Extreme Gradient Boosting algorithms has been applied. By achieving the highest accuracy, it is possible to determine if the payment for an invoice will be done on or before the due date and provide estimates to the customers regarding delays. This can assist the collection team in prioritizing customers and facilitating their day-to-day work. It is estimated that implementing the model to prioritize the work of the Collection Management team, shall result in a substantial amount of savings. Consequently, the team would contact respective customers or account holders during the period in which the invoices are open, thereby reducing the organization's accounts receivable.

articleTitle: The Integration of Stream Data Models in Modern Transportation Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The study proposal proposes an innovative strategy for managing modern transport networks, with an emphasis on the coordinated use of analytics, real-time data processing, and dynamic decision-making utilizing stream data models. To create a solid infrastructure for real-time data analysis, it is required to use a diverse set of data sources, such as sensors, GPS devices, traffic cameras, and mobile application software. A strategy for reaching this goal is described below. The real-time system that integrates transportation models, artificial intelligence, and data mining is at the core of this strategy. In addition to monitoring and assessment, one of the key responsibilities of this system is to develop the transportation network. Without this framework as a foundation, the method would be worthless. This collaborative effort provides proactive traffic control, efficient route planning, and event prediction in real time. The application of machine learning in predictive analytics and traffic analysis, which together give solid traffic forecasts, prompts the creation of tactics that cut wait times and enhance productivity. Event detection algorithms are critical for ensuring commuter safety and reducing wait times in the event of an emergency. Using cloud-hosted data processing technologies, the idea manages massive amounts of real-time data. This is critical for data collection, processing, and storage methods. Finally, we believe that the development of an intelligent transportation network—one that can continually learn, adapt, and drive itself—will result in less traffic, more safety, shorter travel times, and environmentally friendly legislation and practices. To address the ever-increasing demands placed on dynamic urban settings, it is believed that the technique developed would transform current transport networks into more responsive, user-friendly, and efficient systems.

articleTitle: Machine Learning with Artificial Intelligence: And Towards a Broad Consensus
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study explores the complex interplay between machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI), highlighting the pressing requirement for a broad consensus framework. This study uses the Jupyter Notebook for analysis and a secondary research methodology to examine the current state of machine learning (ML) in AI applications. It carefully examines the benefits, and difficulties, along with ethical considerations inherent in this integration, illuminating the complexity of AI research. This research also highlights critical research gaps and provides doable tactics to encourage cooperation among many stakeholders, including academia, business, government, and civil society. It emphasizes the crucial part that these consensus frameworks play in offering moral direction for ethical AI innovation as well as deployment. This research acts as a crucial compass for decision-makers, developers, researchers, as well as ethicists in a world that is being progressively altered by AI. When society navigates this revolutionary technological environment, it reinforces the value of ethical concerns and cooperative efforts. It provides insightful information about the dynamic junction of AI and ML.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach for Heart Disease Detection using Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease stands as one of the most formidable health conditions worldwide, impacting a vast number of people globally. In this paper, we introduce a hybrid system that utilizes machine learning methods for identifying cardiac problems. Machine learning (ML) is extensively implemented in the medical industry worldwide, aiding in the prevention of heart conditions and locomotor disorders by analyzing extensive volumes of complex healthcare data. Our focus in this study revolves around identifying individuals with a higher likelihood of developing cardiovascular disease based on specific medical criteria. For this study, we utilized a 303-row, 14-property online UCI dataset. To validate approximately 7 of these 14 qualities, it's essential to test the effectiveness of several methods. Our analysis is based on supervised learning techniques—K-nearest neighbor, support vector machines, random forests, and decision trees. Experimental findings demonstrate the effectiveness, accuracy, sensitivity, and precision of K-nearest neighbor (8 neighbors) compared to SVM, Naive Bayes, Decision Tree Classifier with four or eighteen features, and Random Forest classifiers. We employed feature selection methods to enhance classification accuracy and reduce execution time. Additionally, we fine-tuned hyperparameters and applied best practices for model evaluation using the LOOCV method. Classifier performances were evaluated using performance measurement metrics. Implementing this approach significantly improves the model's ability to predict cardiac arrest accurately for any individual. In contrast to previously used classifiers such as Naive Bayes, the current model's accuracy, when utilizing logistic regression and KNN, proved highly promising in predicting indications of a cardiac ailment in a person. Evaluating the classification algorithm's ability to accurately detect cardiovascular disease is pivotal, reducing stress and enhancing treatment while cutting costs. This program has provided insights into predicting the prevalence of cardiovascular disease and was executed using Python.

articleTitle: Challenges in Implementing Real-Time Stream Data in Bioinformatics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Creating efficient and adaptable methods for data analysis is crucial in bioinformatics as the amount of real-time stream data continues to grow. We describe an integrated approach that combines complex event processing (CEP), online machine learning (ML), and data stream clustering to solve the problems associated with real-time stream data processing in bioinformatics. This method brings together online machine learning, complex event processing (CEP), and clustering in data streams. Flexible, all-encompassing, and real-time research are just a few of the ways in which this innovative approach excels above more conventional ones. We use several key performance indicators to show how our approach improves upon the status quo. In this study, we looked at ten different strategies and compared their performance over a range of metrics. One of these features was the flexibility to grow or shrink without sacrificing data security, performance, latency, accuracy, or any combination thereof. According to the findings, the novel approach performs better than the conventional methods in almost all respects. Better scalability, resource usage, data integrity, throughput, latency, accuracy, and scalability were all benefits. The proposed method was proven to be a more efficient choice for real-time data processing in bioinformatics due to its increased flexibility and comprehensiveness. This allows us to surmount the obstacles given by the volatile character of biological data. Bio informaticists and other medical professionals may use its flexibility and real-time analytical abilities in a variety of contexts, from analyzing genetic data to monitoring patients' health.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Founded Domain Vocabulary Creation for Enriched Concept Map Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Knowledge may be successfully organised, represented, and shown with the use of something called a concept map. A concept map is a form of knowledge representation graph that is more loosely semantic. A clear and succinct summary of the material needs to be presented via the idea map. This overview should be simple to grasp. An essential component of a concept map is its ability to accurately represent and organise ideas while simultaneously providing access to the greatest possible amount of information. In the ever-evolving realm of domain vocabulary creation, various methodologies have been posited, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. This study embarks on a comparative analysis of traditional techniques vis-à-vis a newly proposed machine learning (ML)-based approach, evaluated across three tables focusing on different dimensions: accuracy and computational performance, robustness and versatility, and user experience and efficiency. Through a comprehensive comparison, we aimed to discern the most optimized method, and our results markedly indicate the ML-based approach's superiority across most parameters. From achieving the highest precision, recall, and F1-score, to its adaptability across languages and domains, and its intuitive interface coupled with real-time operation capabilities, the proposed method stands out as a next-gen solution for domain vocabulary creation.

articleTitle: Advanced Cognitive Assessment Model for Predicting Fall Risks among Elderly Patients in Hospital Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The increasing incidence of falls among the elderly in hospital settings necessitates the development of advanced predictive models. This paper introduces a comprehensive cognitive assessment model designed to predict fall risks among elderly patients in hospital environments. By integrating cognitive assessment scores, patient demographics, and environmental factors, the model offers a holistic approach to fall risk prediction. Three distinct machine learning algorithms, namely Neural Network-based Fall Risk Prediction (NN-FRP), Support Vector Machine-based Fall Risk Prediction (SVM-FRP), and K-Nearest Neighbors-based Fall Risk Prediction (KNNFRP), are explored. The culmination of this research is the Ensemble-based Fall Risk Prediction (E-FRP), which synergistically combines the strengths of the three individual models. Preliminary results indicate that the ensemble model outperforms its constituent models in terms of accuracy and convergence time.

articleTitle: Multimodal Data Fusion and Machine Learning for Comprehensive Management of Parkinson's Disease in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a neurological ailment that affects millions of individuals throughout the world. Successful treatment will greatly enhance the quality of life for those who have it. To effectively treat Parkinson's disease, this study investigates how multimodal data and machine learning technology might be combined. To improve illness diagnosis, symptom severity prediction, and medication efficacy evaluation, the suggested technique draws from a broad variety of data sources such as clinical records, medical imaging, and sensor data. In this study, novel data fusion and analytic techniques are used to generate a comprehensive picture of the patient's health. Classification and prediction can be accomplished using either the Random Forest, Convolutional Neural Network, or Long Short-Term Memory Network machine learning techniques. Data fusion and feature extraction, the first steps in building reliable models, are graphically shown by a set of mathematical equations. Data presented in the tables of comparison show how much of an improvement the proposed remedy represents over the status quo. This strategy has the potential to significantly alter the way doctors treat Parkinson's disease, leading to better outcomes for patients and setting a new standard for healthcare in general.

articleTitle: Harnessing the Power of Deep Learning Algorithms for High-Accuracy Plant Disease Diagnosis and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Plants and agriculture are crucial for human life and economic status. With inadequate management practices resulting in reduced yields and diseases impacting plant health, disease diagnosis is crucial for reducing crop losses and promoting sustainability in agricultural processes. Farmers often need more expertise in leaf diseases, which negatively impacts productivity. In this paper, we propose a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for plant disease detection, achieving remarkable levels of accuracy, reaching 99% for 25 distinct categories of plant diseases and 93.4% for a subset of 5 classes of diseases. The model undergoes training for 60 epochs, with a 32-bit batch size and a dropout rate of 0.5, to prevent overfitting and enhance generalization. This research contributes to precise farming by developing a robust, high-performance solution for predicting plant diseases. The CNN-based method demonstrates the significance of sophisticated machine-learning techniques in addressing agricultural problems.

articleTitle: Advancing Brain Tumor Diagnosis through Machine Learning and the Power of Combined CNN and RNN in Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: A precise and prompt diagnosis is essential for efficient treatment planning in the complex and possibly fatal illness known as brain tumours. The diagnosis of brain tumours through diagnostic imaging information, such as MRI, or magnetic resonance imaging, scans, has shown considerable promise during the past few years. This research provides a thorough analysis of different machine learning methods and algorithms applied to brain tumour identification. The article starts off by talking about the difficulties in detecting brain tumours, such as the natural complexity and variety of brain tumour pictures. The following section gives an overview of the many machine learning methods used in this industry, including more contemporary techniques like deep learning as well as more established ones like SVM, ANN, and decision trees. To address the challenges posed by the complexity and variety of brain tumors. This study proposes an innovative machine learning-based approach that leverages the power of recurrent neural networks (RNNs) in addition to convolutional neural networks (CNNs). RNNs are particularly well-suited for processing sequential data, such as sequential slices of MRI scans. By incorporating RNNs, our model can capture the temporal dependencies and spatial relationships present in the sequential MRI slices, leading to more accurate brain tumor detection. The suggested technique demonstrates promising outcomes in precisely detecting brain cancers, showcasing the potential of combined machine learning, including both CNNs and RNNs, in advancing medical image analysis methods for more accurate detection and diagnosing of brain tumors. . By making it possible to identify and diagnose brain tumors early and precisely, this discovery has the potential to have a substantial impact on the area of medical imaging and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Cross Model Verification of Intrusion Detection System on IoT Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The IDS to secure IoT devices have become so important with the tremendous growth in the field of IoT. The potential damage to the IoT network by different types of attacks is increasing rapidly with the increased use of IoT devices. Therefore, IDS has become an essential defense tool against the vulnerable attacks. These IoT devices are to be continuously monitored for attacks, hence IDS software is deployed to detect anomalies. Today ML and DL algorithms which are subset of Artificial Intelligence are widely used in the intrusion detection system to detect attacks. In this research work, the cross verification of the outputs of IDS using CNN on three different datasets namely NSLKDD, IDS2018 and IOTID20 are explored. Intrusion detection in the context of the IoT has become a critical concern due to the proliferation of connected devices and evolving attack techniques. Traditional IDS often struggle to adapt to the unique challenges posed by IoT environments. This article explores the application of CNNs for intrusion detection in IoT and discusses the significance of cross-model verification to enhance security and accuracy. The AUC score yielded an accuracy of more than 80-95% in 15 epochs in all the three datasets. Both binary and multiclassification are done. Further it is observed that the ROC curve is above the diagonal line signifying the model is excellent. Moreover, a new feature selection algorithm SELBEST is proposed based on Stochastic gradient descent, which significantly reduced the features. Also, the classification time is reduced and the performance is increased.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Innovations for IoT Network Security and Data Privacy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research introduces a comprehensive methodology for the redesign of Cloud Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with a primary focus on improving reliability. The methodology is structured into key steps, commencing with an in-depth literature review to understand the current state of cloud computing, SLAs, and reliability. Collaboration with stakeholders, including cloud service providers and customers, is emphasized to gauge specific needs, expectations, and pain points. A set of critical performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics is defined to measure the reliability of cloud services, encompassing factors like uptime, response times, security, and support responsiveness. The core of the methodology revolves around the customization of SLAs. Cloud service providers are benchmarked based on their adherence to redesigned SLAs, aiding customers in selecting providers that align with their reliability requirements. The methodology undergoes rigorous testing under diverse scenarios, including load testing, security testing, and disaster recovery simulations. By educating customers and providers about the benefits and implications of these agreements, the adoption of redesigned SLAs is facilitated. A feedback loop is established to continuously improve the SLAs based on customer insights and experiences.

articleTitle: The Evolution and Integration of Seamlessly Synchronized Data Streams in Modern Businesses
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In today's age of data-driven decision making, it is crucial for organizations to keep all of their data streams in perfect sync. Research methods and findings from an investigation into “The Evolution and Integration of Seamlessly Synchronized Data Streams in Modern Businesses” Data analytics, principal component analysis, k-means clustering, and autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) are all included into the suggested technique. This all-encompassing method permits a thorough investigation into the development and incorporation of data synchronization in the present-day corporate environment. The results analysis demonstrates that the suggested approach outperforms the conventional ones. We compared the suggested strategy to six established alternatives. Data analysis, extensive analysis, mathematical modeling, practical insights, scalability, and overall performance are just a few of the areas where the suggested technique excels above conventional approaches. These distinctions are highlighted, and the data are represented robustly by four various forms of visualizations: scatter plots, pie charts, box plots, and heatmaps. The importance of synchronized data streams in contemporary enterprises is highlighted by our research, which highlights the need for a multidimensional and data-driven approach to this topic. The findings of this study may help businesses enhance customer service, save costs, and streamline operations by enhancing their data synchronization techniques.

articleTitle: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence Effect on e-Commerce: A Framework for Key Research Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This paper examines how artificial intelligence (AI) is revolutionizing e-commerce, transforming how businesses operate and the goods that customers purchase. From personalized recommendation systems to supply chain optimisation and customer service, AI technologies are transforming e-commerce. Businesses, consumers, and academics all face possibilities and difficulties as a result of this shift. We give an outline of AI's impact on e-commerce as well as suggest a framework for the major research topics influencing the future of the sector. The study evaluates the use of AI in e-commerce by looking at both technical and economical applications. Neglecting AI ethics alongside privacy may decrease income, harm reputation, trigger regulatory measures, and lose consumer trust. Data gathering, Python-based data analysis in Jupyter Notebook, and a qualitative assessment of industry norms are all included in the process. This study helps to comprehend the enormous effects that AI is having on e-commerce in order to develop solutions to the problems and possibilities it presents.

articleTitle: Empowering Multisource Unsupervised Domain Adaptation through Domain Alignment Layers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Since its debut, Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA), sometimes known as just UDA and frequently abbreviated as UDA, has swiftly acquired importance in the fields of computer vision and machine learning. The primary purpose of the Unified Data Architecture (UDA) is to combine regions with dramatically different patterns of data availability. Performance metrics are becoming increasingly important in conversations about the fast-growing disciplines of data analytics and machine learning. This study contrasts conventional machine learning algorithms with the newly developed DFAP approach. Among the techniques provided are SVM, Random Forest, KNN, Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, Gradient Boosting, Neural Network, AdaBoost, and XGBoost. These are only a few of the approaches. Here, we look at the results of this comparison. The information used to develop these images clearly shows the benefits and drawbacks of each technique. These visualizations can provide practitioners and academics with helpful information to help them determine the best approach for the projects they are working on. The suggested DFAP approach performed admirably, particularly in terms of accuracy, suggesting that it might be effective in some specific cases. The approach's inventive technique is offered as proof of this.

articleTitle: Data Mining and AI Approaches for Early Detection and Management of Gastrointestinal Disorders
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study presents an innovative integration of Data Mining and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to advance early detection and management of gastrointestinal disorders. The methodology encompasses data preprocessing, feature selection, model development, and continuous monitoring for timely intervention. Preprocessing involves standardization and normalization to ensure consistent feature scaling and distribution. Addressing missing values and outliers is achieved using suitable methods such as mean imputation and robust statistical techniques. Feature selection methods, including Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA), aid in identifying the most informative features associated with gastrointestinal disorders. Support Vector Machines (SVM) excels in binary classification, distinguishing healthy individuals from those with gastrointestinal disorders. Deep Neural Network (DNN) is employed for non-linear feature representation and classification. In conclusion, the proposed method showcased superior performance in critical parameters when compared to traditional methodologies. Its enhanced accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and computational efficiency position it as a promising approach in the domain of Data Mining and AI for early detection and management of gastrointestinal disorders. This innovation holds potential for significant advancements, promising improved healthcare outcomes and better lives for individuals suffering from gastrointestinal disorders.

articleTitle: Taksh: A Decentralized Social Media App
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Social media has ushered in a revolutionary shift in global communication, offering an expansive platform for the exchange of ideas, concepts, lifestyle, achievements and many more. Nevertheless, alongside its copious advantages, the utilization of social media is constrained by a multitude of challenges. These encompass the propagation of misinformation, the inadequacy of efficient content monitoring, the prevalence of digital piracy, the vulnerability to data breaches, susceptibility to identity fraud, and the dissemination of false news. These platforms engage in the surveillance of our everyday interactions to facilitate tailored advertisements and generate profits. To tackle this issue, our proposal incorporates the capabilities of blockchain technology. This decentralized social media platform would usher in a fresh era of data control, ownership, and freedom of speech.

articleTitle: Real-Time Facial Recognition in Computer Vision for Industrial Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In industrial security, facial recognition is crucial because it allows for precise and timely identification of people, which is necessary to protect assets and guarantee worker safety. This research presents a unique solution to the problems of real-time face recognition in industrial settings by combining state-of-the-art technology. “Deep Face Recognition with FaceNet,” “Real-Time Face Detection with Faster R-CNN,” and “Privacy-Preserving Techniques with Homomorphic Encryption” are all integrated into the suggested way to produce a secure and private system. Through a series of tests, we show in our studies how successful this strategy is. Firstly, Faster R-CNN achieves high accuracy face detection with great efficiency in real-time video streams. FaceNet then does a great job of identifying these faces and associating them with recognized people, providing accurate identification. Our method relies heavily on privacy preservation, which is accomplished by using homomorphic encryption. This guarantees the confidentiality of face data even as it is being recognized. It uses deep learning to adjust to changing situations and provides real-time accuracy for quick recognition. Moreover, it is unique due to its use of homomorphic encryption, which protects users' privacy while identifying them. To sum up, our method is a major step forward in real-time face recognition for industrial security.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Diffusion MRI Alignment: Integrating Deep Learning with Advanced Registration Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Diffusion Magnetic Resonance Imaging (dMRI) has emerged as a groundbreaking imaging technique, capturing the intricate motion of water molecules within biological tissues, particularly the neural fibers in the brain. The precision in aligning dMRI data is pivotal for subsequent analytical processes, such as tractography or group studies. This paper introduces three innovative algorithms that amalgamate the prowess of deep learning with state-of-the-art registration techniques, aiming to redefine the landscape of dMRI alignment. The first algorithm, DeepRegNet, harnesses deep learning to directly ascertain the required transformation for alignment. The second, Diffusion Tensorbased Registration (DTR), utilizes the inherent diffusion tensor information in dMRI data, aligning images based on tensor matching. The third, DeepDiffusionNet, is a fusion of deep learning and non-linear warping, ensuring accurate alignment with smooth deformations. Through rigorous testing, these algorithms have demonstrated their potential in enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of dMRI alignment.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study For Polyp Segmentation From Colonoscopy Video Using Deep Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Colorectal Cancer is now one of the prominent cause of cancerous death worldwide. As its early detection and prevention are critical tasks and depends on size and shapes of polyps. From past few years, deep learning is emerging as a powerful approach for addressing this challenge. This abstract provides an overview of the deep learning perspective for polyp segmentation, highlighting key advances, methods, and their clinical efficiency. Deep learning models, especially Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have revolutionized medical image analysis, including polyp segmentation. CNNs excel at learning hierarchical features directly from colonoscopy images, enabling pixelwise segmentation with high accuracy. Architectures like U-Net, Mask R-CNN, and their variants have been tailored to the specific requirements of polyp segmentation, capturing intricate details and variations in polyp appearances. In this paper, we propose a novel approach that leverages the metaphor of a “chef” to optimize polyp segmentation using a lightweight neural network. Inspired by a chef's ability to finesse ingredients into a delectable dish, our method fine-tunes a lightweight network to achieve real-time polyp segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Measuring Impact of HDFC Groups' Strategic Merger: An Event Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: It was announced on April 4, 2022 that HDFC Ltd. and HDFC Bank will be merging into a single entity. The initiative received acceptance of the Reserve Bank of India. A research was conducted to investigate how the news of the merger impacted the stock price of HDFC Bank. The merger of HDFC Bank and HDFC Ltd. signified a significant step forward for the banking and financial industry in India. The purpose of this research is to investigate the effect that the amalgamation created on the stock prices of both companies. The sample for this study is sixty days after the announcement of the merger. The announcement day is the date of the merger. The researcher also looked at whether or not the news of the merger had a favorable impact on the day of the event, as well as in the time leading up to and post the event. For the purpose of analyzing the data spanning 11 days, Event Study, and more specifically the OLS Market Model, was used. The investigation concluded that the declaration of the merger was the sole reason for unusual return on the day of the event. According to the findings of the research, HDFC bank shareholders saw abnormal profits before to the event, but they did not experience any gains during the crisis. According to the findings of the study performed, HDFC Bank investors obtained an amazing return when the announcement of the merger with HDFC Ltd. was made. According to the article, the merger resulted in an increase in the stock values of both HDFC Bank and HDFC Ltd. The aberrant returns that HDFC Ltd. experienced on the day of the occurrence and the day after it occurred were statistically significant. There was a statistically significant difference between the atypical returns of HDFC Bank on the day of the occurrence and two days following it. Both companies saw positive and statistically significant abnormal returns on their investments. When the news of the merger was made, the market responded positively, which indicated that investors believed both companies would gain from the combination. Investors and regulators in the banking and financial industries really need to have this report.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Strategies in Quantum-Resistant Network Security Protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The cryptographic techniques that underpin current network security standards run the risk of becoming outdated due to the advancement of quantum computing. Researchers and industry professionals are working to create novel strategies for protecting the privacy of confidential data in the post-quantum age. In this study, we explore the possibility that a mix of quantum-resistant network security protocols and machine learning techniques might serve as a potent countermeasure against the growing threat posed by quantum computers. This is the latest addition to the way we've been talking about it. By employing machine learning, we can enhance the effectiveness and adaptability of encryption systems, strengthening network security, therefore. Furthermore, we discuss the potential contributions of several machine learning methods, including neural network-based approaches, pattern recognition, and anomaly detection, to the field of quantum-resistant security protocols. Considering the emergence of quantum computing, combining machine learning with quantum-resistant encryption has become a crucial tactic for protecting sensitive data. This cooperative endeavor, which will be advantageous to both sides, clarifies a crucial tactic. Our results demonstrate that machine learning offers the potential to be a powerful partner in the never-ending fight to protect digital assets. The understanding that our results provide is crucial for building safe networks in the era of quantum computing.

articleTitle: End-to-End Network Security Solutions using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In recent times, network security threats have evolved, demanding sophisticated solutions. This research introduces an innovative “End-to-End Network Security Solution” harnessing the power of deep learning algorithms. The study integrates three foundational deep learning algorithms: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for intrusion detection, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for behavioral analysis, and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for anomaly detection. The research commences with data preprocessing, followed by the application of CNNs to classify network packets as normal or potentially malicious. Further, LSTM networks delve into the temporal behavior of network traffic, flagging deviations from established patterns. Lastly, GANs play a crucial role in identifying subtle anomalies by understanding the intrinsic data distribution of normal network traffic and contrasting it against synthesized data. Comprehensive evaluations showcase the proposed method's efficacy in comparison to existing approaches, making it a promising solution for modern-day network security challenges.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review and Future Perspective of Android Malware Detection Based Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: After becoming incorporated into normal daily life, smartphones gained access to private data. On most mobile devices running Android OS, malware gathers private user data without the user's awareness. Malware frameworks are becoming more and more complicated, making it challenging to identify them. Traditionally, researchers avoided detection processes that employed static and dynamic analysis by employing strategies such as encryption, packaging, and code obfuscation, but the current study reveals that machine learning-based identification of malicious code for Android is an efficient methodology. The effectiveness of the extracted features obtained as a result of malware detection indicates the efficiency of malware detection analysis. The positive aspects of previous reviews have been augmented in our paper by surveying in a variety of areas. Leading malware analysis tools used on Android systems were thoroughly examined. To fill detection gaps, it is necessary to improve effective measures and detection efficiency with regard to advanced malware. A summary of the difficulties addressed throughout the creation of malware classifiers is also included in the paper. The research work in this paper is concerned with the potential of detecting malware targeting Android devices using machine learning.

articleTitle: DEEP Learning Approach Using Modified Auto-Encoder for PPG Signal Compression
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: PPG (Photoplethysmography) signal measures the heart's pumping capacity which uses a light-emitting diode to track the blood flow which controls the actions of the heart rate. PPG is widely used in all healthcare applications, which range from monitoring a person's oxygen saturation level within the ICU (intensive care units) for measuring the pulse rate in preferably devices that are wrist-worn. In this research, we formulate an algorithm called as bioelectrical signals with encoder and decoder and feature engineering). This combined method incorporates a method by combining FE and encoder-decoder. In the end, our algorithm differentiates between relevant tasks and gets all the features required for classification. Our proposed method accomplishes the feature engineering on higher-level learning features; this also ensures encoder and decoder for constructing the generative units. The experimental outcome of our proposed model sets a benchmark to state that our model works better in comparison with existing methods.

articleTitle: Revolutionary AI-Driven Techniques for Comprehensive Medical Service Enhancement with Enhanced Security Protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized data storage and processing, offering rapid performance that outpaces the limited resources at the periphery. The cloud's capabilities have facilitated the effective implementation of diverse security policies, leading to a significant shift of computing and data storage to the cloud. This paper presents a novel fast-acting security framework for cloud-based medical platforms, emphasizing the importance of responsiveness and timeliness for medical cloud platforms. The proposed system architecture showcases the flow of user data from biometric sensors through authentication processes to cloud-based data analysis, all governed by a rigorous security policy. The research further delves into the challenges and solutions of securely transmitting confidential medical information from IoT devices to the cloud.

articleTitle: A Review of Protein Sequences of COVID-19 Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The COVID-19 protein sequences are of great interest for the purposes of understanding the behavior of the SARS-CoV-2 virus and devising effective therapeutic treatments. COVID-19 is an illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. These protein sequences encode the building blocks of viral proteins, which play key roles in viral replication, infection, and interaction with the immune system of the host. The structure of the virus, its functions, and its evolutionary history may be better understood via the study and analysis of these protein sequences. The study on COVID-19 focuses on a number of important proteins, including the nucleocapsid (N) protein, the membrane (M) protein, the spike (S) protein, and the envelope (E) protein. Because it binds to the ACE2 receptor, the spike protein is especially significant because it makes it easier for viruses to enter the cells of their hosts. It is the key target for the production of vaccines as well as the subject of intensive research aimed at understanding its structure, antigenicity, and variations. In order to analyze and understand the COVID- 19 protein sequences, a number of computer methods, such as multiple sequence alignment (MSA), machine learning, and deep learning, are used. This contributes to the process of determining prospective therapeutic targets and creating antiviral medicines. In addition, research into the protein sequences allows for a better understanding of the influence that mutations have on the behavior, transmissibility, and immune evasion of viruses. Researchers are able to monitor the appearance of novel viral variants and evaluate the possible influence these variants may have on diagnostics, vaccines, and treatment techniques if they keep track of the genetic differences that occur in viral proteins.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Data Mining for Predictive Modeling of Stroke Risk and Post-Stroke Care Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The research investigates the efficacy of a comprehensive machine learning and data mining approach in predictive modeling of stroke risk and post-stroke care management. A holistic methodology is proposed, integrating diverse datasets and advanced algorithms, including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. Data preprocessing, feature extraction, and personalized care plan generation are key components. Performance evaluation using accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, F1 Score, AUC, and MAE demonstrates the superior predictive capabilities and efficiency of the proposed method compared to traditional approaches. The study highlights the potential for revolutionizing stroke care, emphasizing personalized risk assessment and post-stroke management for improved patient outcomes and healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Secure Training Protocols for Machine Learning Models in Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the realm of secure training protocols for machine learning models within adversarial networks, the proposed methodology encompasses three key algorithms: Federated Learning with Differential Privacy (FedDP), Adversarial Training with Robust Optimization (AdvRO), and Privacy-Preserving Homomorphic Encryption Training (PPHET). Each algorithm plays a critical role in enhancing data privacy, model robustness, and reliability during the model training process. The study evaluates these methods in comparison to traditional approaches, emphasizing the importance of data privacy, robustness, and computational efficiency. This research presents a secure training protocol for machine learning models in adversarial networks, with a focus on data privacy, model robustness, and reliability assurance. The proposed method combines federated learning with differential privacy, adversarial training with robust optimization, and privacy-preserving homomorphic encryption training. These approaches ensure data privacy, enhance model robustness, and protect against adversarial threats. We compare the proposed method with traditional methods and evaluate their performance across various parameters, such as data privacy, robustness to adversarial attacks, and scalability. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in achieving secure and trustworthy machine learning models in adversarial networks.

articleTitle: Exploring Agile Methodologies in Educational Software Development- A Comparative Analysis and Project Management Insights
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the realm of academic research, the task of determining the most suitable Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) becomes complex, owing to the diverse project requirements, rapidly changing technology, team skills and experience, organizational culture and readiness, flexibility and adaptability needs, and decision-making complexity. It requires a thorough analysis of various factors to make a wise decision that aligns with the project's goals and constraints. A variety of models, including Waterfall, Prototyping, and Spiral, offer distinct sets of advantages and disadvantages. Agile modeling is a flexible and iterative software development strategy that emphasizes collaborative modeling and rapid feedback. The agile philosophy promotes transparency, effective communication, and embracing change to meet evolving project needs efficiently and effectively. An In-Depth Examination of Agile Methodologies versus Conventional Approaches gives a deeper understanding of their respective strengths, weaknesses, and applicability. Also as the educational institutes increasingly recognize the importance of providing industry-relevant skills and preparing students for dynamic work environments, agile methodologies are likely to play a vital role in shaping the future of education and fostering the success of students in their careers. In this paper, we have explored the practical application of well-established Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, Lean, Extreme Programming (XP), Feature Driven Development, and Dynamic Systems Development Method (DSDM) within the context of educational institutions and project management.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Cybersecurity in the Big Data Era Moving Beyond Data Protection to Data-Driven Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Evolution of Cybersecurity in the Big Data Era: Moving Beyond Data Protection to “Data-Driven Security” presents a pioneering approach that harnesses the potential of data analytics and machine learning in the cybersecurity domain. In this study, we introduce a novel methodology termed Data-Driven Cybersecurity Intelligence (DDCI), a fusion of sophisticated algorithms: Anomaly Detection using Isolation Forest, Clustering using K-Means, and Predictive Modeling using Random Forest. The DDCI method revolutionizes cybersecurity by offering efficient anomaly detection, precise grouping of similar instances, and accurate prediction of potential cyber threats. Cyber threats are continuously evolving and growing in sophistication. Traditional cybersecurity methods often fall short in keeping pace with these dynamic threats due to their reliance on static rules and signatures. DDCI, on the other hand, embraces adaptability, allowing it to evolve alongside emerging threats by utilizing data-driven techniques. This study demonstrates that DDCI is a pioneering approach in cybersecurity, showcasing the potential of data-driven security in the big data era. The comparison with traditional methods unequivocally establishes the superiority of DDCI, making a strong case for the adoption of data-driven security approaches to safeguard our increasingly interconnected digital world.

articleTitle: A Review of Sentimental Analysis for Vaccine Dataset Using BI-LSTM Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the age of digital communication, the realm of public opinion, particularly on pressing issues like vaccination, has found its voice through myriad online platforms. Given the surge of discussions around vaccines, especially in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic, there is an imperative need to decipher the underlying sentiments from these vast datasets. Sentiment analysis, a prominent branch of Natural Language Processing (NLP), provides the tools to extract, process, and categorize such sentiments. While traditional machine learning models have held their ground in sentiment analysis tasks, the intricate nature of human emotions and language patterns demands more refined techniques. The Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BI-LSTM) model, an enhanced variant of recurrent neural networks, emerges as a promising candidate with its capability to capture contextual information from both past and future data points in sequences. This review paper delves into the application and efficacy of the BI-LSTM method for sentiment analysis on vaccine-related datasets. Through a comprehensive analysis, we evaluate its performance metrics, benefits, limitations, and its positioning against other prevalent models. The findings suggest that BI-LSTM holds significant potential in providing nuanced insights into public sentiment regarding vaccines, which is instrumental for stakeholders to craft informed strategies and communications.

articleTitle: A Unified View of the Big Development, Big Challenge, and Major Trends in the Field of Bigdata in Branding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
