abstract: This research study offers a thorough analysis of the transforming big data environment in branding. It examines significant advancements, difficulties, as well as trends, emphasizing the crucial position of personalization and predictive analytics. Data gathering and analysis using a secondary research methodology in Jupyter Notebook include data cleansing, exploratory data analysis, trend detection, sentiment analysis, including predictive modelling. The study highlights the value of moral data practices in maintaining customer confidence. Real-time analytics and the influence of cutting-edge technologies on branding strategies will be of future interest. This study advances our knowledge about the way big data may be used for branding in today's more data-driven corporate world.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Some Key Cyber Security Architectures Across the World and Their Significance in Indian Context
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Nowadays, cyber security architectures represent a crucial function in protecting digital environments. Considering the growing, complicated, and dangerous threat landscape, it is essential to implement effective protection systems. Modern architectures encompass many advanced techniques, such as integrating multilayer defensive mechanisms, encryption protocols and artificial intelligence-driven anomaly detection systems. This study provides an overview of cyber security and its various architectures. We conducted a review to identify different categories of cyber-attacks and explored more efficient architectural frameworks for minimizing the risks. The significance of cyber security has been determined by examining modern cyber security architectures. The growth of current cyber security architectures has highlighted the importance of cyber security in today's digital world. This study explores the complexities of complicated cyber security systems, highlighting their crucial function in protecting organizational data and networks. Furthermore, we demonstrate how cyber security has become essential in maritime, railway and healthcare industries. The study involved an investigation of cyber security evaluation in India's context. Various categories of cyber security threats were explored, examining the corresponding prevention architectures.

articleTitle: A Survey on NLP-Based Print and Social Media Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Every person's life in society now revolves around social media (SM) and print media (PM), which have opened a preferred spectrum of practical communication and given people the independence to prompt their thoughts and opinions. It can be tough to comprehend the most recent trends and describe the status or general thoughts about products due to the large multiplicity and size of SM data. Sentiment analysis (SA), a real-time, automated tool for extracting opinions, also known as opinion mining (OM) is now necessary as a result of this. Given that SA requires natural language processing (NLP), it becomes clear that it is a difficult field with many challenges. Its outcomes have an extensive range of applications, comprising news analytics, marketing, question-answering, readers do. For many businesses and institutions, gaining valuable insights from online opinions— particularly those expressed in SM blogs—is essential for understanding customer feedback on products, general sentiment, and investor perceptions. We have provided a succinct overview of the influence of print and social media (PSM) in this research utilising NLP-based SA.

articleTitle: Secure Data Augmentation in Deep Learning for Enhanced Network Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The proposed methodology, titled “Secure Data Augmentation for Enhanced Network Protection,” presents a comprehensive approach to augmenting training data in a secure and privacy-preserving manner while strengthening network protection. This approach revolves around three key algorithms: Secure Data Transformation, Privacy-Preserving Data Generation, and Adversarial Training for Robustness. The first algorithm, Secure Data Transformation, focuses on augmenting the original training dataset while ensuring privacy preservation through a privacy-preserving transformation function. This controlled noise addition diversifies the data, crucial for robust deep learning models. The second algorithm, Privacy-Preserving Data Generation, leverages homomorphic encryption to augment encrypted training data securely. The third algorithm, Adversarial Training for Robustness, enhances model resilience against adversarial attacks by incorporating adversarial examples during training. The proposed methodology has shown superior performance across various evaluation metrics, showcasing its potential for bolstering network protection.

articleTitle: An Introduction to Gossip Protocol Based Learning in Peer-to-Peer Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) has been progressively implemented in a distributed manner to harness the data abundance produced on billions of end user devices. Federated learning (FL) is a type of distributed machine learning that provides robust data privacy by training ML models locally on each participating node without directly exchanging raw data with others. The local ML model updates from all nodes are aggregated in order to obtain a global model. There are different ways to aggregate local model updates for obtaining a global model, such as centralized and decentralized/peer-to-peer. Centralized FL (CFL) requires a server to collect and aggregate all model updates for producing a global model, whereas decentralized FL (DFL)/peer-to-peer FL (P2PFL) requires coordination among all the nodes to communicate and aggregate all models updates and produce a global model. In CFL, the server can pose a bottleneck problem as it is a single point of failure, though, this issue can be resolved using DFL/P2PFL. However, the design of the decentralized/peer-to-peer architecture is complex and challenging, and may incur significant communication overhead due to a large number of nodes involved in the learning process. Gossip protocols are one of the most effective ways to communicate in DFL/P2PFL and optimises its performance, therefore, this decentralized learning is also known as gossip protocol-based learning. Considering the importance of gossip protocol in DFL/P2PFL, this paper will analyse gossip protocol, working of gossip protocol, types of gossip protocol, benefits and limitations of gossip protocol, usages of gossip protocol in DFL/P2PFL and its two main types structured P2PFL and unstructured P2PFL.

articleTitle: The Congestion Control and Performance Improvement by Fuzzy techniques in FANET with IoT: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Now a day's More and more people use UAV-to-UAV communications to send information from one place to another in the air. UAVs are able to communicate with other UAVs and directly transfer the information to the tower through the base station (BS) or directly. The BS is only there to collect all the information from different UAVs and forward that information outside the network. The role of the Internet of Things (IoT) with FANET is to control the information of UAVs and also send feedback to UAVs related to data forwarding. IoT nodes are capable of controlling the working capabilities, of devices but do not affect their actual functioning. The need for an IoT device is only to control the data it receives and sends over the network. Using the idea of Artificial Intelligence (AI), we present a study of strategies that aim to increase FANET performance and reduce congestion using the Internet of Things (IoT). AI concepts like fuzzy logic, machine learning, etc. are able to improve the accuracy of the output after applying learning and training concepts. BSs are not capable of giving instructions to UAVs, and in normal communication, BSs do not check the data to see if it is appropriate or inappropriate. In this survey, also focus on the routing protocols and different issues in FANET and IoT with applications. IoT devices can select only the data from a larger set that is required or requested by the receiver. Data that is received by nodes is transferred to the IoT to check whether the data is valuable or not. The control of device data has been made possible by establishing standards on IoT nodes.

articleTitle: Analyzing Embedding Models for Embedding Vectors in Vector Databases
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Vector databases have emerged as the computation engine that enables us to successfully interact with vector embeddings in our applications as a result of the exponential rise of vector embeddings in disciplines like NLP (Natural Language Processing), computer vision, and other AI applications. In order to address the issues that arise when handling vector embeddings in production applications, vector databases were specifically created. Vector databases that offer quick and precise nearest-neighbor search, clustering, and similarity matching, and that are simple to deploy on cloud infrastructure or distributed computing systems, are more likely to be well-liked by users. They therefore provide a number of advantages over conventional scalar-based databases and independent vector indexes. This research reveals that embedding vectors are frequently utilized for analyzing and exploring unstructured data with the creation of learning-based embedding models. Completely managed and horizontally scalable vector databases are required as vector collections reach billion-scale numbers. The proposal relaxes the data model and consistency restrictions in exchange for the aforementioned benefits because the majority of vector data applications do not call for intricate data models and robust data consistency. VectorDB of Python has been used for implementation and test case which does faster similarity search.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning for Predictive Modeling and Management of Rare Genetic Disorders in Pediatric Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The difficulties caused by rare genetic abnormalities in pediatric healthcare highlight the need for advances in predictive modeling and treatment choices. An innovative method is discussed in the article “Reinforcement Learning for Predictive Modeling and Management of Rare Genetic Disorders in Pediatric Healthcare.” Deep Q-Networks (DQN), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and Actor-Critical are the three RL algorithms used in the suggested approach. To determine the most effective treatment for children with uncommon genetic illnesses, we used these algorithms to create a prediction model. To improve healthcare quality, we carefully evaluate the suggested approach alongside six alternative methods with overlapping but distinct names. We also take accuracy and precision into account while making our assessments. The suggested strategy, which we refer to as the “Novel Genetic Predictor (NGP),” excels in every metric we tested. The results show a considerable improvement in the detection of rare genetic disorders in children. NGP also demonstrates an enhanced ability to make precise predictions, which opens the path for treatment alternatives that are both patient-specific and more effective. This research not only shows the promise of RL in pediatric healthcare, but also emphasizes the need for tailored care for children with rare genetic disorders. The results show that NGP is better than other methods, and they provide doctors a tool they may use to better care for their patients.

articleTitle: Precision Cardiac Risk Evaluation through Flexible Classification Mining Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Accurate methods of measuring cardiac risk are desperately needed, as cardiovascular diseases remain a major global health concern. The aim of a newly released study titled “Precision Cardiac Risk Evaluation through Flexible Classification Mining Strategies” was to establish new standards in the field of cardiac risk assessment. This work suggests a novel method to increase the accuracy and precision of cardiac risk assessment by utilizing flexible category mining algorithms. The study included a proposed strategy. There are clear limitations to traditional risk assessment methods, especially with regard to how accurately they can identify those who are at risk. As a result of this work, innovative new methods for improving cardiac risk assessment without imposing these limitations have been created. Each of these enhancements is supported by the research's conclusions. Combining state-of-the-art data analysis and machine learning technology allows the recommended strategy to enhance forecast precision and adjust to changing risk indicators. The most significant and remarkable outcome of this study is the development of a prediction model with enhanced AUC-ROC values over previous methods and exceptional sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy. The suggested approach shows a higher ability to recognize individuals who may have cardiovascular diseases. By reducing the likelihood of missed diagnoses and the frequency of false negatives, this is achieved. The research also emphasizes the model's interpretability, which gives medical practitioners a better understanding of the variables that affect the predictions. This interpretability increases the technique's potential impact in clinical settings by ensuring that medical practitioners can provide individualized treatment and make correct diagnoses. To put it another way, interpretability ensures that health care providers can provide each patient with the individualized attention they require.

articleTitle: Advanced Threat Intelligence Forecasting using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This section introduces an innovative approach for advanced threat intelligence forecasting employing machine learning algorithms. The proposed method integrates three powerful algorithms - Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and elucidates the foundational mathematical concepts. The process commences with data preprocessing involving cleaning, normalization, and feature engineering to prepare the raw data for machine learning. Subsequently, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is employed for optimal feature selection. The integration of Random Forest, SVM, and LSTM algorithms forms a robust predictive framework. Random Forest, known for its accuracy and versatility, constructs an ensemble of decision trees, ensuring reliable classification. SVM seeks the optimal hyperplane to effectively separate classes in feature space, proving valuable in complex, non-linearly separable data scenarios. LSTM, a type of recurrent neural network, excels in capturing long-term dependencies in sequential data, making it indispensable in threat intelligence.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology in Banking and Insurance a Critical Examination of ICT-driven Disruptions in the BFSI Landscape
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)

articleTitle: Utilizing Cutting-Edge Machine Vision Techniques for Swift Anomaly Detection in Suboptimal Surveillance Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the realm of surveillance and anomaly detection, the proposed Adaptive Multimodal Anomaly Detection (AMAD) method stands as an innovative and potent approach. The objective of this method is to detect anomalies swiftly and accurately in suboptimal surveillance environments by amalgamating state-of-the-art machine vision techniques with multimodal data fusion. The core idea revolves around leveraging advanced deep learning architectures and statistical models, thereby enhancing the performance of anomaly detection systems. The AMAD method initiates with Algorithm 1: Multimodal Data Fusion, a process that involves integrating multimodal data streams, such as visual, thermal, and infrared information, into a unified feature space. This integration is accomplished using a weighted sum approach, allowing varying importance levels to be assigned to each modality based on weights <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\alpha, \beta, \gamma)$</tex>. This fusion strategy proves pivotal in capturing a holistic representation of the environment. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for Feature Learning follows, where a CNN architecture is employed to learn robust and discriminative features from the fused data. This study showcases that AMAD, with its multimodal integration, deep learning-based feature extraction, and efficient scoring mechanism, triumphs over traditional anomaly detection techniques. It significantly contributes to enhanced anomaly detection capabilities, emphasizing its potential for bolstering public safety and security in dynamic and challenging technological landscapes.

articleTitle: Deep Learning's Role in Advancing Gastroenterology and Digestive Health
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This work presents a comprehensive methodology for the application of deep learning in the field of gastroenterology and digestive health. The methodology emphasizes the crucial steps involved in harnessing the power of deep learning, commencing with data preprocessing. Data cleaning, normalization, and partitioning into training, validation, and test sets lay the foundation for subsequent analysis. The choice of deep learning algorithms is pivotal, aligning them with the specific problem at hand. The results generated by these models hold immense promise, spanning accurate polyp detection, disease prediction, and unveiling microbiome patterns, all of which are translated into actionable insights for gastroenterologists and healthcare providers. Moreover, ethical, and regulatory considerations feature prominently, addressing patient data privacy and compliance with healthcare regulations. The proposed methodology offers a robust framework for the integration of deep learning in gastroenterology, promising to advance our understanding of digestive health, improve patient care, and drive medical innovation.

articleTitle: AI-Enabled Predictive Modeling and Management of Rare Pediatric Cancers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the field of pediatric oncology, uncommon tumors present special difficulties due to the low frequency with which they occur, as well as the necessity of developing accurate diagnosis procedures and individualized treatment plans. This research presents a novel strategy to solve these issues. It's called “AI-Enabled Predictive Modeling and Management of Rare Pediatric Cancers,” and it's called “AI-Enabled Predictive Modeling and Management of Rare Pediatric Cancers.” The approach integrates cutting-edge AI methods with time-honored medical procedures to achieve the goal of dramatically enhancing the diagnostic capabilities, therapeutic options, and overall care that may be provided to children patients who have uncommon malignancies. Modeling that is Predictive: Using the data that has been preprocessed and designed, a machine learning model is trained to provide a prediction about the presence or absence of uncommon pediatric malignancies. Evaluation and Refinement of the Model The performance of the model is evaluated utilizing a variety of evaluation measures, and hyperparameter tweaking is carried out to improve the model's precision.

articleTitle: Enhancing Networked Embedded Systems Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Improving performance and flexibility is crucial in the field of networked embedded systems. Using deep learning methods, this research presents a fresh strategy for doing this. Our suggested approach involves creating a custom deep learning architecture tailored to the specific needs of distributed embedded systems. This strategy makes use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs) to evaluate real-time data streams, expedite decision-making, and intelligently adapt to ever-changing environments. In addition, using reinforcement learning helps systems behave and use energy more efficiently, creating a more flexible and smart setting. To reduce latency and reliance on centralized servers, edge computing plays a crucial role by allowing for real-time data processing on embedded devices. The suggested technique was evaluated alongside more conventional methods in a side-by-side comparison. Imaginary numbers were utilized for demonstration purposes. The findings illustrate the higher performance of the suggested technique across several parameters. When compared to baseline deep learning methods like Convolutional Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, Long Short-Term Memory Networks, Generative Adversarial Networks, Federated Learning, Transfer Learning, and Time Series Analysis with Deep Learning, the proposed method shows marked improvements in accuracy, latency, energy efficiency, robustness, security, scalability, and resource utilization. Finally, the suggested methodology emerges as a game-changing strategy for enhancing the capabilities of networked embedded systems, since it is supported by deep learning methods, reinforcement learning, and edge computing. Its ushers in a new era of networked embedded systems with its flexibility to process sequential data, analyze picture and video material, and maximize energy efficiency. The results of the comparison study validate the superiority of the suggested approach across a variety of measures, making it a ground-breaking solution for today's networked embedded environments.

articleTitle: Developments in Image Processing using Deep learning and Reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The continuously surging volume of data, estimated to surpass 180 zettabytes by 2025, presents substantial challenges for both organizations and society as a whole. This influx of data not only brings about increased size but also introduces heightened complexity, presenting new theoretical and computational obstacles. Over the past two decades, the field of data science has experienced a notable surge in popularity due to its versatile applications in managing complex data, ensuring high accuracy, providing customizable flexibility, and demonstrating excellent adaptability. However, the analysis of image datasets introduces additional challenges, particularly when the goal is to enhance image quality, which in turn increases the volume of data for processing. Despite the continued dominance of traditional machine learning (ML) techniques in various research fields and industries, there is a growing interest among the scientific community in exploring innovative artificial intelligence (AI) approaches. The resurgence of neural networks, in particular, has led to significant breakthroughs, especially in the domains of image understanding and processing. This research conducts an extensive examination of the latest progress in designing and optimizing artificial intelligence (AI) solutions specifically tailored to tackle challenges in image processing. Despite the significant accomplishments, the field continues to grapple with various difficulties. The present study thoroughly explores essential and recent improvements, applications, and advancements within the sphere of image processing, offering insights into a domain characterized by continual and swift evolution. Additionally, the paper delineates prospective avenues for future research in this dynamic field.

articleTitle: Early Cognitive Decline Assessment via the Synergy of Machine Learning Algorithms and Cognitive Proficiency Examination
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The rapid increase in global aging underscores the urgency of devising efficient strategies for predicting cognitive decline, a precursor to conditions like dementia and Alzheimer's. Current methodologies for detection often rely on a combination of cognitive, clinical, and physical data, with the latter two often necessitating the use of imaging or fluid samples. However, leveraging Electronic Health Records (EHRs) can circumvent these invasive methods, enabling quicker and more efficient diagnostics. This study emphasizes the significance of early detection, especially among middle-aged individuals with chronic conditions such as diabetes and hypertension, both of which have been linked to an increased risk of dementia. The research relies on a dataset sourced from “Data World”, focusing on age cohorts between 40 to 65. This age group is pivotal, as certain Alzheimer's risk factors manifest around this time, and several studies have underscored the connection between middle-age hypertension and late-life dementia. Through a meticulous analysis, involving both traditional cognitive tests and advanced machine learning models like SVM and Deep Neural Networks, this study aims to offer a comprehensive method for early cognitive decline assessment.

articleTitle: Secure and Tailored Health Solutions for People with Specific Requirements Leveraging Advanced AI Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Our proposed method aims to revolutionize healthcare by leveraging advanced AI techniques to tailor health solutions for individuals with specific health requirements. This innovative approach integrates three powerful AI algorithms: Deep Neural Network (DNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). These algorithms work collaboratively to develop secure, precise, and individualized healthcare services. The DNN mimics the brain's structure to extract intricate patterns, the LSTM handles sequential data and long-term dependencies, and the GAN generates data resembling real distributions. Security and privacy are ensured through data encryption and secure communication. The tailored health solution is a result of integrating these techniques, providing enhanced healthcare services.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Projection through the Fusion of Cointegration Analysis and Advanced Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In the contemporary era, projecting energy consumption has emerged as a cornerstone for sustainable energy, policy formation, and efficient resource management. This paper introduces a novel method that fuses cointegration analysis a statistical approach discerning prolonged relationships amidst variables with cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques. This synergy is meticulously crafted to amplify both the precision and adaptability of energy forecasts. The research navigates from the rudimentary phase of data aggregation, emphasizing the importance of historical energy data, to the advanced stages involving model fusion, optimization, and deployment. The crux lies in the method's comprehensive nature, ensuring a holistic approach to the projection while accentuating the significance of data preprocessing, trend analysis, and the intricate dynamics of energy consumption.

articleTitle: Redefining Anti-Forensics in Digital Image Operation: Exploring the Power of Dual-Domain Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar may be used in a variety of imaginative ways to monitor and observe several things at the same time. However, problems with the radar itself are possible. It is challenging to improve mmWave radar detection while maintaining reliable data categorization. Building a reliable model that is consistent with tracking and sensing goals is a significant barrier to realising the full potential of mmWave sensing. Because radar frames are associated with major events, manually annotating mmWave data takes a lot of time and frequently requires topic expertise. This article lays the groundwork for training mmWave radar by utilising a camera as a labelling and monitoring tool. During the research phase, a preliminary drawing of the framework was constructed. The proposed strategy is evaluated in contrast to other methods that strive to achieve the same goals. Experiments in a variety of real-world settings have verified the conceptual framework. The mmWave technology is used in the multi-object tracking system that arises from the stated architectural design. This technology differs from others in that it can discriminate between sprinting, tripping, and simply strolling. The results of the experiment show that guided tagging from a camera may be utilised to train a radar model consistently. This trained model consistently demonstrates great classification accuracy over a wide range of instances, not just the ones it was trained on. This report lays the groundwork for further research into hybrid monitoring setups. It specifically supports the construction of mmWave classification models by tackling labelling and training issues.

articleTitle: In-depth Analysis of Information Overflows and its Role in Shaping Future Knowledge Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This study provides a thorough evaluation of data deluges and how they will play a significant role in the development of future knowledge architectures. The suggested methodology is adaptable and interdisciplinary since it combines cutting-edge data mining, NLP, and network analysis methods. Data mining, NLP, network analysis, content analysis, big data analytics, cognitive mapping, SNA, MNA, QR, and IV are all compared to the proposed method, as are machine learning algorithms, qualitative research methods, and data visualization. Accuracy, relevance, depth of analysis, innovation, practical consequences, and clarity are only a few of the areas where the suggested technique shines. Its greater analytical skills are shown by its persistent outperformance of conventional approaches. Additionally, the suggested approach better accords with ethical norms and responsible research procedures, thus they are all considered as well. In summary, this study demonstrates the value of looking at information floods from several angles of study. The suggested technique not only provides cutting-edge analytic instruments for negotiating the intricacies of the digital information ecosystem, but also gives a forward-looking viewpoint by anticipating new patterns and developments. It demonstrates how crucial it is to use cutting-edge methods and evolve with the information age.

articleTitle: Integrating Wearable Sensor Data and AI for Remote Monitoring and Management of Chronic Respiratory Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Chronic respiratory illnesses exert a major strain on healthcare systems globally, necessitating creative ways to optimize patient outcomes and treatment. This work presents a new technique for remote monitoring and treatment of chronic respiratory illnesses that blends wearable sensor data with artificial intelligence (AI). The method's properties are highlighted, including the employment of Random Forest, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Support Vector Machines (SVM) as three important algorithms for modeling illness development, forecasting exacerbations, and spotting abnormalities in real-time patient data. Our method has proven to be a big success. It is now conceivable to consistently forecast illness exacerbations, which speeds up medical treatments and decreases the likelihood of life-threatening respiratory crises. Real-time vital sign monitoring gives comprehensive, up-to-date data to patients and healthcare practitioners while allowing people to actively govern their own health. Real-time feedback and individualized treatment regimens assist in enhancing patient involvement. By addressing privacy and ethical concerns, adequate data management has been achieved. The integration of wearable sensors with AI provides a considerable improvement in the treatment of chronic respiratory illnesses. It enables for a more proactive, patient-centered, and data-driven approach to healthcare. The results not only boost patient outcomes, but also offer the ability to minimize healthcare expenses and deliver tailored therapy on a worldwide scale.

articleTitle: The Advantages of AI-Based Transformation Projects and their Effects on Company Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)

To decide their effect on the outcome of associations and to feature the financial returns of AI-empowered projects modernization inside associations, this exploration was finished utilizing a technique comprising of four modes, assessment of AI and AI hypotheses, top to the bottom pursuit of contextual investigations from a great many modern regions, information assortment from of the informational indexes of AI-based arrangement suppliers, and a survey of AI writing.500 contextual investigations from sites having a place with IBM, AWS, Calico, Nvidia, Conversance, Widespread Robots, and so on were inspected as a feature of the exploration interaction. articleTitle: Bridging Image Diagnostics with Advanced Computational Techniques for Hidden Feature Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: This research presents a comprehensive methodology for efficient medical image segmentation in radiology by synergistically combining the strengths of MobileNet and U-Net architectures. The process begins with the collection and preprocessing of diverse medical image datasets, including CT scans, MRI images, and X-rays. Preprocessing involves resizing, normalization, and data augmentation to enhance model robustness. MobileNet, known for its computational efficiency, serves as the feature extraction backbone. It efficiently captures hierarchical features from input medical images while minimizing computational requirements. Simultaneously, a U-Net-style architecture is integrated to leverage its exceptional segmentation accuracy. Skip connections are introduced to connect corresponding layers in both MobileNet and U-Net, facilitating the transfer of low-level and high-level features. Feature maps from both components are fused at multiple levels, combining MobileNet's efficiency with U-Net's accuracy. map, representing the final segmentation output. The hybrid model is trained using annotated medical image data with loss functions like Dice loss or cross-entropy. Fine-tuning and hyperparameter optimization are performed to enhance performance. The proposed methodology is applied to real-world radiology scenarios, such as tumor segmentation, organ delineation, and lesion detection. It significantly outperforms traditional methods, demonstrating superior accuracy and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Impact Of Information Technology On Organizational Commitment And Job Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this study, the impact of information technology (IT) on organisational commitment (OCM) and job satisfaction (JS) in Hyderabadi software firms was investigated. To evaluate the extent of information technology in Hyderabad organisations, six criteria have been established. The study's determination of how these specified information technology elements affect organisational engagement and work happiness is its tenacity. The data was gathered through a survey that N=420 software workers from 102 Hyderabad-based organisations completed. The study's key findings are stated below. The Hyderabadi firms' information technology is in good health, as shown by slightly above average results on these tests. The average number better reflects the emphasis that management places on contemporary Technology, which bodes well for the prospects. All information technology-related parameters and observed organisational performance are shown to have statistically significant, strong, and positive relationships in both the JS and OC dimensions. The three elements most closely related with information technology are its use, management's emphasis on it, and employees' excitement for using it. Organizational performance is most closely correlated with the linkages between communication, kind of job, and emotional involvement. A predictive influence of IT items on the observed continuous commitment is also shown by the regression analysis. The impact of management's attention on contemporary Technology and the motivation for employees to use it becomes more evident when contrasted to other independent elements. It is advised for top managers to continuously and methodically spend in the purchase and upkeep of contemporary information technology and to motivate staff to utilise it. The results of this investment and effort will be improved business outcomes and an increase in a number of organisational performance indicators, including job satisfaction and employee loyalty.

articleTitle: A Review on Crop Disease Classification and Prevention of Pest using Deep Transfer Ensemble Learning in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The expansion of useful technological tools has helped the agricultural sector become more effective and productive. This current study uses deep transfer ensemble learning strategies to tackle the important problems of disease detection and pest control in agricultural systems. When crop diseases and pests are identified and controlled in a timely manner, it has a significant impact on agricultural output. In order to get to the bottom of a problem quickly and accurately, cutting-edge technologies need to be incorporated when conventional approaches fail. This research uses deep transfer ensemble training, a novel technique for combining multiple deep learning models, to boost classification accuracy and robustness. To accomplish this, a large-scale ensemble model is constructed and trained with the help of both CNNs and RNNs. In order to make use of previously-trained models and modify them for the purpose of classifying crop diseases and identifying pests, transfer learning is used. The ensemble method enhances generalization and prediction performance by capitalizing on the different representations provided by separate models. To test the efficacy of the suggested strategy, we use a sizable collection of crop photos depicting a wide range of illnesses and pests. The deep transfer ensemble model has been shown to be superior to both stand-alone models and more conventional methods in a large body of experimental work. The ensemble model outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks in both crop disease classification and pest identification. Moreover, the model is resilient against changes in environmental conditions and imaging quality, demonstrating its potential for use in actual agricultural settings. The study's findings have important ramifications for today's farming practices. Minimizing production losses and sustaining food security depend critically on accurate and timely classification of agricultural diseases and pest prevention. Deep transfer ensemble learning presents an exciting opportunity to put deep learning to work solving pressing problems in the agricultural sector. This study lays the groundwork for future advancements in the field of agriculture that make use of artificial intelligence as technology develops.

articleTitle: Secure Multi-Party Computation in Distributed Deep Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The goal of this study is to present a novel strategy for improving the data privacy and security of distributed deep learning networks through the use of secure multi-party computation (SMPC). The approach in issue employs three key processes: privacy-preserving gradient descent (PPGD), secure aggregation (SA), and homomorphic encryption (HE). Several criteria are utilized to compare the efficacy of our proposed strategy to six industry-standard techniques, including accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, training time, computational complexity, memory utilization, scalability, resilience, and privacy protection. The findings show that our method surpasses standard strategies in terms of protecting private information and sensitive data while retaining competitive model accuracy and training efficiency. This paper offers a complete architecture for secure collaborative model training and underlines the need for privacy-preserving strategies in distributed deep learning.

articleTitle: Land Use and Land Cover Classification for Temporal Analysis on Ganjam District Region, Odisha Using Remote Sensing and Google Earth Engine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Land use/land cover change (LULC) affects natural ecosystems and the environment, which can lead to changes in land resources, biodiversity, ecological functions, and environmental components. This is why LULC Change Analysis plays an important role in planning and using current and future natural resources for the sustainable development of any country. This paper performs LULC classification and analysis over a study region in Ganjam District, Odisha, India. Satellite data was extracted from Landsat 7 and 8 satellites that provide spectral and multi-temporal images. For the LULC classification, 5 LULC classes were considered such as water bodies, vegetation, urban areas, barren Land, and cropland. A machine learning-based approach was applied using Google Earth Engine (GEE) to compare different supervised classifiers such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), Classification and Regression Trees (CART), and Random Forest over the periods between 2010 and 2020. In this study, SVM gave the best results with 92 percent Overall Accuracy(OA) and 0.90 Kappa Value. Also, the change analysis showed that Urban areas increased by 112 percent, cropland by 9 percent, and barren land decreased by 68 percent between 2010 and 2020.

articleTitle: Role of Blockchain in Higher Education Industries: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The Blockchain technology are recommended to add an extra security layer with banking, financial and education industries. The basic structure of Blockchain technology serve the security and privacy features using a concept of Block, Blocks has been mined in a way that distribute the transaction to other blocks of the Blockchain network these blocks are managing the data through transaction process in immutable and temper proof mode that makes Blockchain technology very secure throughout the mode of data transmission. In this study, we wish to examine how blockchain technology has impacted colleges in terms of information and technology in order to raise the standard of universities. Reviewing earlier research publications that are relevant to the study is the process utilized. As a result, it is anticipated that this research will make a positive impact by helping to solve issues with blockchain implementation in higher education, in the mean of how Blockchain transforms the education system and its role in near future with various growing industries as banking system, medical and education industries.

articleTitle: Enhancing Crop Yield through Weed Density Estimation and Management: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Weeds are significant adversaries to crop productivity, competing for vital resources and causing yield losses. Effective weed management is pivotal to attain optimized crop production. This review focuses on the assessment of weed density and its correlation with yield losses, aiming to enhance agricultural practices and productivity. Various methodologies, including remote sensing, image processing, machine learning algorithms, and data analytics, are explored for precise estimation of weed density. Integration of these technologies within the framework of precision agriculture allows for real-time monitoring and targeted weed control strategies. Understanding weed-crop interactions, considering factors such as weed species and environmental conditions, is vital for tailored management approaches. The synthesis of advanced technologies and data-driven insights enables efficient weed management, fostering sustainable agricultural practices. Continued research and innovation in this domain are crucial to refine and develop precise methods, ultimately promoting sustainable and maximized crop yields in modern agriculture.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics and AI for Early Diagnosis and Intervention in Autism Spectrum Disorders
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Predictive analytics and AI being investigated to see whether they may aid in the early diagnosis of autism spectrum diseases. The suggested method, entitled “Behavioral Biomarker Identification (BBI),” makes use of machine learning algorithms to spot patterns of behavior that may be suggestive of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Some popular examples of such algorithms are random forests, logistic regression, and deep neural networks (DNNs). Six other common techniques are compared to BBI to see if it is more effective. Research has shown that BBI is more effective, sensitive, and specific than competing methods. Those with autism spectrum condition can now be diagnosed with more certainty and accuracy thanks to this approach. The BBI's potential as a tool for early identification of autism spectrum disorders is supported by its improved accuracy compared to conventional approaches. The high sensitivity of the BBI (88%), which assures a limited level of false negatives, is essential for effectively detecting instances of ASD. Its specificity of 94% is great for eliminating false positives by excluding situations that have nothing to do with ASD. Data privacy and ethical considerations are prioritized in the proposed approach, which addresses them with openness and strict security measures. This ensures that all patient data is handled in a lawful and transparent way. The BBI approach represents a giant leap forward in the quest to diagnose autistic diseases. Artificial intelligence and predictive analytics enable earlier diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder and hence earlier intervention. BBI is a helpful tool for healthcare professionals because it is more accurate and sensitive than traditional approaches, and because it prioritizes data protection and ethical principles, further assuring its responsible deployment in clinical situations. This study demonstrates that the quality of life for people with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) might be considerably enhanced via the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and predictive analytics. Research and therapy for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) might benefit greatly from the BBI approach due to its high efficacy and lack of ethical considerations.

articleTitle: Exploring Advanced Techniques in Image Reconstruction from Dynamic PET Using Nonlocal Deep Image
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In this study a pioneering approach called Nonlocal Deep Image Reconstruction (NDIR) to elevate image reconstruction in dynamic Positron Emission Tomography (PET). Dynamic PET imaging involves capturing a series of images over time, providing critical insights into the temporal distribution of radiotracers in biological tissues. However, the reconstruction of high-quality images from dynamic PET data is challenging due to inherent noise, limited spatial and temporal resolution, and rapid changes in tracer distribution. To address these challenges, we introduce NDIR, which seamlessly integrates nonlocal regularization with deep learning to significantly enhance image reconstruction in dynamic PET. The NDIR methodology harnesses both spatial and temporal correlations within dynamic PET data, thus improving image quality, denoising capabilities, and the preservation of fine details within the reconstructed images. The core of this approach involves training a dedicated neural network for image reconstruction, which is optimized to learn the intricate patterns present in dynamic PET data. Additionally, NDIR employs nonlocal information to intelligently guide the reconstruction process, resulting in higher fidelity images. These results manifest in superior image quality, highlighting NDIR's ability to produce clearer and more accurate images compared to traditional reconstruction methods. Furthermore, computational efficiency is a pivotal aspect, and NDIR showcases remarkable speed, making it a compelling choice for practical implementations.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Protocols for Enhanced Cloud Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: In fortifying the security of an organization's cloud environment, it is crucial to align security strategies with specific objectives and threats unique to the cloud landscape. This paper proposes an Integrated Augmented Intelligence approach, amalgamating Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies such as machine learning, natural language processing, and behavioral analytics. The methodology involves thorough evaluation of existing security protocols, identification of AI components based on organizational needs, and integration of cloud-native security tools. Data from diverse cloud sources are processed, and features are extracted for machine learning models. The proposed system includes three key algorithms: Threat Detection using Machine Learning, Real-time Incident Response, and Explainable AI for Cloud Security. The Threat Detection algorithm employs machine learning for real-time threat identification. The Real-time Incident Response algorithm automates responses based on threat severity, significantly reducing response time compared to traditional manual methods. Lastly, the Explainable AI algorithm enhances interpretability, crucial for ensuring human trust in AI-driven security decisions. A comprehensive comparative analysis is performed against six traditional methods, revealing the proposed system's superiority in threat detection accuracy, rapid incident response, scalability, interpretability, and resource efficiency. The integration of augmented intelligence offers continuous improvement, learning from emerging threats.

articleTitle: Dart | Data Analysis For Red Teamers

articleTitle: Analysis of Congestion Control Techniques for Improving QoS using Machine Learning Approach in MANET
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Congestion is the main reason why connections fail when there are too many people on the network. This leads to the loss of nodes and modify the way setup of Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET). As we know, MANET is a network with no permanent infrastructure. It is made up of a temporary network that doesn't need a central manager or the usual support equipment found in traditional networks. To assure the longevity of MANET, networks can be constructed anywhere. Buffer overflow and congested links are caused by severe network demand, resulting in significant packet loss. Proper routing results in packet delays and has an effect on the MANET protocol's packet delivery rate. Machine learning (ML) is a part of Artificial Intelligence (AI) which is able to improve the QoS of routing in networks. In this paper, we discuss the latest research work to learn some innovative concepts and focus on doing something new in the field of Machine Learning in MANET. A well-balanced strategy is a method for avoiding network congestion. Load balancing allows network consumption to be optimized, packet latency to be reduced, and packet distribution ratio to be enhanced. Shifting loads from congested to less congested paths enhance the network's overall efficiency. MANET routing protocols prefer paths with less hops and exclude paths with more hops, but in extreme load conditions, they prefer paths with less hops. Furthermore, we investigate congestion management routing options in order to suggest a new approach in the future for identifying and preventing congestion risk in MANET.

articleTitle: Impact of Technological Developments on Customer Satisfaction in Online Banking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Customers' relationships with banks have changed because of technology, which has led to growth in the banking industry. The main reason for this study is to investigate how changes in technology have affected people's happiness and satisfaction with online banking. With the help of client sentiment analysis, predictive analytics for service enhancement, and user interface evaluation, this study shows how online banking services are changing and how that changes customer satisfaction. We'd like to investigate how artificial intelligence (AI), mobile banking apps, and bitcoin affect people's lives, especially how they affect security, personalizing, and ease of use. The study also looks at how these technological solutions boost speed and customer service. Financial companies could use the information to give better customer service in the digital age.

articleTitle: Enhancing Unsupervised Domain Adaptation via Multi-Layered Domain Alignment in Multisource Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Even in current times, lung cancer is recognized as one of the most lethal varieties of the disease. Early detection and exact diagnosis are two of the most important factors in improving patient outcomes. This study proposes a unique way for evaluating medical images with the purpose of identifying lung cancer. In terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, the suggested technique beats both standard histological classification methods and genomic classification methods. The method employs cutting-edge machine learning and neural network methods. The inquiry looks thoroughly into the procedures that occur between the moment an image is captured and its classification. It emphasizes the significance of feature extraction, segmentation, and the convolutional layer. The findings indicate that the developed approach has the potential to become a reliable tool for the early identification of lung cancer, allowing the technology to be used in clinical settings.

articleTitle: MedPlantBot: AI Chatbot Architectural Design Framework for Responsible Use of Medicinal Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Medicinal plants become a viable substitute goto treatment for common ailments when overburdened with hospitalization expenses and low accessibility to the government's health care system. As support and advancement with Catanduanes' alternative healing, this paper presented an approach to integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) with Chatbot technology to address queries on treatment forms and usage of various medicinal plants. Employing documentary analysis and AI Chatbot framework design for its mixed-methods approach, the MedPlantBot prototype was built using conversational AI Chatbot architecture, Google's DialogFlow platform, and Kommunicate, a web chat interactive platform for bot and human interaction (Bot + Human hybrid). User acceptance, consisting of experts, traditional healers, and users of medicinal plants, for the prototype, averaged as “Strongly Agreed” in terms of its usability. Significantly, this study can serve as an educational platform for the community to learn how to use medicinal plants available in their area to treat ailments. Ultimately, this study brings potential in providing local folks with a cost-effective alternative as an initial healing practice to improve their health and wellness, thereby contributing to the attainment of the third Sustainable Development Goal of the United Nations – Good Health and Well-being.

articleTitle: Chat Generative Pre-Trained Transformer (ChatGPT): Comprehending its Operational Structure, AI Techniques, Working, Features and Limitations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: ChatGPT has transformed the way machines interact with humans, as it is a significant improvement in the field of generative AI and conversational AI. ChatGPT is a combination of generative AI and conversational AI, and it is built on an underlying large language model which can create new contents similar to human-generated contents and simulate human-like conversations. It has the ability to understand the context of a conversation and respond accordingly, and learn to adapt from user feedback. ChatGPT is a new AI tool and is still evolving very rapidly, its successive models are gradually becoming more advanced and are capable of generating highly complex, coherent and credible text, thus making it a valuable tool for a wide range of applications. Therefore, this paper will present a comprehensive study of ChatGPT covering its operational structure, key AI techniques, working, features and limitations. This comprehensive study will provide users a detailed insight of ChatGPT in order to understand its core concepts.

articleTitle: From Brick-and-Mortar to Click-and-Mortar Analyzing the Role of ICT in Transforming Retail Marketing Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: The retail business has undergone many significant changes, ups & downs in the past many years down the lane, principally determined by the coming and everywhere reception of Data and Correspondence Advancements (ICT). This examines the transition from the traditional brick-and-mortar retail model to the contemporary click-and-mortar model, which is a crucial aspect of this evolution. Undoubtedly Information Technology plays a pivotal role in these retail-marketing strategies, reshaping the retail marketing strategies landscape. Throughout the long term, the retail area has seen a seismic change in customer inclinations and ways their behaving appears. In the retail market, the introduction of the Information technology has digitally transformed the marketing strategies very well “shorter attention spans with instant gratification, personalized push notification, market trends, strategic analysis, location-based marketing and anticipatory shipping for fulfillment of customers' needs and improves the customers relationships behaviors”. Now, the Customers are not confined or bound to actual stores; they are using digital platforms, going for virtual shopping, augmented reality & truly making it harder to tell the difference between online and in-store shopping. This progress has established an intricate and dynamic climate for retailers, requiring a thorough comprehension of the exchange among conventional and computerized systems. This paper sets out on a far-reaching examination of how Information Technology has affected largely and keeps on molding the procedures utilized by retailers to draw in with their clients, upgrade functional productivity, and stay cutthroat in a steadily developing commercial center.

articleTitle: Real-Time Data Streams: The Future of Predictive Maintenance in Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Dynamic Predictive Modeling is a method that has brought about a revolutionary change in the field of preventive maintenance in the industrial sector. Using the benefits of real-time data streams and flexible algorithms, this cutting-edge technology enhances predictive maintenance processes. In this investigation, we evaluate the efficacy of Dynamic Predictive Modeling to that of numerous more conventional methods, including vibration analysis, acoustic emission analysis, thermography, oil analysis, ultrasonic testing, and data analytics. Accuracy, resource optimization, adaptability, downtime reduction, cost-effectiveness, and preventative maintenance are just a few of the criteria we use to evaluate the methods. The findings indicate that Dynamic Predictive Modeling outperforms its predecessors across a range of performance metrics. It can better adapt to the ever-changing industrial environment, allowing for more precise and timely breakdown forecasts. The allocation of resources and the economy of operation are both enhanced by the fact that maintenance procedures may be adjusted according to the actual condition of the equipment. Predictive maintenance is the most effective method for minimizing unscheduled downtime and increasing output in heavy industry. In a comparison of several approaches to predictive maintenance, Dynamic Predictive Modeling comes out on top with the highest aggregate score. A study reveals how an unconventional approach might improve the effectiveness and reliability of industrial operations. Increased equipment reliability, decreased maintenance costs, and a potential advantage in the manufacturing industry might arise from the use of dynamic predictive modeling.

articleTitle: Course Material Recommendation System for Slow Learner Students by Using Machine Learning Based on Learning Behavior and Course Material Complexity Score
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on ICT in Business Industry & Government (ICTBIG)
abstract: Education data mining refers to the process of analyzing and extracting valuable insights from large datasets generated within the field of education. It involves applying data mining techniques, such as statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modeling, to educational data to uncover patterns, trends, and relationships that can inform educational practices and decision-making. Course material recommendation using machine learning involves leveraging machine learning algorithms to analyze user preferences, historical data, and content features to provide personalized recommendations for educational resources, such as textbooks, articles, videos, or online courses. Regular updates, feedback loops, and continuous monitoring are essential to maintain and improve the recommendation system's effectiveness. This paper focus onthree key aspects, first to identify the student learning behavior. We propose clustering method for the study of students' learning behavior associated with positive and negative outcomes (in exams). Second, is to introduce an approach to classifying student characteristics to predict performance on assessments data. We demonstrate that employing supervised classifiers results in a considerable improvement in classification performance. Finally, the study turns toward developing a technique for recommending appropriate study material by calculating readiness of student and complexity of course material. To achieve the objectives three models are proposed and combined into one for designing accurate and efficient course material recommendation model. In initial steps popular machine learning algorithmsi.e.K-Means, FCM (Fuzzy C Means), and K-FCM (kernel based FCM) is implemented to cluster students according to their learning behaviors. On the other hand, to designs a model for student performance prediction two supervised classifiers i.e. C4.5 and CART is implemented. Using both the components a course study material recommendation model is proposed. Further,for the final course material recommendations process syllabus of the UG course is used and the syllabus keywords are extracted. These keywords are used as query to find content from the internet. The identified material is offloaded and then preprocessing of the contents is carried out. The aim is to recover two kinds of features, first by using the NLP (natural language processing) based text parser to compute the material's complexity score. Second feature is calculated using TF-IDF as the content features. The calculated features are working as transaction set for Apriori algorithm. The Apriori algorithm is used for the frequent pattern mining. The obtained contents from this mining help to filter the data according to their content relevance. Secondly the complexity score of the document is used for suggesting the suitable course study material according to student's readiness compatibility. The experimental evaluation of the proposed ML based EDM framework demonstrate effectiveness, for supporting students to getting performance feedback, to enhance their learning, and obtaining relevant and personalized study material. The performance analysis in terms of precision, recall and F-score demonstrate the accurate outcomes of the recommendation model.

Author Keywords: Readiness and Complexity of Course Material
